fdroid:be.suivicompteurs.app.name: Suivi compteurs
fdroid:be.suivicompteurs.app.summary: Read your meters and forecast your consumption, weather-adjusted.
fdroid:be.suivicompteurs.app.description:
F-Droid users: since version 1.6.2, the app is signed by its developer. If the update won't install, export your data, reinstall, then import it.
Record your water, gas, electricity and heating oil meters, and see where your year is heading.
READINGS IN SECONDS
• Photograph the meter: the reading is recognised automatically, on the phone, offline (not in the F-Droid version).
• The app checks the reading: a meter never goes backwards, and a serial number is not mistaken for a reading.
• Reading reminders, as often as you like.
• After each reading: what it changes in the forecast, and your use compared with what the weather suggested.
FORECAST YOUR YEAR
• Forecast of your consumption up to your next annual reading, or to 31 December.
• For heating, the forecast follows the weather: a mild autumn is not extrapolated onto January.
• Estimated cost, from your tariffs.
COMPARE AT EQUAL WEATHER
• Each year is corrected for how cold it was, using degree days: a drop caused by a mild winter no longer looks like a saving.
• Energy signature: see how much your house uses per degree of cold, and the effect of insulation.
• Forecast accuracy: replay a past year to see what the app would have announced.
YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• No account, no server, no ads.
• All data stays on the phone; only the house's location is sent to Open-Meteo for the weather.
• Excel export and import: back up to Google Drive or elsewhere, bring in an existing history.
AND ALSO
• Several houses, meter replacement, dual-rate meters, tariffs and events (insulation, works…).
• Heat cost allocators: one line per radiator with its factor, annual resets included.
• Prepaid meters: read the balance, note your purchases, and the app works out your usage.
• Heating oil tank with a gauge: read the level, note your deliveries.
• Heat (district heating, heat meters) and meters you get consumption figures for, such as kWh per month.
• Points to check: the app spots readings that were probably mistyped.
• Charts: year to date, monthly consumption, year comparison, climate.
• Available in English, French, Dutch and German, in any currency.
• Fully free F-Droid version: no automatic reading, the index is typed by hand.
Weather data: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0).

fdroid:com.trougnouf.cfait.name: Cfait
fdroid:com.trougnouf.cfait.summary: Powerful, fast and elegant TODO / task manager. (CalDAV and local)
fdroid:com.trougnouf.cfait.description:
Take control of your TODO list. 
Cfait is designed for speed and stability using Rust, it puts you in control of your data with a local-first approach that syncs seamlessly across your devices.
 Why Cfait? 
 Open Source & Cross-Platform: Use Cfait on Android, Linux, and Windows. Your tasks adhere to open standards (CalDAV and iCalendar), not walled gardens.
 Syncs Everywhere: Fully compatible with Nextcloud, iCloud, Radicale, Xandikos, and other standard CalDAV servers.
 Offline First: Optimistic UI updates mean you never wait for a server response. Use the persistent "Local" calendar for offline tasks and migrate them to a server later.
 Smart Input: Add tasks naturally. Typing "Buy cat food !1 @tomorrow @@grocery_store ~15m" automatically sets the priority, due date, location and duration.
 Productivity Features 
 GTD Workflow: Mark tasks as Needs Action, In Process (>), Cancelled (x), or Done.
 Hierarchy: Create sub-tasks, promote children, and organize nested lists.
 Dependencies: Link tasks using "Blocked-by" or "Child-of" logic (RFC 9253).
 Tags & Aliases: Organize with hierarchical tags (e.g., #work:backend). Create inline aliases (e.g., #shed:=#home_improvement and @home_improvement:=@@home) for rapid filing.
 Sane Sorting: Tasks are sorted by Status > Start Date > Due Date > Priority.
 Smart Syntax Guide 
When adding or editing a task, use these shortcuts:
 !1 to !9: Set Priority (1 is Critical, 9 is Low).
 @date: Set Due Date (e.g., @tomorrow, @2025-12-31, @2w, @in two weeks).
 ^date: Set Start Date (hides task until date).
 ~duration: Estimate time (e.g., ~30m, ~2h).
 @every X: Set Recurrence (e.g., @daily, @every 2 weeks).
 @@loc: Set Location (e.g., @@home, @@"hardware store").
 url:http://perdu.com: Attach a URL.
 Advanced Search 
Find exactly what you need with powerful filters:
 is:active / is:done: Filter by status.
 ~<30m: Find tasks taking less than 30 minutes.
 !<3: Find high-priority tasks.
 @<today: Find overdue tasks.
 @@home: Find tasks at a specific location.
 Support the Developer 
If you enjoy using Cfait, please consider supporting its developer:
 💳 Liberapay: https://liberapay.com/trougnouf
 🏦₿ Other payment details are available within the app's "Help & About" screen or on the project website.
 Community & Source 
Cfait is developed by Benoit Brummer (Trougnouf) and released under the GPL3 License.
Source code, desktop versions, and issue tracking available at: https://git.disroot.org/trougnouf/cfait

fdroid:de.badaix.snapcast.name: Snapcast - multi-room audio in perfect sync
fdroid:de.badaix.snapcast.description:
Snapcast is a Snapcast control client and player for Android. It uses the Snapcast JSON-RPC API to control your synchronous multi-room audio player.
 This App is not meant for productive use and will only run when you have a Snapserver installed in your local network.
 Snapcast is a multi-room client-server audio player, where all clients are time synchronized with the server to play perfectly synced audio. It’s not a standalone player, but an extension that turns your existing audio player into a Sonos-like multi-room solution.
 The server’s audio input is a named pipe /tmp/snapfifo . All data that is fed into this file will be send to the connected clients. One of the most generic ways to use Snapcast is in conjunction with the music player daemon (MPD) or Mopidy, which can be configured to use a named pipe as audio output.

 Make it yours Fonts: monospace, clean, your phone's font, free Google Fonts, or import a .ttf/.otf, plus bold
 Font and clock size, 12/24h clock, search bar at the top or bottom

PLAY YOUR WAY

• Connect to Lichess or FICS for online games.

• Choose standard chess, Chess960, or Duck Chess.

TRAIN AND IMPROVE
• Solve puzzles from Lichess.
• Practice with a collection of mate-in-two puzzles and training positions.
• Explore openings with the built-in ECO opening explorer.
• Navigate through moves and review complete games.
MANAGE YOUR GAMES
Save games in a local game database and search by details such as player, event, date, or result. Edit saved games, import and export game files, and share positions or games through other apps.
ACCESSIBLE CHESS
Chess for Android supports screen readers such as TalkBack. Board squares, pieces, moves, and controls provide spoken information to help screen-reader users navigate and play.
The optional Accessibility Drag mode provides another way to move pieces for players who find conventional dragging difficult. Its timing can be adjusted to suit different interaction needs. Accessibility Drag is a separate mode intended for use without TalkBack.
PLAY ON A BIGGER SCREEN
Cast the chessboard to a Chromecast-enabled TV or display, so other people can follow the game on a larger screen.
USE YOUR PREFERRED ENGINE
In addition to the built-in engine, Chess for Android supports the Open Exchange Protocol (OEX), allowing compatible third-party chess engines to be used when installed.
Whether you want a quick offline game, online competition through Lichess, tactical training, accessible chess controls, or a searchable database for your games, Chess for Android gives you a flexible chessboard wherever you go.

apple-macos:1502228492.description:
The Oregon Trail™ by Gameloft—Experience The Oregon Trail™ like never before. A modern twist on the trials and tribulations of the road to Oregon, this official successor to the global phenomenon will immerse players in exhilarating journeys ranging from the historically accurate to the totally extreme. Players will pick their traveling party, stock the wagon with supplies, and embark on an adventure filled with tough choices, new dangers, and unexpected situations. Surviving blizzards, broken limbs, snakebites, exhaustion, starvation, and the dreaded dysentery is no small feat; all the while navigating an untamed frontier to get your party to their new life in Oregon before the winter. Track down a missing party in the aftermath of a fierce blizzard, transport volatile gunpowder through blistering desert heat, compete in challenging hunting mini-games, and meet a broad cast of historic figures. With procedurally selected random events where players’ choices affect their party and future game events, there’s always a new adventure on the horizon every time you play.
Always a New Adventure
• Build and name your party from different classes—each with their own starting items, skills, and personalities—to make every journey to Oregon unique.
• Overcome hundreds of random events where your choices affect the fate of your travelers, and are influenced by their unique skills and traits.

Fresh Features
• Take on 15 playable Journeys.

True to the Original

Striking Art Direction and Score
• A beautiful blend of charming pixel art characters, 3D environments and cutting-edge lighting and visual effects creates a unique visual style that’s both nostalgic and contemporary.

Respectful Representation

Officially Licensed & Supported

 smart full-text search allows for rapid information retrieval. Completed todos can be hidden or
 archived into separate done.txt files. Easy integration with other todo.txt apps is facilitated
 by continuously scanning todo.txt files for changes.
 sleek is available for Windows, macOS and Linux, and in several languages.
 Features
 Uses existing todo.txt files or creates new ones
 File watcher scans todo.txt files for changes
 Simultaneously manage multiple todo.txt files
 Add and search for todos by priority, contexts, projects, due date, creation date, completion
 date, recurrence (repeating todo), threshold dates (deferred todos), pomodoro intervals
 Filter, sort, and group todos by all available attributes
 Invert the sorting of each group
 Find todos using a sophisticated advanced search based on the todo.txt syntax
 Inline autocomplete available for adding contexts and projects
 Multi-line and bulk todo creation
 Due dates, threshold dates, recurrences, pomodoros and priorities can be selected by built-in
 picker elements
 Speaking dates can be entered for due and threshold dates
 Marking a recurring todo as complete, will create a new todo
 Navigable via keyboard shortcuts
 Due date notifications
 Toggle between dark and light mode
 Completed todos can be shown, hidden, and archived
 Language options: English, German, Italian, Spanish, French, Simplified Chinese, Brazilian
 Portugese, Japanese, Turkish, Hungarian, Czech, Polish, Russian, Korean, Hindi

flathub:com.slugchess.SlugChess.name: SlugChess
flathub:com.slugchess.SlugChess.summary: Chess with Fog-of-War and shuffled officers
flathub:com.slugchess.SlugChess.description:
SlugChess online digital chess variant with fog-of-war and double shuffled officers. 
 It is both a rule set and an application for Linux and Windows.
 In SlugChess you can only see a limited part of the game board based on the type and position of your pieces. 
 You can only move your pieces to squares you can see. Both white and blacks officers are shuffled separately and completely random. 
 Therefor you can't know where your opponents king is at the beginning of the game. 
 You win SlugChess by capturing the opponents king. There are two sub-variants of SlugChess with different vision rules. 
 They are SlugChess Torch and SlugChess Sight.
 In SlugChess Torch the vision is a range around your pieces, as if they are holding a touch. The range of pawns are 1 and officers 2. 
 This sub-variant results in methodical games where you have to fight for vision and build up and advantage.
 In SlugChess Sight the vision is the squares your pieces can move to. 
 Therefor your pieces can move as in normal chess but you can see a lot less. In addition knights and pawns have vision range of 1. 
 This sub-variant results in dynamic and aggressive games that can swing back and fourth and can end quickly.

flathub:io.github.htkhiem.Euphonica.name: Euphonica
flathub:io.github.htkhiem.Euphonica.summary: Advanced music playback powered by MPD
flathub:io.github.htkhiem.Euphonica.description:
Dynamic playlists, integrated spectrum visualiser, background blur, synced lyrics & more.
 Features 
 Both a self-contained music player and an MPD-compatible client. The power of MPD, without the manual set-up. Plays nearly every format, DSD included!
 Supports most MPD features, from queue reordering and ReplayGain to output control, crossfade and MixRamp.
 Genre & tag filtering, plus in-app tag editing.
 Client-side dynamic playlists: both query and sticker filter rules, multiple ordering clauses, fetch-first limits, scheduled refreshes, all via an intuitive editor UI.
 Fetch album arts, artist avatars and (synced) song lyrics from external sources (currently supporting Last.fm, MusicBrainz, TheAudioDB and LRCLIB).
 Configurable multi-artist and multi-genre tag splitting.
 Stay in control while in the background via MPRIS & XDG Background Portal.
 Customisable spectrum visualiser (FIFO or system PipeWire).
 Live bitrate readout + audio quality indicators (lossy, lossless, hi-res, DSD).
 Largely **zero-cost** static background blur.
 Volume knob with dBFS readout support ('cuz why not?)
 User-friendly configuration UI & GSettings backend
 MPD passwords are securely stored in your user's login keyring.
 Works with large playlists (tested with 30K songs).
 Commands are bundled into lists for efficient MPD-side processing where possible.
 myMPD-compatible stickers handling.
 This Flatpak installation bundles MPD 0.24 internally to serve as the playback engine for Standalone Mode.
 PipeWire permissions 
 Euphonica requires PipeWire capture permissions for its PipeWire visualizer backend, but currently it is only possible to specify a "blanket" PipeWire permission that also allows screen recording, microphone access, etc. Euphonica does not make use of these extra permissions, and will be updated to use a more restricted "audio portal" when one becomes available.
 Screenshot content copyright information & disclaimer 
 Album arts contained in the screenshots have been substituted with random photos from Pexel. All credits go to the original authors.
 Euphonica is solely a music player programme and does not provide any media content or sources. Users must provide their own content or manually configure Euphonica to access third party online services.

flathub:org.alienarena.alienarena.developer: Alien Arena team - previously COR Entertainment
flathub:org.alienarena.alienarena.description:
Do you like old school deathmatch with modern features? How about rich, colorful, arcade-like
 atmospheres? How about...retro Sci Fi? Then you're going to love what Alien Arena has in store
 for you! This game combines some of the very best aspects of such games as Quake III and Unreal
 Tournament and wraps them up with a retro alien theme, while adding tons of original ideas to make
 the game quite unique.
 Project 100
 Release 7.72 and later has been optimized to smoothly run at least a 100 FPS frame rate on a
 100-tick server with 100 PPS packet rate, and with a mouse polling rate that aligns with the frame
 rate. This greatly improves the smoothness and responsiveness of the game. Also the lag compensation
 got an improvement to match the 100-tick server better and to make it fairer to low-ping players,
 which is configurable per server.
 Single player
 Also from 7.72 and later you can now practice the game modes CTF and Tactical from the single
 player menu, for Deathmatch and CTF you can now also choose weapon modes Insta and Insta/Rockets.
 Note about the "Potentially unsafe" warning: This game uses the xorg legacy windowing system,
 and allows the use of a joystick or controller.

flathub:xyz.safeworlds.hiit.description:
Exercise Timer is a simple utility to conduct high intensity interval training. Following a
 short preparation period, a prescribed number of exercise sets are played. In between each exercise,
 there is a resting period. The app does not make an assumption about the kind of the exercise.

 Save and recall presets containing the number of sets and the duration of the exercise, rest
 and preparation periods.

 The volume of the sound can be adjusted.
 Light and dark mode follows the system's setting.

fedora-packages:golang-github-gorilla-mu.name: golang-github-gorilla-mux-devel
fedora-packages:golang-github-gorilla-mu.summary: A powerful HTTP router and URL matcher for building Go web servers
fedora-packages:golang-github-gorilla-mu.description: Package gorilla/mux implements a request router and dispatcher for matching incoming requests to their respective handler. The name mux stands for "HTTP request multiplexer". Like the standard http.ServeMux, mux.Router matches incoming requests against a list of registered routes and calls a handler for the route that matches the URL or other conditions. The main features are: – It implements the http.Handler interface so it is compatible with the standard http.ServeMux. – Requests can be matched based on URL host, path, path prefix, schemes, header and query values, HTTP methods or using custom matchers. – URL hosts, paths and query values can have variables with an optional regular expression. – Registered URLs can be built, or "reversed", which helps maintaining references to resources. – Routes can be used as subrouters: nested routes are only tested if the parent route matches. This is useful to define groups of routes that share common conditions like a host, a path prefix or other repeated attributes. As a bonus, this optimizes request matching. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – github.com/gorilla/mux

fedora-packages:golang-github-klauspost-.name: golang-github-klauspost-pgzip-devel
fedora-packages:golang-github-klauspost-.description: Go parallel gzip compression/decompression. This is a fully gzip compatible drop in replacement for "compress/gzip". This will split compression into blocks that are compressed in parallel. This can be useful for compressing big amounts of data. The output is a standard gzip file. The gzip decompression is modified so it decompresses ahead of the current reader. This means that reads will be non-blocking if the decompressor can keep ahead of your code reading from it. CRC calculation also takes place in a separate goroutine. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – github.com/klauspost/pgzip

firefox-addons:2913335.name: OWASP Penetration Testing Kit
firefox-addons:2913335.summary: Penetration Testing Kit is an extension for application security practitioners, penetration testers, and red teams.
firefox-addons:2913335.description:
OWASP Penetration Testing Kit (PTK) is an open-source browser extension for interactive security testing of web applications.
PTK works from the live browser session where the application actually runs. This gives it access to the authenticated workflow, browser-generated traffic, loaded client-side code, application routes and runtime behaviour being tested.
Use OWASP PTK to:
Capture and inspect HTTP requests and responses generated by real browser workflows.
Run selected DAST checks against captured requests, parameters and request bodies.
Analyse JavaScript and HTML loaded by the browser for insecure patterns and source-to-sink data flows.
Observe security-relevant browser behaviour while the application executes using in-browser IAST.
Identify client-side libraries and known vulnerable versions with SCA.
Replay and modify requests with R-Builder, including cURL import and export.
Inspect, edit and test JSON Web Tokens.
Review cookies, browser storage, security headers, application technologies and discovered routes.
Encode, decode and transform data used during manual security testing.
Why test from the browser?
Authenticated applications and single-page applications often depend on state that is difficult to reproduce outside the browser. PTK tests the workflow you are currently using, including its identity, tokens, navigation, API traffic, DOM state and loaded client-side resources.
PTK provides its own extension interface and does not require browser DevTools. Its normal testing workflows do not require traffic to be routed through a separate desktop interception proxy.
For automation and CI/CD, use PTK Agent together with the separate PTK Auto browser extension. OWASP PTK also integrates with OWASP ZAP for combined browser-side and proxy-based security testing.
OWASP PTK is intended for penetration testers, bug bounty hunters, AppSec engineers, developers, QA engineers and security students.
OWASP PTK is free and open source.
Use PTK only against applications where you have explicit authorisation. Active scanning, request modification and token testing can modify application data, generate additional traffic and trigger security monitoring.

Apache Cordova online is a tool that enables users to run an Apache Cordova IDE online over an Android emulator directly from their web browser. With this extension, users can easily develop and test cross-platform mobile applications without the need for any additional software installations.
Features:

firefox-addons:826282.name: Download Star
firefox-addons:826282.summary: Download all items in a webpage that match a pattern
firefox-addons:826282.description:
A simple addon to replace DownThemAll filtering but without the download manager. 
Specify a filter to download matching files. Files are added to the native download manager. The number of concurrent downloads can be limited in the addon options.
Choose which items are scraped using the 3 buttons on the bottom left: linked images and media, embedded images and media, and plaintext links.
 New in 2.0.4! There is now an option in the add-on options to open in a popup window instead of the default browser action popup.
 Requried Permissions: 
 Download files and read and modify...: This one should be obvious.
 Optional Permissions: 
 Access your data for all websites: Required to scrape links and images from other tabs besides the active tab (i.e.: for the Scrape All Tabs button,) or from cross-origin iframes.
Note: The downloads API in web extensions is lacking in many features. Currently, you can only place downloads inside of Firefox's default downloads folder. Files served using Content-Disposition header to provide a filename cannot be handled properly. Skip existing files is based on remembering downloaded URLs, since there is no API to test for existence of a file.

bluejetty:00144643:ios.description:
“Helps you track your dreams, analyze them and even teaches you how to lucid dream.” ~Forbes
The #1 dream app that helped track millions of dreams.
Oniri (previously Capture) is the most complete app for dream journaling, dream interpretation, and lucid dreaming.
◆ DREAM JOURNAL
The most complete dream journal app to track everything about your dreams.
□ Write down or record and transcribe your dreams
□ Track emotions, people, places, context, and much more
□ Generate images with AI or draw your dreams
◆ DREAM INTERPRETATION
Understand the meaning of your dreams with personalized dream interpretation, based on science.
□ Get a personalized interpretation of your dream with AI, based on science
□ The AI asks you questions to deepen the understanding of your dream
□ Access nightmare analysis, trends, and correlations modules to discover patterns in your dreams
◆ LUCID DREAMS
Start having lucid dreams now with all the most popular techniques for lucid dreaming.
□ Reality check reminders and widgets
□ Night cues and alarms to hear in your dreams
□ WILD, MILD, SSILD: guided tracks to perform all the popular lucid dreaming techniques
□ Soundtracks and binaural beats to guide your sleep
□ Track dream goals and dream signs
◆ AND MORE
Everything else you expect from a dream journal.
□ Password protection to protect your journal
□ Export your dreams to PDF, TXT, CSV or even video
□ Calendar view
□ Advanced statistics
□ Filter & search
◆ DREAM SYMBOLS AND DREAM DICTIONARY
What does your dream mean? Look up hundreds of general dream interpretations, like a dream dictionary, and follow the dream symbols, people, and places that come back in your dreams night after night.
◆ NIGHTMARES AND RECURRING DREAMS
Bad dreams and recurring dreams usually have something to say. The nightmare analysis shows how often they come back, what you feel during them, and who shows up in them, so you can see the pattern instead of just living it.
◆ WHY KEEP A DREAM DIARY?
The more dreams you record, the more dreams you remember. A dream diary also makes dream interpretation and lucid dreaming much easier, because you start to recognize your own dream signs, dream symbols, and patterns.
◆ WELCOME TO YOUR DREAMS
Whether you want to remember more of your dreams, understand what they mean, or have your first lucid dream, Oniri has what you need. Hundreds of guides and stories along the way will help you learn more about yourself.
Oniri was first released in 2015 under the name Capture, and has been developed with dreamers around the world ever since. Same app, same team, new name.
~
Enjoy the app and sweet dreams!
~~~~
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel the subscription once activated. After purchase, manage your subscriptions in App Store Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
~~~~

Puzzle mode: Progress through the game by destroying cities
bluejetty:00104720:android.description:
(HD version: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nodetrack.citydeshd)
Welcome to City Destructor! 
Your goal is simple: Demolish cities!
Featuring two game modes: 
Puzzle mode: Progress through the game by destroying cities. You need to do as much damage as you can, using a fixed amount of bombs! Can you beat all levels with a gold metal? 
Playground mode: Every level you complete in puzzle mode, it unlocks in playground mode, where there are NO RULES! Place as many bombs as you like, combine different bombs to create a cinematic havoc! It's just "demolition and chill"
More havoc, more money! 
Every building you demolish, every car you damage, it earns you Kaos Coins (Koins)
Spent your hard earned Koins to unlock new bombs and upgrades! Bigger bombs, bigger explosions, total demolition!
Destroy cities in style!
Bombs descriptions:
💣Kaos Bomb: This is the basic bomb,
💣Thrower Bomb: breaks pieces from the building throwing them outwards.
💣Imploder Bomb: collapses the whole building along its y axis
💣Cluster Bomb: spawns more bombs upon explosion.
💣Chrono Bomb: explodes and permanently slows time.
💣Black Hole Bomb: creates a vortex that can suck everything caught in its range.
💣KingBomb: Musical bomb (in the tune of "hall of the mountain king" by Edvard Grieg). 
💣1812 Bomb: Musical bomb (in the tune of "1812 Overture" by Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky). 
💣William Bomb: Musical bomb (in the tune of "William Tell Overture" bt Gioachino Rossini). 
💣CanCan Bomb: Musical bomb (in the tune of Can-Can Music by Jacques Offenbach). 
💣RainDrop Bomb: will make it rain bombs, lots of bombs!
💣Stasis Field Bomb: stops time for anything that enters its field!
💣Meteor Bomb: spawns an unstoppable meteor that will crush anything in its path!
💣Antigravity Bomb: will sent anything enters its field flying!
Get your demolition game on!

This fun yet challenging
bluejetty:00073330:ios.description:
Welcome to a brand-new logic game from the developer of the prominent Sudoku.com and Nonogram.com free puzzle games. Dive into exciting stories with cross logic puzzles, challenge your brain, and unravel mysteries!
This fun yet challenging brain puzzle game with simple rules may help to strengthen logical thinking and deductive reasoning. Try to solve all the smart riddles grouped into thematic stories that are sure to delight. Help Detective Grapes investigate a necklace theft, participate in vacation planning for a young couple, or even go on a space expedition. You will find many mind-bending stories with varied plots and tricky solutions. If you are interested in solving logic problems, play this engaging game and have hours of fun!
How to play a logic puzzle game:
• Each puzzle contains several categories and an equal number of parameters within each category
• The goal of these brain teasers is to match all parameters in the grid correctly
• Each parameter can be matched to only one other parameter in each category
• A logic grid puzzle is solved by making conclusions based on a limited number of clues
• Read clues and put ticks in the table accordingly
• Rule out incorrect options and place crosses
• Use reasoning, elimination, and pure logic to fill the remaining cells and deduce the whole brain puzzle!
What you get:
• Easy to learn logic grid puzzles
• Tons of free brain-teasing logic riddles for you to enjoy
• Unique puzzle pages grouped into various entertaining stories for every taste
• Hints to help you reach the goal faster
• No time limit, take your time and focus on the details playing cross logic riddles
• Top-notch quality from a top puzzle developer!
Try Logic Puzzles now, put your gray matter to work, and have fun!

SpeakGenius — Your smart AI assistant for everyday use.
This is a modern application powered by artificial intelligence, designed to assist you in communication, learning, work, and creativity. SpeakGenius is a versatile tool to help you handle daily tasks and expand your capabilities.
Features of SpeakGenius:
– Intelligent conversation 
Ask questions, discuss any topic, and receive personalized recommendations, advice, and in-depth responses from a smart AI companion.
– Image generation 
Create unique images from text descriptions — perfect for design, inspiration, or creative projects.
– Educational assistance 
Break down complex topics, get help with homework, write essays, and understand difficult concepts — SpeakGenius makes learning easier and more accessible.
– Text generation 
Generate articles, emails, social media posts, marketing copy, scripts, poems, songs, jokes, and much more — simply provide a topic or goal.
– Text translation 
Support for dozens of languages. SpeakGenius helps you communicate with people around the world without language barriers.
– Programming support 
Generate and analyze code in popular programming languages including Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, and more. Ideal for both beginners and experienced developers.
– Information search and analysis 
Get fast and accurate answers to any question based on relevant data and context.
– Text evaluation and improvement 
Edit, proofread, and receive style suggestions — improve the quality of your texts in just a few taps.
SpeakGenius is your reliable digital assistant, always within reach. Download the app and start using artificial intelligence in your daily life today.

bluejetty:00184506:ios.description:
It's the best word puzzle game of all time! Train your brain and spin the wheel in the official Wheel of Fortune mobile game!
Have you ever wanted to buy a vowel? Spin the Wheel with Pat Sajak? Guess letters and watch them appear on the iconic puzzle board? It’s WHEEL...OF...FORTUNE - based on the popular game show, and now you can be a contestant!
Jump into the Emmy®-winning TV game show you know and love because now it’s an addicting mobile game! Spin the Wheel, solve new puzzles written by the show’s producers, and win prizes. Challenge your friends and family through Facebook or play with millions of other players from around the world! 
Make it a daily habit and challenge yourself to new exciting puzzles with fun categories every day!
In Wheel of Fortune, Pat Sajak guides you on a fun-filled trip around the world with new puzzles from the hit TV game show! Play thousands of other fans, friends and family for a huge prize! The winner of these word puzzles will come out on top with the ultimate jackpot! 
Wheel of Fortune Features: 
Official Puzzles 
- Play THOUSANDS of all-new word puzzles created by the hit TV show! Can you solve these official word puzzles from the minds behind America’s Game? Stay tuned; fresh puzzles are released all the time!
- Solve word puzzles in Wheel of Fortune games, anytime and anywhere you want. You can finish a game in five minutes or less! 
TV-style Gameplay 
- Feel like you’re on TV. Hit the right wedges to score and win big, but watch out for Bankrupt and Lose a Turn! 
- Choose your other letters wisely to solve the puzzle and win the ultimate prize! Just like on TV, you’ll get a selection of letters to use in the Bonus Round!
Exciting Online Tournaments & Multiplayer games 
- Challenge friends and family in Wheel of Fortune! 
- With millions of players worldwide, you can test your word solving skills instantly with thousands of other fans, friends and family for huge jackpot prizes!
Travel Around the World 
- Discover amazing puzzle themes from cities like New York, Paris, Tokyo and Hollywood to unlock upgrades to bring your own flair to the party. 
Social Online Interaction 
- Play with friends and family or challenge millions of players
- Create your own puzzles and try to stump your friends with Puzzle Maker!
- Chat, find new friends and send gift boxes to other players
The VIP All Access Pass is here!
Enjoy a jackpot of ongoing benefits with a VIP subscription - available for a cost of 9.99 USD/month (or local equivalent) charged to your iTunes account at the end of each 30-day subscription period, at the price displayed to you at the time of purchase, unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours prior to the renewal date. 
Try the VIP All Access Pass one-week Free Trial. A free trial will convert to a Paid subscription unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours prior to the end of the trial. Unused portions of free trials will be forfeited upon purchase of a subscription. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewals in your device account settings, as described in our FAQ on "How to Cancel a Subscription."

bluejetty:00166687:ios.name: Wakemusic：Offline Music Player
bluejetty:00166687:ios.summary:
Your music. Your collection. More than playback.
Wakemusic brings your local files, cloud drives, NAS and Navidrome library together. Play, explore and organize your music, from a favorite track to a carefully curated collection.
◆◆◆ Loca
bluejetty:00166687:ios.description:
Your music. Your collection. More than playback.
Wakemusic brings your local files, cloud drives, NAS and Navidrome library together. Play, explore and organize your music, from a favorite track to a carefully curated collection.
◆◆◆ Local music, ready when you are
1. Play MP3, FLAC, WAV, M4A, AAC, APE, AIFF, DSF, DFF and more, from everyday listening to lossless collections.
2. Import files and folders, transfer over Wi-Fi or extract audio from videos.
3. Browse by song, artist, album or genre. Make playlists and save favorites.
4. Download music for offline listening on your commute, on a trip or anywhere without a connection.
◆◆◆ Connect your collection
1. Access Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, pCloud, MEGA, Baidu Netdisk, Aliyun Drive, 115, 123 and Guangya cloud drives.
2. Connect to your NAS, computer or server via SMB, WebDAV or FTP.
3. Stream music or queue downloads to build your offline library.
4. Enable pre-downloading to keep completed downloads in your local music folder as you listen.
◆◆◆ Your personal music server
1. Explore Navidrome and compatible Subsonic services in a dedicated server mode.
2. Rediscover recent plays, favorites, playlists, random picks and recent additions.
3. Browse and search songs, artists and albums. View album details, artist biographies and similar artists when supplied by the server.
4. Download songs, then switch to classic mode to enjoy them offline.
◆◆◆ Give your music lasting value
1. Find song information with audio fingerprint recognition.
2. Edit titles, artists, albums, artwork and lyrics to keep your collection organized.
3. Embed metadata in supported audio files so your work stays with your music across devices and players.
4. Recognition results and writable tags depend on the song and file format.
◆◆◆ Shape the sound. See the details.
1. Adjust a 10-band EQ and preamp gain to suit your taste.
2. Try Bass Boost, Vocal, Rock, Jazz and other presets, or save your own settings.
3. Analyze local audio spectra and check format, file size, average bitrate and sample rate.
4. Save or share an analysis card. A spectrum helps reveal audio characteristics but cannot, on its own, prove a recording is truly lossless.
◆◆◆ Make listening your own
1. Choose vinyl, cassette and other player styles.
2. Enjoy artwork-inspired backgrounds, mini lyrics and audio information.
3. Use shuffle, sequential playback, repeat-one, queue management and a sleep timer.
◆◆◆ Premium and purchases
1. Remote connections, EQ adjustments and some other features require Premium. See the app for details.
2. Choose a monthly or annual subscription, or a personal or Family Sharing lifetime purchase.
3. Free trial eligibility, duration and subsequent pricing, when offered, are shown at purchase.
4. Subscriptions renew automatically. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account subscription settings. Lifetime plans are one-time purchases and do not renew.
◆◆◆ Good to know
Wakemusic is a player and library manager; it does not supply music. Use audio you have permission to access. Third-party access, memberships, transfer limits and features depend on each provider.
Feedback: support@kakainc.com
Privacy Policy:
https://kakainc.com/en/wakemusic/legal/app-store/privacy/
Terms of Use:
https://kakainc.com/en/wakemusic/legal/app-store/terms/

bluejetty:00126925:ios.description:

Receive in-app notifications regarding activities, weather, and important schedule changes from the app home screen or main navigation menu. You’ll find the most up-to-date news and information and can even have your mobile device notify you when notifications are published in the app. 
The EAA AirVenture Oshkosh 2022 event in the app is sponsored by BendixKing.

- Advanced specimen details and rare rock database
- No ads for uninterrupted discovery
- Priority support for identification questions
- Export tools for serious collectors

SKIDOS now supports kids with ADHD, Dyslexia, Dysgraphia & Dyscalculia. Built with accessibility guidelines, the experience is tailored to every child’s unique learning needs—making learning more personalized, inclusive, and enjoyable for neurodivergent learners too.
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
Bike Racing
Epic SKIDOS Bike Trial! Kids master skills, dodge spikes, glass, bombs, and wind to collect treasures. Boosts problem-solving, focus, creativity, and coordination in a fun, educational game. Navigate thrilling levels for child development!
Bike Racing includes:
101 adventurous levels
Fun to play, challenging to master
Tons of upgrades
Personalize bikes your way

bluejetty:00062482:ios.description:
Welcome to my kindergarten! You can experience great fun: handcraft, have music lessons, meet new friends, learn good habits. Are you ready? Let's start your journey! 
Learn to make handcrafts
Are you a little fan of handcraft? Learn how to make handcrafted cars with the kindergarten teacher! Cut a carton and fold it into the shape of a car; put on wheels, windows, and lights. The handcrafted car is ready! Don't forget to color and decorate the handcrafted car! 
Take music lessons
Be creative and DIY glass bottle instrument! Pour water into glass bottles, drop in paint to color the water, and make colorful glass bottles. Fix the glass bottles on the wooden shelf to assemble them into a musical instrument. Then knock on the instrument to play soothing music and show your musical talent! 
Meet new friends
At kindergarten, you will meet new friends and play games together: make sandcastles, play swings, blow bubbles...You can also play hide-and-seek with friends. Take a close look and find where they are hiding. Under the slide? Behind the big tree? Or in the ocean balls? 
Learn good habits
Eat by yourself and wash hands before meals; develop the good habit of taking a nap after lunch, keep your voice down and walk slowly; put your things away and learn to stand in line. Do you know these good habits? Come to my kindergarten. Learn more good habits and become a kid of good manners! 
What are you waiting for? Come to experience and accustom to the kindergarten life. Get to enjoy and love kindergarten!

bluejetty:00084906:ios.name: No Meat Today
bluejetty:00084906:ios.summary:
You believe that eating less meat might be good for you, animals and our home planet.
But when you begin to reduce meat consumption, it’s hard to measure your effort and balance your diet.
I know, I’ve been there.
No Meat Today makes track
bluejetty:00084906:ios.description:
You believe that eating less meat might be good for you, animals and our home planet.
But when you begin to reduce meat consumption, it’s hard to measure your effort and balance your diet.
I know, I’ve been there.
No Meat Today makes tracking your meatless meals in a fun & simple way, whether you want to progressively adopt a vegan diet or find a flexitarian balance that suits you.
You will become the god of a universe with two planets: punch them to answer Naomi’s daily question “Did you eat meat today?”
Next time you want to indulge in a burger, you can look at your logs and decide if you can allow yourself a tender steak. I call that “asking my cow”, and it has helped me decide more than once.
Your universe hosts a single species: Daisy cows. They are named like that because they are attracted by one DAY of meatless meals.
The most friendly of them is your personal cowch, Naomi, as in Naomi’t Today, and she will accompany you on your journey to eat less meat.
Your green and peaceful “No” planet is naturally appealing to them, but you got to earn their trust by logging meatless meals.
Daisy cows are a wonderful species: they have the ability to fusion and evolve into higher forms of cows that you will discover along your journey.
• Log your meatless meals: just hit the "No" planet if you didn't have any meat, or the "Yes" planet if you did
• Gaze on your planet as it starts to attract cows, which happens each time you have one day worth of meals. Beware of scaring them!
• Fusion cows as your planet gets crowded and unlock more cows combos as you log more meals
• Have fun with the silly comments accompanying the habitual daily question: “Did you eat meat today?”
• Use your history to decide if your next meal should include meat or not
• Never forget to log your meals: ask for an evening reminder. If you don’t like notifications, just put the app on your home screen! I did both
• Still managed to forget a day? No worries, you can complete it later. Plus it’s a good memory exercise.
• Adjust the cows’ tolerance to your meaty meals by adjusting your target diet, from omnivorous to vegan
———
# Your privacy matters to me #
Your data is yours: it lives on your device and in your own iCloud, you can export it anytime in an open format (JSON), and I can’t read it.
The app only counts which features get used, anonymously and on European servers, so I know what to improve. It never sends what you ate, and there’s no ad tracking and no crash-reporting tool: bugs reach me through Apple’s tools, or when you write to me.
———
# This app tries to be good for the planet #
5% of the income goes toward animal welfare and planet conservation. What doesn’t go to taxes & fees will make sure I, Arnaud, will keep improving the app. And I have MANY ideas.
———
# You have the power #
This app was made for you with great care and dedication.
If you spot a bug, want to suggest a feature or have anything to say to improve the app, you can easily contact me from the settings.
———
Terms of Use: https://nomeat.today/terms
———
*** Wait no more, become Naomist, adopt the milky way! ***

bluejetty:00099300:ios.summary:
Bring Your Child’s Favorite Characters to Life in Coloring with Blippi & Friends, powered by Crayola!
This creativity-boosting coloring app is filled with scenes and surprises from beloved Moonbug shows like Blippi, CoComelon, Little Angel
bluejetty:00099300:ios.description:
Bring Your Child’s Favorite Characters to Life in Coloring with Blippi & Friends, powered by Crayola!
This creativity-boosting coloring app is filled with scenes and surprises from beloved Moonbug shows like Blippi, CoComelon, Little Angel, Morphle, and Oddbods.
Designed especially for kids ages 3–6, this preschool coloring app blends early learning and creative play through simple tools, intuitive design, and trusted, age-appropriate content. Whether it’s coloring JJ at the beach, Morphle on an adventure, or Blippi blasting into space, every stroke sparks imagination.
Endless Creativity with Familiar Faces
• Hundreds of coloring pages featuring scenes from hit Moonbug shows
• New content added regularly to keep kids engaged and excited
• Themed books let kids explore different stories, settings, and characters
• Save and revisit favorite creations anytime
• Download and save your little artist’s favorite creations
Built for Learning Through Play
• A preschool coloring app that encourages creative self-expression and confidence
• Supports fine motor development and hand-eye coordination
• Introduces colors, shapes, and patterns in context kids love
• Grows with your child’s creative skills
Kid-Friendly Tools
• Classic Crayola crayons, markers, brushes, and more
• Add sparkles, stickers, and fun textures with a tap
• Safe, intuitive tools designed for little hands
There’s Always Something New
• Explore themed journeys and unlock fun rewards
• Discover hidden surprises and bonus brushes
• Builds positive motivation through play
Made for Independent Play
• Simple navigation with voice support
• Designed for pre-readers and early learners
• 100% ad-free and COPPA-compliant for peace of mind
• Great for offline play at home or on the go
Made with Care by Crayola & Red Games Co.
• Developed in partnership with Red Games Co., a boutique studio led by parents, educators, and creatives who care deeply about fun, safe, and enriching play
• Named #7 on Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Gaming (2024)
• Built by people who understand what toddlers love—and what parents trust
• Focused on polished, playful design that sparks creativity and supports early development
• Makers of the award-winning, Parent-Tested Parent-Approved app Crayola Create and Play, Crayola Scribble Scrubbies, and more!
About Moonbug:
Moonbug inspires kids to learn and grow and have fun doing it through shows, music, games, events, products and more, including Blippi, CoComelon, Little Angel, Morphle and Oddbods. We make shows that are more than entertainment – they’re tools for learning, exploring and understanding. We work closely with trained experts in education and research to make sure our content is age-appropriate and provides value that complements the skills kids also learn through play and time with family.
Download the preschool coloring app, “Coloring with Blippi & Friends” today—and watch your little artist light up with color, creativity, and confidence!
Contact Us:
Have a question or need support? Reach out to us at support@coloringwithblippi.zendesk.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.redgames.co/coloringwithblippi-privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00186426:ios.name: Money Up! - Build Life Skills
bluejetty:00186426:ios.summary: Looking for an ACCESSIBLE app to teach or reinforce how to use money in real life situations? Money Up is the perfect app for children learning to handle money, kids, teens and adults with developmental disabilities as well as for therapist
bluejetty:00186426:ios.description:
Looking for an ACCESSIBLE app to teach or reinforce how to use money in real life situations? Money Up is the perfect app for children learning to handle money, kids, teens and adults with developmental disabilities as well as for therapists who work with stroke survivors, those in the early stages of Alzheimer’s, and more.
Money Up was designed by teachers and therapists as a way for people to practice working out how much money they have, if they have enough to purchase the items they need and how much money to give a cashier, all without requiring them to count change. The app’s goal is to help children, teens and adults to acquire or maintain a life skill they need in order to foster independence.
The app currently supports the following currencies:
• Australian dollar
• Canadian dollar
• U.S. dollar
• British Pound
• Euro
• New Zealand dollar
• Singaporean dollar
In addition to teaching the ‘Dollar Up’ technique, seven games provide the user with practice using it in the following situations:
• Identifying notes and coins
• How much to pay when shown a price total
• How much to pay when told a price total
• Checking how much money they have
• Working out how much money to hand over
• Paying for items
• Calculating if they have enough money to pay for items
For those who plan to use Money Up in an educational or therapeutic context, we have included many desirable features in the app including:
• Supports iPad Accessibility!
• Support for multiple students or clients
• The ability to customize the app to suit each user’s needs
• Data tracking, including reports that can be shared via email
• For children (or adults!) who want or need a fun break there are two mini games included in the app
• Support for students who's vision is impaired, through the use of high contrast backgrounds (selectable for each student).
• A complete grocery list editor. Choose your own groceries that suit your school.
• Add groceries from the camera roll, or the web via a paste operation.
• Add groceries using the built-in iPad camera.
• Five friendly characters with which to interact!
• Support for both English and Spanish languages
All aspects of Money Up have been designed to make it as accessible as possible and initial feedback from parents, teachers and therapists has been extremely positive:
"The lesson content is the important thing. It really has been useful for us. One student on the money program went from getting nowhere to almost mastering it in a fortnight, and when I asked her, she had been playing it in her free time."
"My [autistic] 16 year old just learned the method in 2 goes. I'm showing his teacher next week!!"
"Smooth design, no glitching, no need for a manual as I was able to get it started and working with the kids in minutes." 
Rated at 4.5 Stars by The iMums who think that "Money Up! is a valuable tool to have for those who want to teach their student the dollar up method and help them become more independent". 
http://www.theimum.com/2015/08/money-up-learn-how-to-use-the-next-dollar-up-method-by-pkclsoft-review-giveaway/
Rated at 5 Stars by Bridging Apps: "This is a solid and very well thought out app that provides a clean interface, structured/predictable pace, and consistent appearance and feedback with limited distractions, that is very important to students with special needs."
https://search.bridgingapps.org/apps/3968b077-cb3b-b54e-169f-ce44b8c15840
Certified by Teachers with Apps:
http://www.teacherswithapps.com/money-up/
PKCLsoft takes children’s privacy serious. For detailed information on our privacy policy, visit http://www.pkclsoft.com/wp/privacy/
–––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
KNOW WHAT'S INSIDE
As a Know What's Inside member, we follow the 
"Know what's inside" best practices for kids' apps 
–––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
At PKCLsoft we value your feedback so please email any comments or questions about Money Up to info@pkclsoft.com

bluejetty:00151857:ios.description:
Sprinting is the fastest way to get fit, 3AK makes it simple while guiding you every step of the way.
You don't need hours of jogging to change your health. A few short sprint sessions a week can lift your cardio fitness, build lean muscle, and give you more energy — in a fraction of the time. 3AK builds your plan, coaches your technique, and tracks every step of your progress.
WHY SPRINTING
- Time-efficient — real results in 20–30 minutes, not endless miles
- Heart & lungs — raise your VO2 max and cardiovascular fitness
- Strength & power — build lean muscle that steady-state cardio can't
- All-day burn — keep your metabolism working after you finish
WHAT YOU GET
- A personalized plan — adaptive sprint sessions built around your level and updated as you improve
- Daily readiness check — tell 3AK how your body feels and it tunes the session to match
- AI sprint analysis — breaks your run into phases (reaction, drive, acceleration, top-end, speed, finish) so you know exactly what to work on
- Sprint Age — see how fit you really are, and watch it get younger as you train
- Strength training — guided lifts that build the power behind your speed
- Snap-to-log nutrition — photograph a meal for instant calories and macros
NEVER SPRINTED? PERFECT.
No track, no experience, no problem. 3AK meets you where you are and coaches you every step — from your first stride to your fastest.
Start sprinting smarter. Download 3AK and feel the difference in weeks, not months.
Join 50,000+ people already training with purpose.

bluejetty:00177807:ios.description:
Want to take care of your car without spending hours with a hose, soap, and towels? 
Car Detailing Simulator is a virtual game where you can become an expert detailer in your own garage. Choose from one of 30 different car models, and clean it from top to bottom. Polish the bumpers, wash the bodywork, wax the paintwork – it's all there!
The Car Detailing Simulator will test your abilities to detail what matters most. From the dirty exterior, to the upholstered passenger compartment, there's no detail too small. Use your skills to create your best work and you'll be rewarded with new cars to keep for yourself or sell on the open market.
Do you want to be a professional car detailer? With Car Detailing Simulator you can live out your dream, while having fun and improving your skills. This game will teach you everything from the basics of care, to advanced techniques to make that car shine! You can also run your own business and upgrade your workshop as your skills grow. You’ll have access to the latest tools and equipment so there are no limits to what you can achieve. 
Use licenced AMMO tools for the most complicated jobs and toughest makeovers. 
Detailing includes:
- Washing
- Polishing
- Wheel cleaning
- Interior Vacuuming
- Interior stain removing
- Tuning
- And many more
Want to do your own car detailing and take it to the next level? 
With Car Detailing Simulator, you can do just that and so much more. 
Start by customizing your own cars with various tuning elements, then clean them up and make them look fresh and new. Upgrade your workshop and AMMO tools to get even better jobs and unlock better cars.
Confidently tackle any car detailing job with this powerful car care simulator. With Car Detailing Simulator, you can polish cars and restore their original shine without risking any damage. Choose from a wide range of auto care tools to wash, wax, and buff. Become a pro detailer with extensive training material to help you master the trade in no time! 
With a little of your time and effort, you can start earning money while upgrading your workshop to handle the toughest jobs. Work on cars to increase your car detailing skills and earn more from every job.
There is not a single person who will say that it's not nice to get a sparkling, clean car. And if you want your car to shine, but don't have the time or patience to wash it on your own, our Car Detailing Simulator will help you out! After all, it's so easy to spend some time with this game and keep your car spotless for weeks.

bluejetty:00164771:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00164771:ios.description:
Rumba is the daily Binairo+ puzzle for everyone who loves Takuzu, Binoxxo and binary logic. Simple rules, deep thinking, and a fresh grid waiting every morning.
How to Play: fill the grid with two symbols. Follow the rules:
1. Every row and column holds an equal number of both symbols.
2. Never more than two identical symbols side by side.
3. "=" joins cells that match, "x" joins cells that differ.
4. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, so you never have to guess.
Features:
- Daily Puzzle: a new grid every day, in the difficulty you pick.
- Weekly Challenge: a longer puzzle with no timer and no ranking. Take the whole week.
- 39 Puzzle Packs: five tiers from Beginner through Advanced, Expert and Wizard up to Genius. Replay any pack whenever you like.
- Grids from 6x6 to 24x24: start small, then take on boards most binary puzzle apps never offer.
- Hints That Teach: the solver explains the technique behind each move, from pairs and gaps to forced triples and chain reactions, so you improve instead of just getting unstuck.
- Strategy Guide: Rules, Basics and Advanced chapters, plus an interactive tour that walks you through your first grid.
- Play With Friends: invite friends, compare times head to head, and climb the global leaderboards.
- Streaks: build a run of daily solves, and recover one if life gets in the way.
- Make It Yours: swap the board symbols for 10 icon sets including sun and moon, animals, nature and food.
- Built for Comfort: dark theme, optional timer, quick saves, undo, redo, highlight marks, pinch to zoom, and full offline play.
Why Rumba?
Binairo, Takuzu, Binoxxo, Binero. Whatever you call it, this is binary logic done properly: hundreds of grids, a solver that actually teaches, and a new challenge every morning.
Download Rumba and start your streak today!
Rumba is a standalone product with no connection to LinkedIn. It has not been endorsed, authorized, sponsored, or approved by LinkedIn in any way.
Privacy policy: https://guriddo.app/rumba/legal/privacy
Terms of use: https://guriddo.app/rumba/legal/tos

bluejetty:00165506:ios.description:
Embark on an enchanting flower adventure where your intelligence blossoms as you uncover the allure of floral combinations! Navigate through a colorful landscape, guiding vibrant bouquets to dance to a melodic tune. Collect flowers of matching colors and watch them gracefully swirl in the vase, creating a symphony of puzzles and creativity.
Embrace the thrill of this delightful flower-matching game:
Explore a lush flower garden, seeking out beautifully coordinated bouquets. Strategically arrange them in the vase to create stunning floral displays. When sets of three identical blooms come together, they magically disappear, revealing new flowers. Each level tests your ability to match bouquets, boosting your score and honing your observation skills. Push your boundaries and aim for floral mastery!
Immerse yourself in stunning visuals and enchanting sounds:
The game's intricate design transports you to a vibrant floral paradise filled with vivid hues. The soothing soundtrack soothes your soul, inviting you to forget your worries and dive into this colorful world. Join us on a soul-nourishing journey through this floral paradise!
Experience the rush of timed flower-sorting challenges:
Each level has a strict time limit, pushing you to act quickly for the highest scores. As you progress, the clock ticks faster, making the challenge more intense. Stay calm, make quick decisions, and use your wit and courage to savor each victorious moment.
Collaborate with your team to earn rewards:
Join a team, make friends, showcase your skills, and collaborate with your team members to overcome challenges and earn generous rewards.
Main Features:
Explore the exquisite beauty of flower art in an endless floral world, all in a relaxed and casual way.
Free your mind by harmoniously arranging similarly colored flowers in the vase, creating spectacular arrangements.
Enjoy the peacefulness of fresh graphics and delightful sound effects, promoting relaxation and enhancing focus and mental sharpness.
Join now and see your flower kingdom thrive in this magical world of flower arranging. Every bloom brings beauty and success! You will become the best master florist of all time!

bluejetty:00113595:ios.description:
Hello, I'm George, Erste Bank's internet banking and mobile application service! 
My goal is to get the most out of yourself and your finances, which is why I am constantly expanding my features. Whether it's everyday banking, savings, or insurance, I strive to put all the solutions in your hands and help you where you need it.
Thanks to our "Selfie account opening" feature, you can now open a bank account in a just few minutes - without visiting a branch.
Available features:
• Selfie account opening
• Transfers / Internal transfers
• Currency conversion between your own FX accounts at preferential exchange rates
• Management of standing orders and direct debit mandates
• QR code-based bill payment
• Donations
• SEPA transfers
• FitZone – helping you stay informed about financial topics
• Spending overview by category and merchant
• Ability to attach files and add custom #hashtags to transactions
• Secondary account identifier management
• Payment request management
• Watchdog monitoring service
• Account statement download
• Debit and credit card application
• Fixed-term deposit opening
• Apple Pay card digitization
• Primary account modification
• Time-locked card limit settings
• Bank card PIN display
• Bank card blocking
• Secure online payments via Visa Click to Pay using your saved card details
• Round-up feature – rounds up every card payment
• Credit card loyalty program with point redemption
• Moneyback cashback program
• Highway vignette (toll sticker) purchase
• Display and management of active insurance policies, and new policy purchases
• Initiate authenticated calls directly from the app
• Messaging the bank and chatting with Mira, Erste Bank’s digital assistant
• Branch and ATM locator
What will you need when registering?
After downloading, you only have to enter your e-channel ID and password, and the freedom of banking is already yours.
5 stars service? I count on your opinion!
The goal is to use the best possible banking app, and you can help with this! Please, if you have a moment, rate my operation here on the store's interface with stars. Thank you very much!
Do you need a well-functioning relationship?
If you would like to receive answers to your questions about usage and/or to know that your comments about the operation will be included in the development, then write an email with the subject "George feedback" here: -> erste@erstebank.hu
Want to know more?
More useful information about me -> www.erstebank.hu/george
Now I've given you all the basic information, we'll see you on the other side after the download.
I'm already waiting!
George

bluejetty:00165716:ios.summary:
RUN YOUR LIFE, WITH HERO ASSISTANT
- Hero is the first Daily Assistant, and app that brings your life into 1 place, so you never forget a thing: Your calendars, to dos, habits, grocery ordering, notes, weather, and more
- Instead of checkin
bluejetty:00165716:ios.description:
RUN YOUR LIFE, WITH HERO ASSISTANT
- Hero is the first Daily Assistant, and app that brings your life into 1 place, so you never forget a thing: Your calendars, to dos, habits, grocery ordering, notes, weather, and more
- Instead of checking 10 apps, now you only need 1 (perfect for anyone with ADHD!)
- Powered by AI
●
1) RUN YOUR LIFE ALL IN ONE APP!
- CALENDAR – Sync all calendars (Google, Outlook, and iCloud) together in one place, so you never miss a thing (works with Google, Outlook, and Apple calendars). Hero is the perfect daily planner.
- TO-DOS – Stay on top of tasks and reminders with intuitive to do lists that let you create, organize, share, and comment on to-dos and tasks with family and friends.
- HABITS – Record and track your habits, see your streaks and progress, and more
- NOTES – Record plans using AI notes and voice memos, like grocery lists, shopping lists, vacation plans, or as an AI journal or habit tracker
- GROCERY ORDERING – Order your grocery list with one tap from 1000s of stores with Instacart
- WEATHER – Plan your schedule with hour by hour Apple Weather forecasts overlaid right on your calendar, including a 10 day weather forecast
●
2) START YOUR DAY RIGHT, WITH A PERSONAL DAILY BRIEFING
Hero briefs you daily as your personal AI assistant
- Just tell Hero’s AI what you’re interested in: news, sports, local events, and more
- Every morning, you’ll get a personalized update of what you care about. Read aloud with voice!
●
3) NEVER FORGET ANYTHING, WITH SUPERALERTS
- SUPERALERTS – Hero has the most powerful notifications of any app, usinglive activities to remind you and let you complete or snooze habits and to-dos right on your lock screen.
- CRITICAL ALERTS – In addition, Hero is the only app with "Can't Miss" notifications, which use critical alerts to make a sound *even if your phone is on silent*, for important to-dos, habits, and events. So now you will never forget a thing, which is especially useful for people who are neurodivergent or have ADHD
●
4) BLOCK SOCIAL MEDIA, WITH FOCUS MODE
- For the first time, an app marries to-dos and screen time, so you can be more productive
- If you want to be more productive, just tap “Focus”, and Hero will block social media apps for you
●
5) GET PROACTIVE REMINDERS AND ACTIONS, POWERED BY AI
As your personal AI Assistant, Hero proactively reminds you of what's coming up, and takes actions for you
- IMPORTANT EVENT REMINDERS – Never forget birthday, anniversaries, graduations, and more!
- FOLLOW UPS – Reschedule to-dos and habits, or remind your wife or husband to get something done if they've forgotten
- WEATHER ALERTS – Remember to grab your umbrella if it's going to rain, or dress warmer or cooler if there's a significant weather change
●
6) ORDER YOUR GROCERY LIST, GET 5% CASH BACK
Hero saves you hours every week with smart shopping lists and grocery lists
- AUTO-CATEGORIZE BY AISLE – So you can shop faster, AI auto-sorts your grocery lists and shopping lists by category
- TAP TO ORDER – If you don’t have time to shop, you can tap to order your grocery list and shopping lists instantly from any of your favorite local stores with Instacart
- GET 5% CASH BACK – At the end of the month, you'll get 5% cash back emailed to you as a Visa gift card
●
7) COORDINATE INSTANTLY WITH YOUR PARTNER, FAMILY, AND FRIENDS
Hero Assistant works with others
- SEND TODOS = Use shared to-do and task lists to assign accountability and comment on to dos and reminders
- FIND TIME = Instantly check availability and share your calendar by pulling from the edge of the screen, to see when others are free or busy
- SHARE NOTES = Use shared notes to plan events, organize projects, or see accountability for a grocery list run
- COMMENT ON ANYTHING = To discuss to-dos and notes, attach images for more context, and more
●
- For Terms of Use, see https://www.tryhero.app/terms
- For feedback, contact brad@mail.tryhero.app

bluejetty:00145628:ios.description:
Prepare for an epic war of robots where your leadership decides the fate of the galaxy. In Mech vs Aliens, you take command of humanity’s most advanced forces—from robot units to starships and base operations. Uncover alien secrets in a story-driven campaign and lead the charge into hostile territory beyond Earth. This is not just another robot war—it’s a strategic conquest for dominance in deep space.
Choose your war robots, outfit them with cutting-edge weapons, and fight in both solo PvP arena battles and massive clan wars. Every choice counts as you strive to become the ultimate commander in this mech-powered galaxy war.
Key Features:
Immersive Story Campaign
Lead elite units across a galaxy threatened by alien invaders. Make critical decisions, unlock powerful technologies, and shape the future of humanity through an engaging narrative campaign. This is more than a robot war—it’s a battle for galactic control.
PvP Arena & Clan Wars
Test your personal skill in competitive PvP arena fights or join forces in large-scale clan wars. Fight alongside allies to take down rival clans and rise through the ranks. Whether you fight solo or with a team, strategy and coordination are key.
Advanced Mech Customization
Build a deadly fleet of war machines. Equip your mechs with high-impact cannons, guided missiles, energy shields, and tactical upgrades. Tailor each mech to your playstyle and dominate across diverse battlefields.
A Fleet of Unique War Robots
Command a wide array of specialized robots, each with abilities that can turn the tide of combat. Develop your forces, form synergies, and lead your custom squad into intense mech wars.
Daily Missions & Special Events
Complete missions to gain resources and unlock upgrades. Participate in limited-time events for exclusive weapons and visual customizations. There’s always a new challenge waiting in this evolving sci-fi battlefield.
In Mech vs Aliens, your victory depends on more than firepower—it demands intelligence, strategy, and bold leadership. Master tactical combat in robot shooting games, build your base, manage your fleet, and prove your strength in war robots multiplayer warfare.
Download now and step into the cockpit—lead your robots to victory, expand humanity’s reach, and carve your legacy across the stars.

• Retrieve your forgot username/password
• Report a debit card as lost or stolen

bluejetty:00070035:ios.summary:

Become part of a community of thousands of players from acr
bluejetty:00070035:ios.description:
EPIC PVP BATTLES
Start battling online in fast-paced duels!
Boom! is a 2D turn-based battle game with lovely retro graphics, destructible environments and dozens of unique weapons.
Become part of a community of thousands of players from across the world.
ACTION AND STRATEGY
Unleash powerful weapons to obliterate your surroundings and inflict maximum damage… Or strategically outwit your opponent in style.
Explore an endless array of possibilities! Leap your way to victory, or teleport to the best firing location. Harness the laws of physics to your advantage with ricochets and gravity. Erect walls and platforms to fortify your position. Slip into invisibility or burrow a tunnel to catch your enemy off guard. Employ hearts and shields for a solid defense. Test your fortune with luck-driven weapons and relish in their unpredictable and amusing outcomes!
150+ DESTRUCTIBLE BATTLEFIELDS
Cause massive explosions or reshape the terrain to your liking using Brick Potions of diverse shapes. 
Enjoy colorful environments - each meticulously handcrafted : plains, volcano, desert, forest, castles, city, sewer, snow mountain… All these await your exploration in this captivating pixelated world.
CHOOSE YOUR WEAPONS
Show off your skills with an arsenal of dozens of well-balanced and awesome weapons.
- Common weapons: Bazooka, Laser Gun, Frag. Grenade, Duck, Poop (!?), Proximity Mine, Blue Shield, Fart Bean (!!?)…
- Rare weapons: Double and Triple Bazooka, Bomb, Angry Duck, Chicken, Drill Rocket, Hammer, Magic Wand, Mirror Shield, Fart Pepper, Teleportation Ball…
- Legendary weapons: Super Bazooka, Golden Hammer, Flying Bomb, Invisibility Shield, Flying Teleportation Ball…
BATTLE IN 5 ARENAS
Training > Noob > Pro > Master > God
After a brief Training session to grasp the basics, you’ll dive headfirst into genuine combat.
Each Arena has its own set of rules and battlefields, promising a fresh and exciting challenge every time you step into the fray.
TOP THE LEADERBOARDS
Fight your way to the top to prove you are the greatest fighter.
Rank #1 for glory and for awesome rewards every day (Legendary weapons, coins, diamonds…)
INCREASE YOUR LVL
Reach LVL 100 and become the best player in the world!
COLLECT 250+ FIGHTERS
Want to be the coolest fighter? Play with a unicorn, a ninja, a superhero or a wizard!
Try to unlock the amazing Legendary characters!
PRIVATE ARENAS
To create a Private Arena, just choose an Arena name and share it with your friends or your community.
SEASONAL CHALLENGES
Participate in epic Challenges with twisted rules and win awesome rewards.
Lunar gravity, sudden death, special weapons… Everything is possible!
MORE FEATURES
- 100+ Emoji for in-game communication.
- 50+ Achievements to unlock special fighters. Get the Dragon after 100 victories. Get the Red Knight when you reach LVL 20. Shoot 500 rockets to unlock Rocket-man… 
- Daily Rewards: a new gift every day! Special fighters, weapons, coins, diamonds, chests… 
EASY TO PLAY
Straightforward controls made for mobile.
Everyone can enjoy Boom! thanks to a well-designed interactive tutorial.
FREE TO PLAY
Boom! is FREE to download and play, with NO ADS.
The Gun, Grenades and Cannon are UNLIMITED!
There are optional purchases with real money and optional rewarded videos to get more coins, diamonds and weapons.
SUPPORT
Any questions or suggestions? Found a bug?
Please send us an email: contact@1button.co
Get more info about Boom! and discover the latest games made by 1Button
Twitter: @1ButtonStudio
Instagram: @1ButtonGames
TikTok: @1ButtonGames
Web: 1button.co
Boom! has been crafted with passion by Thomas, Jeremie and Alexandre during 18 months of hard work.

bluejetty:00115184:ios.description:
Reverse Singing – The Ultimate Reverse Singing App
Reverse Singing is the fun, fast, and easy app that lets you record your voice or a song, flip it backwards, and try singing in reverse to match the original. Join the viral reverse singing challenge trend and see how creative you can get—completely offline, simple, and ready to play anytime.
How It Works
 1 Record or Import: Capture your own voice or import an audio clip.
 2 Reverse Play: Instantly hear your audio in reverse.
 3 Imitate & Record: Try singing what you hear, then reverse it again to check your accuracy.
Why You’ll Love It
 • Instant Reverse: Flip any song or voice in just one tap.
 • Clean Reverse Playback: Large, intuitive controls with clear waveforms and quick replay.
 • Offline & Private: No internet required; perfect if you’ve used “reverse audio online” tools before.
 • No Account Needed: Start reversing and singing immediately.
 • Lightweight & Fun: Great for party games, vocal training warm-ups, or creative sound experiments.
Perfect For
 • Viral reverse singing challenges with friends.
 • Practicing diction and vocal precision by singing backwards.
 • Reversing hooks, ad-libs, or sound effects for unique music textures.
 • Content creators looking for trending reverse audio effects for TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube.
Features
 • Record, import, and reverse audio in seconds.
 • Adjustable playback speed and loop for focused practice.
 • Session tracking: define a session as a full loop—say → reverse → imitate → reverse.
 • Clean, simple interface with optional ads after sessions.
If you’re looking for a reverse app, reverse audio app, reverse singing app, or reverse play app, this is the perfect tool to jump on the latest reverse singing trend. Simple, reliable, and endlessly entertaining.
