bluejetty:00186381:ios.description:
NCalc — Powerful Scientific Calculator, Graphing, and Converter
NCalc combines a natural-display scientific calculator, advanced math tools, a full graphing module (as 83/84 calculator), a large formula library, and a comprehensive unit and currency converter—designed for students, engineers, and anyone who loves math.
◉ Main Calculator Features
- Natural display: Enter expressions exactly as in textbooks—fractions, roots, exponents, and more—see results as written on paper.
- Keyboard layout: Matches popular models for familiarity and speed: 115 ES Plus, 991 ES Plus, 300 ES Plus, and 991 EX.
- Symbolic and numeric modes: Perform exact fraction calculation or evaluate numerically when needed.
- Arbitrary precision integers: Work with very large integers without losing accuracy.
- Output types: Choose from fraction, mixed fraction, decimal, repeating decimal, degrees/minutes/seconds, and polar coordinates.
- Angle units: Degree, radian, and gradian (grade).
- Decimal formatter: Display numbers in normal, engineering, engineering SI, scientific, or fixed formats.
- Calculation history: Review and reuse past calculations with ease.
- Copy and paste support for fast data entry and sharing.
◉ Algebra, Calculus, and Core Math
- Algebra calculation: Expansion, factorization, simplification, and more.
- Calculus calculator: Derivatives, integrals, and limits of expressions.
- Complex number calculation: Arithmetic, polar/rectangular conversion, exponential, logarithm, powers, roots, and full trigonometric functions.
◉ Equations and Inequalities
- Equation solver: Solve general equations, plus dedicated solvers for quadratic, cubic, and quartic equations.
- System of equations solver: Solve systems with 2, 3, or 4 variables.
- Inequality solvers: Quadratic, cubic, and quartic inequalities with interval-based solutions.
◉ Matrices and Vectors
- Operations: Addition, subtraction, multiplication for matrices and vectors.
- Advanced tools: Determinant, inverse, transpose, rank, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors.
◉ Statistics and Distributions
- Statistical calculation: Descriptive stats and regression calculation (including a regression plotter).
- Distribution calculation: Normal distribution, binomial distribution, Poisson distribution, t-distribution, chi-square distribution, and F-distribution.
◉ Number Bases and Formats
- Base N calculation: Effortlessly switch between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal, with arithmetic in each base.
◉ Tables, Variables, and Custom Functions
- Table Generator: Generate value tables based on any expression and range.
- Calculator variables: Store values and reuse them across calculations.
- User-defined functions: Create your own functions to streamline repetitive work.
- Built-in constants: A rich set of mathematical and physical constants.
◉ Formulas
- Extensive formula collection: Math and Physics formulas, clearly categorized—ideal for secondary school, high school, and university students.
◉ Unit Converter
- Currency Converter
- 1000+ unit conversions
◉ Graphing as 83, 84 calculator
- Cartesian functions, implicit plots, polar, and parametric.
- Tracing, roots, intersections, extrema, derivative, and integral evaluations on graphs.
◉ Auto-renewing subscription
You may purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase.
• Auto-renewable subscription
• Your subscription will be charged to your AppStore account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your AppStore Account Settings after purchase
• Privacy policy and terms of use: https://ncalc-app.web.app/terms-of-services.html

bluejetty:00071494:ios.name: Complete Rhythm Trainer
bluejetty:00071494:ios.summary: The ultimate rhythm training app for musicians. Learn to read, recognize, tap and write rhythms from simplest to most advanced. Rhythm is one of the most important aspects of music and one that every musician should become proficient with.
bluejetty:00071494:ios.description:
The ultimate rhythm training app for musicians. Learn to read, recognize, tap and write rhythms from simplest to most advanced. Rhythm is one of the most important aspects of music and one that every musician should become proficient with. Designed like a video game and with strong pedagogical concepts in mind, this app will make you master rhythm while rendering the learning process enjoyable.
Features
• 252 progressive drills arranged over 4 levels / 30 chapters
• Extensive content: from simple time signatures to compound and asymmetric time signatures, from half notes and quarter notes to thirty-second notes, triplets, swing eighths, double dotted notes, quintuplets, ...
• 5 drill types: rhythm imitation drills, rhythm reading drills, rhythm dictations, two-voice reading drills and two-voice dictations
• Play a selection of 11 drills in arcade mode
• Play and practice polyrhythms in a dedicated polyrhythm section
• Most of the drills are randomly generated, enabling you to practice the studied rhythms as many times as needed
• 23 instrument sound banks with actual recorded sounds: piano, guitar, pizzicato violin, conga, bongo, djembe, darabuka, woodblock, ...
• Designed like a video game: earn 3 stars in each drill of a chapter to complete it. Or will you be able to obtain perfect 5-star scores?
• Don't want to follow the preestablished path of progression? Create and save your own custom drills and rehearse them at your own convenience
• Create full custom training programs and invite friends or students to join them. If for example you're a teacher you can create custom programs for your students, add drills every week and view their scores on private leaderboards
• Never lose any progress: cloud sync across your various devices
• 25 achievements to unlock
• Leaderboards to compare arcade mode scores with other players worldwide
• Nice and clean user interface with 2 display themes: light and dark
• 4 sheet music display styles: modern, classic, handwritten and jazz
• Designed by a musician and music teacher with a Royal Conservatory master's degree
Full Version
• Download the app and try out the first two chapters for free
• One-time in-app purchase to unlock the full version on all your devices
Having a problem? Got a suggestion? You can reach us at hello@completerhythmtrainer.com
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00153874:ios.description:
Unlock the secrets to your unique facial features and discover your most flattering styles with FaceForm, your personal AI face analysis and style guide.
Ever wondered what your true face shape is? Or which hairstyles and glasses frames would best complement your features? FaceForm uses advanced AI technology to provide a detailed analysis of your facial geometry, giving you the insights you need to enhance your look with confidence.
HOW IT WORKS:
Simply upload a clear photo, and our AI will get to work:
- Discover Your Face Shape: Instantly identify your specific face shape (e.g., Oval, Round, Square, Heart, and more) with a clear explanation.
- Detailed Geometric Analysis: Go beyond just shape. We analyze your facial symmetry, key ratios (like the Golden Ratio approximation), and the proportions of your features including eyes, nose, and mouth.
- Personalized Style Recommendations: Receive tailored suggestions for:
- Hairstyles: Discover cuts and styles that flatter your unique face shape and features, complete with reasons why they work and styles to approach with caution.
- Glasses Frames: Find the perfect frame shapes to balance and enhance your facial structure.
- Visible Skin Tone Analysis (Non-Medical): Get insights into your visible skin tone based on your photo, helping you understand your complexion better.
- Fun & Engaging Insights: Uncover your playful Animal Face Archetype, learn about celebrity feature similarities (type-based), and identify your facial feature superlatives.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE FACEFORM:
- Understand Your Unique Look: Gain a deeper understanding of your facial structure, symmetry, and proportions.
- Effortless Style Choices: Take the guesswork out of choosing hairstyles and glasses. Make informed decisions that highlight your best features.
- Boost Your Confidence: Feel more assured in your style choices knowing they are recommended for you.
- AI-Powered Precision: Leverage cutting-edge AI for a detailed and objective (though ultimately for informational and entertainment purposes) analysis.
- Comprehensive Reports: Get easy-to-understand reports detailing all aspects of your analysis and recommendations.
- Save & Track: Keep a history of your analyses to see how your look evolves.
Stop guessing and start understanding. Download FaceForm today and unlock your most confident and stylish self!
---

bluejetty:00149104:ios.description:
Peça seu empréstimo pessoal online dentro do app. Compare propostas de instituições financeiras parceiras e escolha com base nas condições apresentadas.
Empréstimo para CLT
Escolha a modalidade e responda para que precisa, quanto e para quando. Preencha o pedido com seus dados e autorize o encaminhamento às instituições parceiras. Salve e acompanhe por e-mail e código. Se a instituição aprovar o pedido, o valor é liberado por Pix.
Simular parcela de empréstimo
Veja uma estimativa ilustrativa antes de pedir. A simulação ajuda a avaliar parcelas, mas não representa aprovação nem condições finais.
Comparar taxa de empréstimo
Confira taxa, Custo Efetivo Total (CET) e exemplo representativo. Receba propostas dentro do app e conclua a contratação com a instituição escolhida.
Empréstimo para quem está negativado
Quem está negativado pode solicitar e comparar propostas. A elegibilidade depende dos critérios de cada instituição. O app não garante aprovação.
Empréstimo para pagar dívida
Avalie o custo total antes de assumir outro compromisso. Além do empréstimo pessoal, há consignado, antecipação salarial, antecipação do saque-aniversário FGTS e crédito com garantia de veículo ou imóvel.
O app facilita o pedido e não concede crédito. As instituições parceiras são responsáveis pela análise, aprovação, condições finais e pagamento. As condições completas de crédito estão no fim desta descrição.
Compare e escolha a proposta que atende à sua necessidade.
Condições de crédito
Prazo de pagamento: a partir de 3 meses, até 120 meses.
Taxa Percentual Anual (APR) máxima: 35,99% ao ano.
Exemplo representativo
Empréstimo de 1.000,00 reais em 12 parcelas, com juros de 2,05% ao mês (APR de 28,88% ao ano):
Valor solicitado: 1.000,00 reais
Parcela mensal: 94,85 reais
Total de juros: 138,20 reais
Valor total a pagar: 1.138,20 reais
Tarifas: Além dos juros, podem incidir IOF e tarifas da própria instituição. Confirme o Custo Efetivo Total (CET) antes de assinar qualquer contrato.
Este aplicativo não concede crédito: ele compara ofertas de instituições financeiras, e a aprovação é decisão de cada instituição.
Fonte das taxas: https://dash.creditocomvc.com.br/valores-credito.json
=========

Terms: https://knk-solucoes-app.myprivacy.dev/terms-of-service

Quem está negativado pode solicitar e comparar propostas. A elegibilidade depende dos critérios de cada instituição. O app não garante aprovação.

Empréstimo para pagar dívida
Avalie o custo total antes de assumir outro compromisso. Além do empréstimo pessoal, há consignado, antecipação salarial, antecipação do saque-aniversário FGTS e crédito com garantia de veículo ou imóvel.

O app facilita o pedido e não concede crédito. As instituições parceiras são responsáveis pela análise, aprovação, condições finais e pagamento. As condições completas de crédito estão no fim desta descrição.

Compare e escolha a proposta que atende à sua necessidade.

Condições de crédito
Prazo de pagamento: a partir de 3 meses, até 120 meses.
Taxa Percentual Anual (APR) máxima: 35,99% ao ano.

Exemplo representativo
Empréstimo de 1.000,00 reais em 12 parcelas, com juros de 2,05% ao mês (APR de 28,88% ao ano):
Valor solicitado: 1.000,00 reais
Parcela mensal: 94,85 reais
Total de juros: 138,20 reais
Valor total a pagar: 1.138,20 reais
Tarifas: Além dos juros, podem incidir IOF e tarifas da própria instituição. Confirme o Custo Efetivo Total (CET) antes de assinar qualquer contrato.
Este aplicativo não concede crédito: ele compara ofertas de instituições financeiras, e a aprovação é decisão de cada instituição.

bluejetty:00148866:ios.name: Stone Age Survival-Tribal Game
bluejetty:00148866:ios.summary: Step back into a world where survival is a daily struggle, and every moment counts. In Stone Age Survival, you’re not just a bystander but the hero of an epic journey that takes you deep into the Stone Age - a time when survival, courage, a
bluejetty:00148866:ios.description:
Step back into a world where survival is a daily struggle, and every moment counts. In Stone Age Survival, you’re not just a bystander but the hero of an epic journey that takes you deep into the Stone Age - a time when survival, courage, and skill were everything. This 3D adventure places you in a harsh but thrilling prehistoric setting where you must grow from a lone wanderer to the leader of a powerful tribe.
Survival isn’t just a game mode - it’s your way of life. Navigate the wilds, gather essential resources, and build the foundation of a new civilization. Start by crafting basic shelters and tools, then progress to constructing a full settlement where your tribe can flourish. Every piece you build is a step towards a thriving society, giving you more options and possibilities in your journey.
Offline adventure meets immersive clicker gameplay. Whether you’re tapping to gather materials or managing your tribe’s daily needs, Stone Age Survival combines the excitement of idle gameplay with the strategic depth of world-building. Gather, build, and protect your settlement as you strive to craft the world around you.
The Stone Age is rich with untold dangers and opportunities. Hunt wild beasts, explore uncharted territories, and discover hidden secrets. As you progress, the challenges grow - but so do the rewards. Unlock new tools and abilities to better equip your tribe for the perils of prehistoric life. Experience the Jurassic world like never before, where you must adapt or face extinction.
Take charge and build a legacy in the ultimate survival game. Stone Age Survival offers a unique combination of survival, building, and offline adventure mechanics, perfect for those who love a deep, evolving experience. Go from crafting basic items to overseeing a flourishing civilization. With each new level, unlock advanced buildings, enhanced weapons, and new strategies to face the Stone Age’s most daunting obstacles.
Play anytime, anywhere - even offline. Stone Age Survival is designed for uninterrupted adventure. With its idle mechanics, the game keeps progressing even when you’re away, so your civilization grows while you handle other tasks. Return to find new resources, buildings, and surprises that await you in this ever-evolving clicker experience.
Are you ready to craft the world of your dreams and conquer the prehistoric wilds? Download Stone Age Survival now, and step into an epic 3D adventure where every decision counts. Explore the vast Stone Age wilderness, lead your tribe, and build a future in a world untouched by time.

bluejetty:00123778:ios.name: Champion Strike - PVP Arena
bluejetty:00123778:ios.summary:
Win PvP battles with champion control and strategic unit composition!
An exciting battle with players from all over the world!! Welcome to 『Champion Strike』 where elaborate strategy and control fights are possible!
◈ Game Introduction ◈
『
bluejetty:00123778:ios.description:
Win PvP battles with champion control and strategic unit composition!
An exciting battle with players from all over the world!! Welcome to 『Champion Strike』 where elaborate strategy and control fights are possible!
◈ Game Introduction ◈
『Champion Strike』 is a real-time PvP strategy simulation game with a controllable Champion aspect.
Unpredictable battles with a strategic combination of champion control and card units will make the hearts of players all over the world beat!
Create a moment for reversal winning through strategic card unit combination.
If you are confident in strategy and control! Play now and become the hero of Super Play!
◈ Latest update features ◈
▶ Card Crafting and Dismantling System
- Attractive system for obtaining a desired specific card! 
- Dismantle unwanted cards and make them into new ones!
▶ Profile Decoration System
 - Show off your unique profile with your favorite characters!
 - Banners and badges can be customized to your own taste!
▶ 2v2 Battle
- This is a multiplayer battle mode where you can battle with your partner!
- Invite friends or clan member to play battles together!
- Take victory in a more diverse strategy 2v2 mode!
◈ Game Features ◈
▶ Evolved game play
 - Experience great PvP through skillful controls in real-time strategy battles.
 - Don't wait for automatic battle! Attack your opponent's week point directly!
 - Target and attack the opponent's units with the champion!
 - A tense 1 point situation! Jump into enemies and aim for the opponent's tower!
▶ The vast world of Champion Strike
 - Orcs, Demons, and Elves. Various cards such as beasts, machines, and buildings are waiting for you!
 - Collect over 70 different cards and build your own deck!
▶ World Battle
 - Meet and compete with players from all over the world in World Battle!
 - Show your control to beat your opponents with unexpected strategies!
 - Thrilling experience to enjoy in real time! Turn the tide of battle and claim a thrilling victory!
▶ Big Match
 - Watch the battles of the world's top rankers in real time in Big Match and receive cheering rewards!
 - You too can be the main character of the big match! Thousands of people will watch you play!
▶ World League
 - Classified into random groups of users based on the season's highest medal, and an event competition to determine the strongest in each group!
 - Obtain reward items according to the World Battle Victory Point ranking results during the event period!
 - Participate in the World League and challenge the world's No. 1!
▶ Clan system
 - Join a clan, send and receive cards with clan members, and enjoy clan race content!
 - Enjoy friendly battles with your clan members and friends!
 - Participate in the Clan Race and gather strength with your colleagues to receive even more valuable rewards!
▶ Various event modes
 - You can enjoy the pleasure of playing in various modes such as speed-up mode for fast battles, sudden death where the first player to gain victory points wins, and mana double mode for quick mana recharge.
▶ Ranking system
 - Take the top place in the ranking system operated by season and earn massive rewards.
▶ Daily Mission
 - Open daily free missions and various chests to get cards, gold, ruby, and emoticons.
[Official Community]
- Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thechampionstrike
- Official YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/ChampionStrikeOfficial
- Official Twitter: https://twitter.com/championstrike
Check out the various events and news of Champion Strike!
[Support page]
- Official support page: https://twohands.helpshift.com/a/champion-strike

bluejetty:00047001:ios.summary: Sirrus helps agronomists and farmers collaborate on farming decisions by making field data accessible and easy to collect. By connecting to the agX Platform, standardized field data is available offline and can be shared with other users an
bluejetty:00047001:ios.description:
Sirrus helps agronomists and farmers collaborate on farming decisions by making field data accessible and easy to collect. By connecting to the agX Platform, standardized field data is available offline and can be shared with other users and applications.
Features:
* Scout crops for pest pressures and easily record and collect observation photos
* Create and share recommendation from the field
* Generate PDF reports and share via email or text
* Soil sample using a grid, zones, or previous soil sampling points
* View fertilizer and nutrient recommendations
* Send recommendations wirelessly using Raven Slingshot®
* Export data as a shapefile
* Receive rainfall estimates updated to the hour for each field
* Drive or draw new field boundaries
* Store and share data securely via the agX Platform
ACCOMPLISH EVEN MORE WITH SIRRUS PREMIUM! Sirrus Premium unlocks advanced features:
* Advanced Fertilizer Recommendation Editor – Edit variable rate recommendations by total product or cost
* Product Labels/SDS – View up to date product information, labels, SDS and store for offline use
* Variety Tech Sheets – View and share variety traits/information and store for offline use
* Premium Reports – Beautiful PDF reports that cover your Scouting and Recommendation communication needs
* Recents Search – A tool to increase efficiency in recommendation creation by sourcing previous activities
* $49.99 Monthly, $499.99 Annually
*Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
*Sirrus Premium subscription prices may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://www.reedbusiness.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00129078:ios.description:
**Welcome to Cooking World**, the ultimate cooking game that blends the thrill of time management with the art of cooking!
**Embark on a culinary adventure!** Travel the globe and bring iconic dishes to life, step by step.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with soft, fluffy donuts and crispy chocolate brownies with gooey centers. Master delicate waffles, craft unique desserts, dishes, teas, and so much more-all in Cooking World!

- **FUN AND CHALLENGING:** Endless enjoyment meets fast-paced time management challenges.
- **REAL-LIFE EXPERIENCE:** Step into the shoes of a star chef and serve diverse customers around the globe.

Don your chef’s hat, grab your magic spatula, and wow the world with legendary dishes!
**Open Your Restaurant Anytime, Anywhere**
- No internet needed after the first download!
**Enjoy Free, Offline Fun!**
- Play this free cooking game offline whenever you want!
**Discover Culinary Capitals**
- Unlock and savor the flavors of iconic cities like Italy, Mexico, Tokyo, and Beijing!
- Dive into famous dishes like pizza, tacos, sushi, and Peking Duck!
**Over 2000 Unique Levels**
- Experience fast-paced, strategic gameplay that makes cooking a blast!
- Enjoy regular updates with new levels and exciting event restaurants for fresh adventures!
**Master Your Kitchen**
- Run your kitchen, upgrade ingredients, and create a top-tier restaurant!
- Get creative in your personal space for endless fun!

bluejetty:00044051:ios.name: Jigsolitaire
bluejetty:00044051:ios.summary:
Combine the photos depicted on the cards correctly to complete a single picture.
Once you experience the exhilarating snap of the cards fitting perfectly, you’ll be hooked for sure!
[Game Features]
 - Enjoy Completing Photos by Combining C
bluejetty:00044051:ios.description:
Combine the photos depicted on the cards correctly to complete a single picture.
Once you experience the exhilarating snap of the cards fitting perfectly, you’ll be hooked for sure!
[Game Features]
 - Enjoy Completing Photos by Combining Cards
Even if the cards seem random at first glance, once you find the exact spot they fit, the satisfaction of that perfect snap is unparalleled!
 - Intuitive Swipe Controls
Simply swipe to move the cards. When cards stick together, you can move them as a group, making gameplay smooth and easy.
 - Exhilarating Chain Reactions
The thrill of multiple cards locking into place all at once is seriously addictive. This is a puzzle game with high replay value.
 - Designed for All Skill Levels
Whether you have just a bit of free time or want a longer play session, this game is perfect. You’ll find new discoveries each time you play!
 - Wide Variety of Themed Photos
From flowers and landscapes to animals, we plan to add a diverse range of photos on an ongoing basis!
[How to Play]
 - Swipe to Move Cards
Swipe your screen to drag the cards wherever you like.
 - Move Connected Cards All at Once
When cards are placed correctly, they snap together. You can then move the connected group of cards as a single unit.
 - Caution When Overlapping Large and Small Cards
If you place a small card on top of a larger one, the larger card may shrink. Pay close attention to any size changes and combine them carefully.
Despite its simple controls, “Jigsolitaire” also offers depth through strategic card placement. Whether you love jigsaw puzzles, enjoy solitaire, or just want a fun and easy puzzle, give it a try!

Embark on a journey of creativity and storytelling with our innovative travel companion app. Just like the popular apps, Trav
bluejetty:00036149:ios.description:
Are your travel memories fading away in dusty photo albums? It's time to bring them to life with Travel Animator!
Embark on a journey of creativity and storytelling with our innovative travel companion app. Just like the popular apps, Travel Animator is here to help you create travel blogging in an exciting & dynamic way. 
Explore, Animate, Share your travel routes:
With Travel Animator, your travel experiences come to life like never before. Create stunning animations of your travel mapping, turning static photos into animated masterpieces that capture the essence of your wanderlust.
Interactive Travel Maps:
Plot your journey on interactive travel maps to give your audience a real sense of place. Highlight key landmarks, activities, and hidden gems along the way. It's like having a personal travel mapping that comes to life with a touch of your finger.
Share Your Adventures:
Share your animated travel stories effortlessly with friends, family, & fellow travelers. Whether it's on social media, or directly within the app, inspire others to embark on their own adventures.
Key Features: 
User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive & easy-to-use, Travel Animator is designed for travelers of all levels to create travel blogging.
Animation Styles: Choose from a variety of animation styles to suit your travel memories.
Map Integration: Seamlessly integrate maps into your animations and showcase your route.
Share with the World: Share your personal travel maps on social media or privately with friends & family.
Why Choose Travel Animator?
Whether you're a seasoned globetrotter or a weekend wanderer, Travel Animator is your perfect companion for reliving & sharing your journey mapping experiences. Our user-friendly interface & creative tools make it easy for anyone to become a travel storyteller.
Subscription Packages: 
We're excited to introduce subscription packages in our Travel Animator app, offering users flexibility and value with three packages: weekly, monthly, and yearly. Users can cancel their subscription anytime, but no partial refunds are given. 
Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of each plan period at the rate of your selected package. Manage your subscription & turn off Auto-renewal at anytime.
Privacy policy: https://www.travelanimator.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://www.travelanimator.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00015154:ios.description:
Enjoy your wildest visit yet with the free Denver Zoo mobile app!
The new Denver Zoo mobile app is the best way to explore the Zoo without missing anything that’s important to you! This digital guide includes a GPS-enabled map so you can find your favorite exhibits with ease, as well as the locations of concessions and restrooms. Use the Denver Zoo mobile app for easier access at the front gate by pulling up a digital version of your membership card or any purchased tickets.
FEATURES:
GET AROUND EASILY
-Access our GPS enabled map to find your favorite animals and where the restrooms and food stations are located. 
SEE DEMONSTRATIONS
-Check out the daily schedule of daily animal demonstrations, zookeeper talks and more.
GET TO KNOW THE ANIMALS
-Learn the animals names, birthdates and species information.
ACCESS YOUR ACCOUNT
-Skip the lines. Pull up your membership information, including your digital membership card and ticket purchases directly through the mobile app.

Get a consolidated view of your account balances, fixed/recurring deposits, credit card bills, and utility bills—all in one dashboard.

bluejetty:00081669:ios.description:
32 players compete to see who's the best Sonic hero!
Compete in fast‑paced knockout rounds across obstacle courses and survival arenas.
A fresh mix of obstacle‑course racing, survival battles, and fast‑paced online party action awaits.
Race through Dr. Eggman’s toy‑themed world!
Sonic and friends dash across the stages as toy‑like figures, speeding through chaotic courses.
Compete with players worldwide and jump into a fun, chaotic multiplayer party in every Rumble!
■■Easy controls for quick fun—anytime, anywhere! ■■
Experience a vast array of stages with different themes and ways to play!
Rumble is packed with different gameplay styles, including Run, where players race for the top spot, Survival, where players compete to stay in the game, Ring Battle, where players duke and dodge it out for the most rings, and lots more! Matches are short, so anyone can pick it up and play in their spare time.Clear three mini‑games in Ring Battle, or enjoy a one‑round quick match in Party Rumble.
Pick the mode that suits your playstyle—casual, competitive, or just for fun with friends.
■■Explore 75+ maps & modes—race, dodge, and outlast in chaotic party action.■■
Sprint ahead in Run, outlast rivals in Survival, or fight for rings in Ring Battle—every mode delivers chaotic mini‑game fun. Classic Sonic worlds like Green Hill and Chemical Plant appear as reimagined obstacle stages.
Enjoy a unique mix of fast run‑style action and signature Sonic speed toy-world chaos, creating a completely fresh online multiplayer party-game experience.
■■Join 32‑player online multiplayer, squad up, and enjoy the party together.■■
Enjoy real‑time online multiplayer with players from around the world.
Form a 4‑player squad to team up, support each other, and fight to stay alive together—
co‑op play and shared victories and fun party moments make every match even more exciting!
■■Unleash the Sonic mania! ■■
Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, Amy, Shadow, Dr. Eggman, and more fan‑favorite characters— including Surge from the Sonic the Hedgehog (IDW) comic series.
Collect character skins, animations, emotes, and effects, and customize your look freely to make your Rumbler truly your own!
■■Limited‑time events and crossover collabs add new mini games and beats.■■
Enjoy a variety of fast‑paced BGM that brings every match to life, along with iconic tracks from the Sonic series to make the world of Sonic Rumble Party even more exciting!
■■15M+ downloads worldwide — User Reviews■■

Write a note and it saves automatically as you t
bluejetty:00042123:ios.description:
Simple Notes. is exactly what it sounds like: a simple app for taking notes. It focuses on everyday essentials. No grids, camera, or audio—just text, with easy ways to organize and share it.
Write a note and it saves automatically as you type. The first line becomes its title. Search your notes, star favorites, sort by favorites, date, or title, and tap the counter to switch between character and word counts.
Keep notes close with widgets. Show a note you choose or browse a list of recent notes. Tap a note in a widget to open it in the app.
FEATURES
- Create and automatically save text notes
- Count characters or words
- Search, star, and sort notes
- View a selected note or recent notes with widgets
- Share notes as text or as a .txt file
- Add a note to a Messages conversation, with the option to include its title
- Create or retrieve notes with Shortcuts app
- Create note or search using Siri
HOW TO USE
Create a note: Tap “Create New Note” and start typing. Your changes save automatically.
Delete a note: Swipe left on it and tap Delete.
Sort notes: Tap the menu button and choose Favorites, Date, or Title.
Share in Messages: Open Simple Notes. from the Messages app drawer, choose a conversation and a note, then tap Send. Use the switch at the top to include or leave out the title.
Have a suggestion? Please leave a review on the App Store or send feedback through the app.

bluejetty:00043706:ios.description:
Twelve O’clock is an app that helps track your watch accuracy easily in a realistic way.
I can’t stress this enough: it’s “tracking”, not measuring instantaneous accuracy like a timegrapher device.
It’s a manual and oldschool job but it brings so much fun. It reminds me of the old days when I had to synchronize my watch to the clock on the TV at 7pm every day.
With Twelve O'clock you can:
** MANAGE YOUR WATCH COLLECTION
* Add, edit, remove any item in a list of your watch collection
* Include a nice wristshot of each watch
** KNOW YOUR WATCH ACCURACY
* Simply add some checkpoints and let the app calculate the accuracy in *second per day*
* A nice chart of the accuracy over the time
** LEARN MORE ABOUT HOROLOGY
* Curated content for watch lovers (like me)

bluejetty:00043742:ios.description:
Solitaire Classic: Klondike – The timeless card game you know and love!
Unwind, focus, and sharpen your brain with the most popular solitaire card game ever. Whether you're a seasoned solitaire player or new to card games, Solitaire Classic: Klondike offers smooth gameplay, elegant design, and daily brain-teasing challenges.
Perfect for casual play, mental training, or just passing time – easy to pick up, hard to put down!
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Top Features You’ll Love:
+ Classic Klondike Solitaire – Enjoy the original rules: stack by alternating colors, build suits from Ace to King.
+ Daily Challenges – New puzzles every day to test your skills and win rewards.
+ Offline Play – No Wi-Fi? No problem. Play anywhere, anytime.
+ Custom Themes – Personalize your cards and backgrounds to fit your style.
+ Smart Hints & Undo – Perfect for beginners or pros who like a second chance.
+ Auto-Complete & Save – Finish faster or come back later with autosave.
+ Left-Hand Mode – One-tap switch for a more comfortable experience.
+ Smooth Controls – Tap or drag cards effortlessly. Great for one-handed play.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Master the Game
Complete thousands of Klondike Solitaire levels, earn crowns and trophies, and track your progress with in-game stats. Can you rise to the top?
Stay engaged and motivated with monthly challenge systems designed to reward your consistency and skill.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
How to Play Klondike Solitaire:
+ Move all cards to the Foundation piles by suit (Ace → King)
+ Build descending stacks with alternating red and black cards
+ Reveal hidden cards and open up new moves
+ Use the Stock pile if you're stuck
+ Only Kings or King-stacks can go into empty spaces on the Tableau
+ Even if you’re new to solitaire, you’ll learn quickly with built-in tips and guidance.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Who It’s For:
+ Fans of classic card games like FreeCell, Spider Solitaire, and Patience
+ Players who want a relaxing, offline game to pass time
+ Anyone looking for a daily brain workout with simple, elegant design
+ Whether you're on a short break, commuting, or winding down before bed, Solitaire Classic: Klondike offers a perfect mental escape.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Play now to relax, challenge your mind, and enjoy the timeless fun of Solitaire!
Download today and join millions of happy players around the world!

bluejetty:00129006:ios.description:
Match 3 down THE YELLOW BRICK ROAD™ in a magical puzzle adventure game featuring classic characters like DOROTHY™, the SCARECROW™, the TIN MAN™ and the COWARDLY LION™!
Magic awaits in the EMERALD CITY™! Join the fun by solving puzzles and unlocking magical movie Moments! Learn fun facts and trivia, and see never-before-seen stills from The Wizard of Oz! Discover the rarest Moments to learn more about your favorite movie! 
Match your way to meet the wonderful Wizard of Oz in this amazing puzzle adventure!
The Wizard of Oz: Magic Match Features:
MATCH 3 IN THE LAND OF OZ!
- Match 3 with new and unique gameplay based on the beloved Wizard of Oz movie and characters!
- Matching brings you farther down the Yellow Brick Road with hundreds of exciting levels to overcome on your way!
- Match even faster with bonuses and power-ups from GLINDA THE GOOD WITCH™! Use Dorothy’s RUBY SLIPPERS™, Munchkin Lollipops and the Tin Man’s Axe to solve puzzles!
- Get help from your favorite movie characters by dropping their Medallions to the bottom of the board. They will appear and provide assistance on your current level!
IMMERSE YOURSELF IN OZ STORYBOOK!
-Play an infinite level to collect story points!
-Use your story points to complete pages in your storybook, and go on adventures with your favorite characters!
-Finish storybook pages to earn magical rewards!
STRING TOGETHER WINS TO EARN IN THE MUNCHKIN PRIZE PARADE!
-Beat matching levels without losing to start your streak.
-Earn enough victories in a row to unlock magical prizes!
EARN EXTRA REWARDS WITH MAGIC KEYS!
-Prove you’re an expert matcher by beating levels on the first try, and earning extra rewards!
-Unlock mystery boxes to reveal characters and win a Big Prize!
TRADE FOR REWARD IN THE GEM BAZAAR!
-Beat matching puzzles on your first, second, or third tries to earn gems!
-Take your gems to the bazaar and trade for fun rewards!
UPGRADE YOUR ITEMS WITH THE BAZAAR!
-Trade in extra items earned during match play for Emerald Points!
-Use your Emerald Points to advance up the Emerald City Challenge leaderboard!
BATTLE AGAINST THE WICKED WITCH!
- Match 3 or more gems against the WICKED WITCH OF THE WEST™ as you battle to reach The Wizard of Oz.
- The fantasy comes to life as you take on the Wicked Witch in turn-based matching combat.
ADVENTURE IN A MAGICAL WORLD!
- Visit Munchkinland, the Haunted Forest, and more enchanting locations on your way from Kansas to the Emerald City!
- Discover brand new levels and your favorite beloved characters in each new region you unlock.
- Adventure with friends from Facebook, sharing gifts as you go.
Download The Wizard of Oz: Magic Match and relive the magic of The Land of Oz today!
Already enjoying The Wizard of Oz: Magic Match? Like us on Facebook to stay up-to-date on the latest content, newest levels, exciting contests, and more. https://www.facebook.com/TheWizardOfOzMagicMatch/
ADDITIONAL DISCLOSURES 
• For specific information about how Zynga collects and uses personal or other data, please read our privacy policy at https://www.take2games.com/privacy.
• This game does permit a user to connect to social networks, such as Facebook, and as such players may come into contact with other people when playing this game. Social Networking Service terms may also apply.
• The game is FREE to download and includes optional in-game purchases (including random items). Information about drop rates for random item purchases can be found in-game. If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s Settings.
• Use of this application is governed by the Zynga Terms of Service, found at https://www.take2games.com/legal. Collection and use of personal data are subject to Zynga’s Privacy Policy, found at https://www.take2games.com/privacy.
THE WIZARD OF OZ and all related characters and elements are trademarks of Warner Bros. and Turner Entertainment Co. (s16)

bluejetty:00156347:ios.description:
Meet StreamLabs®, your all-in-one home water solution that protects your home from water damage and leaks from both plumbing and non-plumbing sources. Using a combination of advanced ultrasonic technology and sensors, StreamLabs captures and delivers powerful insights into your water usage – and provides real-time alerts of potential leaks. Manually customize your leak alert settings or let the new learning Smart Alerts™ feature automatically protect your home by detecting any water usage outside of the norm. 
Choose from three StreamLabs devices: StreamLabs Scout, StreamLabs Monitor or StreamLabs Control. All three of these Wi-Fi-enabled devices provide leak protection for your home, and work together or independently. The StreamLabs Scout and the StreamLabs Smart Home Water Monitor each install in under 5-minutes with no pipe cutting, tools, or professional installer required. The StreamLabs Control features remote, flow-based automatic water shut-off functionality, and can use alerts from the Scout to stop leaks even sooner for high-risk appliances such as water heaters and ice makers.
The StreamLabs App is mission control for your StreamLabs devices. It supports the Scout, Monitor and Control all in one place to create tailored household leak protection optimized for your needs. In the StreamLabs App, you’ll have access to:
- Live water usage
- Customized leak detection settings: slow and major leak alerts (Monitor and Control)
- Smart Alerts™ learning leak detection (Monitor and Control)
- Freeze alerts (Scout, Monitor and Control)
- Home and Away modes (Monitor and Control)
- Comparative water usage charts (Monitor and Control)
- Remote shut-off (Control only)
- Water pressure, water temperature (Control only)
- Drip Detect™ alerts (Control only)
- Room Temperature alerts (Scout, Monitor, and Control)
- Humidity alerts (Scout and Control)
See how StreamLabs puts household leak protection at your fingertips.
To learn more, visit www.StreamLabswater.com.

bluejetty:00061862:ios.summary:
Increase your project profits by better measuring and managing your construction crew. Workyard’s construction time tracking software uses the industry’s most precise GPS tracking to create accurate time cards and project cost reports.
Wor
bluejetty:00061862:ios.description:
Increase your project profits by better measuring and managing your construction crew. Workyard’s construction time tracking software uses the industry’s most precise GPS tracking to create accurate time cards and project cost reports.
Workyard Helps Construction Companies Improve Project Profits
*Eliminate excessive payroll expenses caused by inaccurate time cards.
*Improve accuracy of client billing with automated breakdowns of labor costs for each client.
*Increase crew efficiency by automatically displaying employee labor costs down to the individual task.
*Manage your crew more effectively with scheduling software that consolidates communication about work
Workyard Is Trusted By 1000s Of Contractors To Measure & Manage Their Labor
“GPS location with time is precise and accurate, so I can easily see when people are on site or headed to another location.” John Massarra, Owner, Prestige Flooring
“We’ve been able to track our labor expenses in real-time, with a cost capture that far outpaces what we were previously using. I would predict our client reimbursements will increase by 30% before the end of the year.” Kelly Adreani, General Manager, Earned Run Property Management
“When I tried TSheets the GPS showed me clocking in 3 cities away from where I was at. Workyard is by far the best GPS technology in the industry.” Corey Jeffers, Owner, Deer Creek Construction
“Once you factor in overtime, we’re looking at saving more than $1,500 per employee each year from eliminating those little time reporting mistakes.” Kathi Smith, Vice President, D&S Electric
THE MOST ACCURATE GPS TIME CLOCK FOR CONSTRUCTION
If you're using paper timesheets or a mobile app that shows your workers clocked in three cities away, you can bet you're losing money on payroll. Workyard’s mobile time clock captures precise GPS location, arrival, and departure information to give you confidence that every time card is accurate. 
Most companies say they’re saving up to $2,000 per employee each year by eliminating excess payroll costs caused by time reporting mistakes.
TRACK DRIVING TIME & MILEAGE
Since Workyard switches to super-high accuracy mode when your employees drive, you can count on the mileage we capture to be used in expense reporting.
ADD NOTES, PHOTOS, & RECEIPTS TO TIME CARDS
Workyard helps provide project updates and saves you time collecting paper receipts for expenses by giving your employees the ability to add photos and notes directly to their time cards.
REAL-TIME LABOR COST REPORTS THAT HELP IMPROVE PROFITABILITY
Collect up to 30% more in client invoices. By enabling employees to easily tag hours to projects and tasks using the Workyard app on their phone, you’ll get automated breakdowns of labor costs in actual dollar amounts for every client. All this comes in real-time, so no need to wait until the end of a pay period for valuable data.
INCREASE YOUR CREW’S EFFICIENCY
By automatically displaying your real-time labor costs down to the individual tasks done by each employee, Workyard helps you see how much you’re spending on each of your jobs. Workyard’s up-to-the-minute data helps you gauge if every employee’s time is being used efficiently.
SCHEDULE & COMMUNICATE ABOUT WORK IN ONE APP
Workyard consolidates all communication about your work – including tasks, notes, and photos – into the same app your team uses to track time, so you can more efficiently manage your team.
EASILY FEED YOUR PAYROLL & ACCOUNTING SYSTEMS ACCURATE TIME & COST DATA
With integrations to Quickbooks Desktop, Quickbooks Online, Foundation, ADP, Gusto, Quickbooks Payroll, and Paylocity, Workyard makes it easy to send accurate data to your existing accounting and payroll systems. 
SUPPORT FROM HUMANS
Have questions? We hate waiting on hold struggling to find someone that can help us. That’s why we’ve got a team looking forward to giving you straight answers. Contact help@workyard.com

Navigating the bustling city of Edmonton has never been easier and more convenient than with the Edmonton Transit iOS App. Designed with the modern commuter in mind, this cutting-edge application offers a seamless and user-friendly experience for residents and visitors alike.

Real-Time Tracking: Stay informed with live, real-time updates on bus and LRT (light rail transit) locations. Effortlessly track the exact arrival times of your preferred routes, ensuring you never miss a ride again.
Intuitive Route Planning: Whether you're a daily commuter or an occasional traveler, our app simplifies your journey with intuitive route planning. Enter your origin and destination, and the app will provide you with the most efficient and convenient transit options available.
Customizable Favourites: Save your frequently used routes, stops, and destinations as favourites for quick access. Personalize your transit experience by creating a customized dashboard tailored to your preferences.
Nearby Points of Interest: Discover local landmarks, restaurants, and attractions near transit stops with the app's built-in location services. Seamlessly integrate your transit plans with your city exploration.
Embrace the future of urban mobility with the Edmonton Transit iOS App. Whether you're a daily commuter or an adventurous explorer, this app empowers you to navigate the city with ease, efficiency, and confidence. Download now and embark on a smarter, more connected transit journey in Edmonton!

bluejetty:00123186:ios.description:
APP DESCRIPTION:
The Southeastern CU App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Southeastern CU customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Southeastern CU App, you must be enrolled as a Southeastern CU Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00084712:ios.description:
With the hvv switch App, you can use local public transport, carsharing, e-scooters, bikes and on-demand mobility – all with just 1 account.
Choose your perfect connection by bus, train or ferry – including the hvv ticket. For regular journeys in Hamburg and across Germany, the hvv Deutschlandticket as well as the hvv Deutschlandticket for senior citizens 67+ living in Hamburg are available directly in the app.
Alternatively, you can rent a car from Free2move, SIXT share, MILES or Cambio, book a MOIA-shuttle, or explore Hamburg flexibly with a Voi e-scooter or a StadtRAD bike.
Highlights of the hvv switch app:
• 8 providers, 1 account: local public transport, carsharing, shuttle, e-scooter & bikes
• Tickets & subscriptions: buy the hvv Deutschlandticket or any other hvv ticket
• Route planning: timetables for bus, train & ferry incl. disruption reports
• Reserve & hire cars: Free2move, SIXT share, MILES & Cambio
• Stay flexible: rent an e-scooter from Voi or a bike from StadtRAD
• On-demand shuttle: book a MOIA-shuttle
• Pay securely: PayPal, credit card or SEPA
Download the hvv switch app now and enjoy full mobility in Hamburg.
8 mobility providers – 1 account
Register once, use it all: buy hvv tickets and book Free2move, SIXT share, MILES, Cambio, MOIA-shuttle, Voi & StadtRAD – all with just 1 account. Stay flexible: local public transport, MOIA-shuttle, e-scooter, bike or carsharing – simply use whatever suits your needs.
hvv Deutschlandticket
With just a few clicks, you can buy the hvv Deutschlandticket or the hvv Deutschlandticket for senior citizens 67+ living in Hamburg in the app and start your journey straight away. Use local public transport throughout Germany, including regional trains RB/RE. If you live in Hamburg, you only pay for the days you have the ticket in the 1st month.
Order a digital ticket & pay conveniently
Whether it’s a short journey, single ticket or day ticket – the app automatically suggests the right ticket for your trip. Save 7 % on most tickets when you buy in the app and pay securely via PayPal, SEPA or credit card. Your ticket is available instantly in the app and can also be added to your wallet.
Set your most-used ticket as a favourite and access it quickly from the home screen via our widget. You can also easily purchase tickets for accompanying passengers.

bluejetty:00067947:ios.name: Sibelius
bluejetty:00067947:ios.summary: Sibelius brings professional music notation to iPad and iPhone, putting the workflows used by countless composers, orchestrators, and arrangers at your fingertips. Seamlessly move between iPad, iPhone and desktop, and from studio to coffees
bluejetty:00067947:ios.description:
Sibelius brings professional music notation to iPad and iPhone, putting the workflows used by countless composers, orchestrators, and arrangers at your fingertips. Seamlessly move between iPad, iPhone and desktop, and from studio to coffeeshop to scoring stage, and write anywhere inspiration strikes.
# Work on scores anywhere
Sibelius for mobile puts the #1 selling music notation program at your fingertips—literally. Work with the same tools and features used by countless composers and production houses every day on your iPad and iPhone. Whether writing down ideas, creating full-blown compositions, or reviewing scores, you have the freedom to create wherever you’re comfortable.
#Take your portfolio to go
Forget having to bring and break out your laptop when meeting with clients and collaborators. Instead, you can conveniently take the world’s most powerful notation toolset and your entire music portfolio with you wherever you go—ideal for those unexpected opportunities. And for tandemly working through last-minute revisions.
# Hear your music in stunning detail
Sibelius includes a high-quality sample library filled with a variety of musical instrumentation, so you can hear what your music will sound like when performed by real musicians. The Espressivo advanced notation interpretation even lets you adjust rhythm and swing to create a more humanistic feel.
# Speed your workflow
Sibelius for mobile is designed to take full advantage of Apple Pencil and iPad touch capabilities. Its elegant, streamlined interface provides the most intuitive and efficient workflows possible while supporting the same keyboard shortcuts you know and love from working on the desktop version, so you’ll feel right at home.
# Get innovative note entry
Experience the pen and paper workflow reimagined. Enter notes with the onscreen Keypad or a keyboard, and Sibelius takes care of all note layout. Touch a note and drag up or down to change its value, or drag left or right to add a flat or sharp. With an Apple Pencil, tap a note and tilt up or down to add a flat or sharp, or tilt left or right to choose the note value. 
# Have everything you need
In addition to the Keypad, Sibelius for mobile features a Create menu that’s optimized for iOS, making it easy to add clefs, key signatures, time signatures, barlines, symbols, text styles, and more to your score from searchable galleries. You can also quickly search through all Sibelius commands using the Command Search, putting the entire app at your fingertips.
# Move tiers to meet needs
Sibelius is designed to grow with you to support your creative aspirations and project needs. From the introductory (and free) Sibelius First to the industry-standard Sibelius Ultimate, you can add more notation capabilities and instrument parts to take on more creative opportunities by simply upgrading your subscription tier. 
# Have everything on one creative platform
Seamlessly move from desktop to tablet and back without ever having to import or export files. That’s because whether on mobile or desktop, you’re always in Sibelius. With files saved to iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, or other iOS-supported cloud service, you have easy anywhere access to all your ideas and scores.
# Enable a hybrid workflow
While Sibelius for mobile is fully featured, providing many of the same tools as its desktop counterpart, there are some notation and layout features only available in the desktop version, making it an integral part of a complete workflow (compare versions). Plus, the mobile version comes free with the desktop version, enabling you to work where and how you want.

bluejetty:00174495:ios.description:
AsiaPay for Non-Banking Financial Services is your best option for a varied payment service provider that is focused on boosting the economy with cutting-edge financial solutions created to motivate people from all walks of life. We have come a long way to make the first money transaction service in Iraq. Since the establishment of the company in 2014 and the launching on 29 December 2015, we are there to help the rest. AsiaPay reached a customer base of 260,000 users and has the largest distribution network in the country. Being the pioneer in technology-based financial solutions for everyone seeking access to financial transactions of any type, our products and services range from:
- e-Wallets;
- Money Transfers
- Bill Payments;
- Salary Disbursements;
- Merchant Payments;
- Online Shopping;
- Flight Reservations
- And much more. 
Our substantial investment in cutting-edge technologies and research enables us to provide our clients the most comprehensive and up-to-date menu of services.
In pursuit of our mission to be the preferred Non-Banking Financial Services solution provider by providing the most comprehensive and innovative bouquet of services, along with our vision to be the forerunner and leader in Non-Banking payment Services and to become a part of the customers' everyday lives, we concentrate on and directly target the financial needs and issues of the customers to pioneer groundbreaking and advanced set of services that address all the needs. We are prepared to provide a range of services that influence and enhance customers' daily lives while also guaranteeing a top-notch client experience that enhances each service.
The Central Bank of Iraq (CBI) licenses AsiaPay after complying fully with the requirements of CBI pursuant to Iraq Electronic Payment Service No (3) of 2014, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter Terrorist Finance (CTF) no 39 of 2015. 
 Company Strategy:
 - Vision: To be the number one choice for any mobile financial transactions in the country.
 - Mission: Delivering the most advanced financial services for our clients throughout Iraq.
 - Goal: Make AsiaPay every day’s choice.
Core Values:
We are a team that strives for improvement, never stops working, and uses cutting-edge technology to give our clients the best customer service possible.
To meet the needs of every class, AsiaPay offers three different types of wallets.
Lite wallet is a fast short-termed wallet. The threshold of the lite wallet is 2,000,000 million IQD for three months either per day or per the activation period, which is 90 days. Lite wallet holders must transfer the wallet to Standard wallet after three months because the wallet will be suspended. 
Standard Wallet can be obtained by visiting one of the AsiaPay agents throughout Iraq after the completion of registration procedures (Know Your Pay Customer). The threshold of the Standard wallet is 2,000,000 IQD daily and 10,000,000 IQD monthly. The wallet will be active for an unlimited period subject to the terms and conditions of AsiaPay. 
Premium Wallet is a type of wallet that has been designed for employers, merchants, main dealers, high earners, and VIPs. The threshold is defined by the AsiaPay on a case-by-case basis in accordance with Central Bank of Iraq instructions. This wallet can be obtained by visiting AsiaPay’s main dealers only.

Lite wallet holders must transfer the wallet to Standard wallet after three months because the wallet will be suspended. 
Standard Wallet can be obtained by visiting one of the AsiaPay agents throughout Iraq after the completion of registration procedures (Know Your Pay Customer). The threshold of the Standard wallet is 2,000,000 IQD daily and 10,000,000 IQD monthly. The wallet will be active for an unlimited period subject to the terms and conditions of AsiaPay. 

Premium Wallet is a type of wallet that has been designed for employers, merchants, main dealers, high earners, and VIPs. The threshold is defined by the AsiaPay on a case-by-case basis in accordance with Central Bank of Iraq instructions. This wallet can be obtained by visiting AsiaPay’s main dealers only.

Let's stop off at the Supermarket with Mommy to pick up some delicious treats! Shop for cakes, cookies, milk, and even pick up some toys!
Head home and straight into a warm, bubbly bath! Play with bath toys, scrub with bubbles, and finish off with a good rinse!
It's been a long day and it's time for bed! Play a magical lullaby song and watch your Baby Panda & Unicorn drift off to sleep for night night!

bluejetty:00168538:ios.description:
Step into the world of "Slap & Punch," a super engaging game that mixes the simplicity of clicking actions with the excitement of boxing and slap-fighting competitions. As you start, you’re in a virtual gym, getting ready for some serious slap and boxing action. Here, you’ll be lifting weights and doing all sorts of exercises to build your strength, speed, and stamina, all crucial for the challenges ahead in the boxing ring and slap fights.
How to Play
The game is straightforward: all you need to do is click or tap. Your main goal at the beginning is to train by hitting a punching bag and lifting weights as much as possible. This helps you become stronger and prepares you for the exciting part of the game - the slap and boxing matches. These matches are where the real fun begins. You'll be put up against different opponents, each match a chance to test your skills and strength. Winning these matches will help you move up to more challenging levels, where even tougher opponents await.
Features
Easy clicking and tapping to play.
Train in a gym to get strong for fights.
Fight in exciting slap and boxing matches.
Move up through harder levels as you get better.
Try to be the best among all players.
"Slap & Punch" is designed for both casual gamers looking for some quick fun and those who enjoy a bit of competition. Whether you’re a fan of sports games, fighting games, or just in search of a good time, this game offers a mix of action, strategy, and excitement. It’s all about how well you train, fight, and conquer the challenges that come your way. Are you ready to tap, fight, and emerge victorious in this thrilling world of slap and boxing matches?

bluejetty:00157631:ios.description:
Welcome to the wondrous adventure world of "Golden Stones"!
The gears of fate turn once more in Cairo, Egypt, in 1989. After the noble sacrifices of your companions, you will inherit the Golden Spirit, uncover the truth hidden in the shadows, and explore unknown secrets. Relive the passion and fantasy of the classic universe, and embark on an epic journey to change the world's ending!
Log in now and get 10,000 draws at the start! Experience this meticulously crafted new casual card RPG mobile game with "Pixel Art × Idle Strategy" now!
[Game Features]
Retro Pixel Art, Gorgeous Stand Awakening
Hundreds of classic mythological heroes reimagined in pixel art! Combined with exquisite and stunning visual effects, each character has exclusive storylines and unique ultimate Stand skill forms, bringing you a refreshing pixel art aesthetic experience!
Immersive Narrative, Relive Classic Battles
The main story levels perfectly integrate the original manga narrative, taking you through classic battles in the rifts of time and space. Uncover the ultimate secrets of the Heaven Domain and rewrite the fate of the world with your exclusive lineup!
Idle Strategy, Diverse Tarot Lineups
An easy progression system combined with deep strategic gameplay! Heroes have rich attribute counters, and with 33 unique emblems and Tarot card skills, you can freely mix and match to create the world's strongest Stand team!
Zen Mode, High Welfare
No burnout, easy AFK! Diamonds, gold coins, massive EXP, and mythical gear can be automatically claimed offline. Built-in limited-time mini-games, multi-line simultaneous combat, even free-to-play players can easily collect everything!
Global Competition, Strive for Supreme Glory
Cross-server guild wars, World BOSS raids, global ranking matches, Heaven Domain trials... Multiple competitive modes are in full swing! Compete with players and guilds worldwide, showcase your top strategy and strength, and ascend to the throne at the top of the rankings!

bluejetty:00078913:ios.description:
Recommended by CNN and Lonely Planet, this is Bangkok's best subway map! Up-to-date with all the BTS and MRT metro lines; Works offline; Routeplanner, GPS, Street maps; English and Thai included.
Download the app completely free! The free app is ad-supported. Upgrade to VIP features if you'd like to get extra features, remove ads and support future development!
WHY EXPLOREMETRO?
1. Fully up-to-date
Accurate metro map, includes every station on every line. Free updates for future station openings and timetable changes.
2. Designed for iPhone X, XR, XS
Our gorgeous maps have been fully redesigned for the iPhone X. Runs on all iOS9-13 devices.
3. Designed for iPad 
Specially redesigned interface for the larger iPad screen with split screen. Drag and drop station names, tips, maps and timetables into other apps.
4. Street maps for every station 
Need to get your bearings at a station? Integrated Street maps show you metro exits and nearby streets for every station.
5. Route-planner 
A really easy route-planner. Get route and time information for any journey with just three taps.
6. "Find my nearest station" 
Using your GPS, see a list of the closest metro stations to your current location.
7. Works offline 
Everything works without an Internet connection. Search stations and plan routes on the go.
UPGRADE TO VIP FOR EVEN MORE FEATURES
I've been developing this app for 10 years. Upgrading to VIP helps support future development of the app. VIP users get additional features, like NO ADS, accurate prices for every journey, first/last train times, offline street maps, tips at every station, and a general warm fuzzy feeling.
REVIEWS
CNN Travel: "These maps are very easy on the eye and simple to navigate. They work offline and also include free updates of stations that have yet to be completed, operating hours and schedules." 
Lonely Planet: "Easy to use, up to date and work offline. Very handy, especially when they've run out of paper maps at the stations."
SUGGESTIONS
We'd love to hear your comments and suggestions on ways to improve the app. Please contact us via support@exploremetro.com, as we can't respond to comments left in the reviews.

bluejetty:00035793:ios.description:
OFFICIAL iOS MOBILE APP by Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited (IRCTC)
IRCTC Official Website: https://www.irctc.co.in/nget
IRCTC Rail Connect Mobile App is Now Available on App Store!!!
Book train tickets conveniently with the upgraded app. Search trains, check seat availability, manage bookings and make secure payments — anytime, anywhere in India.
New Features:
• Simplified Biometric enablement from login page for quicker and secure login
• All class availability displayed in a single view for easier booking decisions
• Improved experience for IRCTC Loyalty Credit Card users
• Unified payment options for a seamless checkout experience
• Improved and simplified in-app alerts
Key Features:
• Secure login with PIN and Biometric Authentication
• Quick train search, route details, and seat availability
• Check train and seat availability without login
• PNR status enquiry for booked tickets
• Support for General, Tatkal, Premium Tatkal, Ladies, Divyangjan and Senior Citizen quotas
• Current Reservation booking facility
• Easy passenger management with Master Passenger List
• Integrated IRCTC eWallet for faster payments
• Multiple payment options including UPI, Net Banking, Credit/Debit Cards, EMI, Book Now Pay Later(BNPL) and Wallets
• Boarding point change facility
• Book, view, cancel or file TDR for tickets booked via website or app
• Aadhaar linking facility to extend monthly ticket booking limits
• Online Reservation Chart availability
• Accessibility support and OTP-based booking flow (instead of CAPTCHA) for visually impaired users
• Earn rewards through the IRCTC Loyalty Program with benefits including up to 10% cashback on eligible services
Why Use IRCTC Rail Connect?
+ Official Indian Railways train ticket booking app
+ Safe, secure, and reliable transactions
+ Simple and user-friendly experience
+ Manage your journeys anytime, anywhere
Feedback & Support
We value your feedback. Share your suggestions and help us improve your booking experience.
Enjoy a smarter, faster and more convenient way to book train tickets with IRCTC Rail Connect.
Registered Office / Corporate Office
Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd.
4th Floor, Tower-D, World Trade Center, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi – 110029

bluejetty:00041138:ios.description:
Unlock your potential with our comprehensive CPHQ (Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality) Test Prep & Practice 2026, designed specifically for healthcare professionals aiming to pass the CPHQ exam. This resource provides the tools and knowledge necessary to excel in your certification journey.
Key Features: 
Expertly Crafted Questions: 
Dive into a vast pool of practice questions meticulously designed to mirror the structure and content of the CPHQ exam. Our extensive question bank covers a diverse range of topics, ensuring a thorough understanding of the material. 
Realistic Simulations: 
Immerse yourself in the exam environment with our realistic simulations. Practice under timed conditions to refine your time management skills and build the confidence needed to excel on the real exam day. 
Detailed Explanations: 
Every question is accompanied by detailed explanations, offering valuable insights into correct and incorrect answers. This feature not only aids in understanding the reasoning behind each answer but also reinforces core concepts crucial for the exam. 
Focused Study Plans: 
Tailor your preparation to your unique needs with our flexible study plans. Whether you prefer targeted reviews of specific topics or full-length exam simulations, our app adapts to your study preferences, ensuring an efficient and personalized learning experience. 
Track Your Progress: 
Stay informed about your performance through comprehensive analytics. Monitor your progress over time, identify areas that require additional attention, and track your improvement as you move closer to the exam day. 
Stay Updated: 
We recognize the importance of staying current with the latest exam developments. Our app is regularly updated to align with any changes in the CPHQ exam, ensuring that you always have the most relevant study material at your fingertips. 
In-Depth Content Coverage: 
Our app covers a wide range of topics essential for the CPHQ exam. Each topic is thoroughly explored to provide a comprehensive understanding of the subject matter. 
Interactive Learning Tools: 
Engage with interactive learning tools that enhance your understanding of key concepts. Visual aids, mnemonics, and interactive scenarios are incorporated to make learning both effective and enjoyable.

bluejetty:00045830:ios.description:
Build your own soda empire and become the ultimate soda tycoon!
Welcome to Soda Inc – a fresh and exciting idle simulation game where you start by managing a small bottling plant and work your way up to expand and dominate the soft drink industry. Your goal: to build the world’s largest soda empire!
Manage Your Ingredients
To craft the perfect soda, hire specialists to develop new flavors and source premium ingredients! Expand your operations by acquiring more land and growing your supply network. Train your workers to improve efficiency in creating and bottling delicious drinks.
Upgrade Bottling Lines
Purchase and upgrade high-tech bottling machines to boost production speed and unlock new soda varieties. Explore and discover advanced machinery as your factory grows!
Maintain and Enhance Your Fleet
Delivery trucks and forklifts are essential to keeping your soda flowing from storage to market. Upgrade and maintain your fleet to ensure smooth and uninterrupted operations.
Handle Sales and Marketing
Run clever marketing campaigns to attract thirsty customers, fulfill orders quickly, and maximize your profits.
Unlock Upgrades
Earn rewards with every successful order and invest them in permanent upgrades to boost your factory’s income and production.
Expand Your Empire
Buy new factories in different locations to skyrocket your income and establish yourself as the top soda producer!
Jump in and start building your soda empire today!

→ You can scan documents to your vault.
→ You can send files or photos to your vault.

bluejetty:00014672:ios.description:
With the Cornerstone Saba mobile app, Intelligent Talent Management is available anytime, anywhere. Mobility provides flexibility so employees and managers can learn, collaborate, and coach at their convenience, elevating productivity and engagement. Instant access to information, experts, and approvals is often the key to success.
Key features include:
o Search and Register for Learning: Browse the learning catalog and register for self-paced, instructor-led, virtual, or blended learning.
o Access Diverse Content: Access content in standard-compliant (SCORM, AICC, Tin Can) or non-standard-compliant (MS Word, PDF, video, etc.) formats.
o Online and Offline Learning: Launch content online or download it for offline consumption.
o Evaluate and Assess: Complete evaluations, checklists, tests, and surveys.
o Performance Management: Manage goals and complete performance reviews.
o Schedule and Participate in Meetings: Organize and join meetings seamlessly.
o Seamless Synchronization: Enjoy instant progress synchronization between the mobile app and the LMS, allowing you to switch back and forth between devices effortlessly.
Download Cornerstone Saba App now and transform the way you learn and collaborate!

bluejetty:00178908:ios.description:
Storage Cleaner – Remove Photos, Videos & Contacts
Running out of storage on your iPhone? Duplicate Cleaner helps you find and remove duplicate and similar photos, videos, and contacts while giving you tools to organize, protect, and optimize your device.
Free up storage, compress large media files, edit photo and video metadata, protect private media with Secret Vault, and monitor device health.
CLEAN UP DUPLICATE PHOTOS & VIDEOS
Quickly scan your photo and video library to find unwanted duplicates and similar media.
• Find duplicate photos and videos
• Detect similar photos and screenshots
• Review files before deleting
• Remove unwanted media safely
• Free up valuable storage space
Clean up repeated screenshots, burst photos, similar images, and duplicate videos without manually searching through your entire library.
EDIT PHOTO & VIDEO METADATA
Update important information stored with your photos and videos.
 • Edit date and time
 • Change location information
 • Modify other available media metadata
 • Update photo and video details in one place
Keep your media information accurate and organized.
CREATE & ORGANIZE PHOTO ALBUMS
Keep your photos organized with custom albums.
• Create custom photo albums
• Add selected photos to your albums
• Keep your photo library organized
SECRET VAULT FOR PRIVATE PHOTOS & VIDEOS
Keep your personal photos and videos private with Secret Vault.
• Hide private photos and videos
• Protect your vault with PIN and Face ID
• Import and organize private media
CLEAN & MANAGE DUPLICATE CONTACTS
Take control of a cluttered contact list with a powerful contact management tool.
• Find duplicate contacts
• Merge contacts with matching names, phone numbers, or emails
• Delete multiple contacts in bulk
• Filter contacts by matching details
• Update and manage contact information
• Organize contacts more efficiently
Keep your address book clean and reduce unnecessary duplicate entries.
BACKUP & RESTORE CONTACTS
Protect your contacts and make them easier to recover when needed.
• Back up contacts to local storage
• Export contacts as CSV or to your iPhone
• Restore contacts anytime
• Schedule regular backups
• Recover contacts after device migration or reset
COMPRESS PHOTOS & VIDEOS
Reduce media file sizes and make more room on your iPhone.
• Compress photos and videos
• Optimize storage usage
• Reduce file sizes for easier sharing
Store more memories while maintaining a good balance between file size and quality.
DEVICE STATUS & PERFORMANCE
Get a quick overview of your iPhone's status and performance.
• Device information
• Battery status and charging details
• Storage and memory usage
• Network information
• Performance insights
SYSTEM DIAGNOSTICS
Check your iPhone’s key hardware and system functions with built-in diagnostic tests. If you’re buying a refurbished or second-hand iPhone, use System Diagnostics to check important features before making your purchase.
• Touch & Display

• Camera & Flash

• Simple and user-friendly interface
• Fast scanning and smart detection
• Powerful storage cleanup tools
• Secure Secret Vault with PIN and Face ID
• Convenient contact management
• Safe cleanup with review before deletion
• Useful device monitoring tools

bluejetty:00152074:ios.description:
Kẻ Thao Túng Tam Quốc mới là người có được tất cả! 
Đây là câu chuyện về bậc quân sư ẩn mình sau màn, điều khiển thiên hạ bằng trí tuệ và chiến lược.
-----
Bạn sẽ nhập vai Chúa Công trong Tam Quốc Chí, chiêu mộ danh tướng, xây dựng đội hình và viết lại lịch sử trong một game Tam Quốc kết hợp giữa game thẻ bài và game chiến thuật. 
-----
ĐẶC SẮC NỔI BẬT
-----
1. Đồ họa 3D chuẩn điện ảnh: Công nghệ Unity tiên tiến, hiệu ứng kỹ năng bùng nổ, bản đồ hùng tráng.
2. 100+ danh tướng Tam Quốc: Quan Vũ, Lữ Bố, Gia Cát Lượng… Hệ 5 binh chủng khắc chế, hợp thể – đổi tướng chỉ với một chạm.
3. Game Tam Quốc tốc chiến: Xây thành nhanh, treo máy vẫn mạnh, PvP 4vs4 công bằng – thắng bại dựa vào chiến lược.
4. Công thành xưng đế: GVG bang chiến theo mùa, địa hình & thời tiết ảnh hưởng trận đấu, liên minh – phản bội tùy mưu lược thao túng.
5. Hậu cung 3D sống động: Tương tác mỹ nhân, nuôi dưỡng môn đồ phục vụ đại nghiệp.
6. Phúc lợi khởi đầu: Free tướng SSR Điêu Thuyền, Tôn Thượng Hương, 1000 lượt chiêu mộ liên tiếp và quà giá trị.
-----
TẠI SAO BẠN KHÔNG THỂ BỎ LỠ?
– Game chiến thuật Tam Quốc – kết hợp hoàn hảo giữa thẻ bài và SLG.
– Đấu trí căng não thành Bá Vương Tam Quốc với hàng ngàn người chơi.
– Thách thức trí tuệ, chứng minh bản lĩnh trong Tam Quốc Chí Chiến Lược.
– Chỉ kẻ Thao Túng Tam Quốc mới có thể xưng đế và thống trị thiên hạ.
-----
Hãy Thao Túng Tam Quốc ngay và bắt đầu hành trình xưng bá thiên hạ!
Quyết định phát hành trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số 277/QĐ-PTTH&TTĐT ngày 26/5/2026
Link giấy phép: https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/132099
