The world of Phantasia is filled with mystery and wonder but has been eroded away by the Dreamless, shadowy entities that seek to corrupt all living things and con
bluejetty:00020168:android.description:
Awaken to a new beginning in a world of dreams and fairy tales. [Grimlight]
The world of Phantasia is filled with mystery and wonder but has been eroded away by the Dreamless, shadowy entities that seek to corrupt all living things and consume the world into the endless void.
Even the Dominion lords who once defended the realms were corrupted and soon lost their reason and sanity. They are now mere shells of their former selves engulfed in madness and destruction.
Only you, the Dreamer, can banish the darkness by calling upon heroes of legend through fragments of their past memories and embark on a tale to save the world from endless ruin…
■A Story of Dreams and Fairy Tales■
Call upon heroes from classic stories, grimm fairy tales, and folklore such as Alice, Cinderella, Red Riding Hood, Snow White, and more!
With the power of the Dreamstone, summon your allies and save the world of Phantasia from the mysterious and deadly Dreamless.
■Anime-Style Illustrations■
Unlock characters with gorgeous art from top anime-style illustrators.
Listen to their voices and unlock their stories!
■Weapons and Tactics■
Plan your unique battle strategy with countless combinations of weapons, items, and Heroes. Acquire various weapons and items to customize and strengthen your heroes to make them even more powerful to attack and defend against the Dreamless onslaught for RPG survival.
■Simple and Easy Controls■
Deploy your heroes on the battlefield, and you're ready to start! Strategic combat with simple drag-and-drop controls. The right strategy and tactics can make the difference between victory and defeat. 
Play your cards well and change the fate of Phantasia by mastering your mysterious power.
■Official Links■
Official Website: https://grimlight.global/
Official Twitter Account: https://twitter.com/GrimlightEN

- find a lion or even biscuits, 
- escape prisoner or choose father for a baby, 
- repair a tape or draw the tower of Pisa,
- convert «lose» to «love» or feed ufo-cat.
► Why Brainwash is worth paying attention to?
Top-5 key reasons: 
1. There is nothing in common with old school puzzle games.

3. It saves your time – one level takes about 1 min.
4. User-friendly interface: easy to get the idea.

• Press the button and be ready for some action!

Ready, set, wash your brain!

bluejetty:00071105:ios.summary:
From the studio that brought you My Talking Gummy Bear game comes a new talking videogame for kids, My Talking Hello Kitty!
Check out this cool game, where the famous character Hello Kitty invites you into her house and plays games with you
bluejetty:00071105:ios.description:
From the studio that brought you My Talking Gummy Bear game comes a new talking videogame for kids, My Talking Hello Kitty!
Check out this cool game, where the famous character Hello Kitty invites you into her house and plays games with you!
Talking Hello Kitty is your new best friend: Have tons of fun with this Lovely girl and get amazing casual games for everyone! She hears you speak and talks to you, all in your family will enjoy magical surprises in this talking game! Designed for everyone to play in family and with friends. 
Embark on a delightful culinary journey with the new cooking and baking game feature introduced in Talking Hello Kitty! Dive into a world of sweet treats and savory delights designed to engage and entertain players of all ages. This update adds a wide array of cooking and baking activities, including pastry-making, cake decorating, and more, offering a fun and immersive experience centered around food and creativity.
PLAY ON THIS AMAZING OFFLINE CASUAL GAME!
PLAYING AND TALKING: you can Help Hello Kitty bake when she’s hungry, help her wash the dishes, take her to sleep when she’s tired, play in the garden with her or plant some flowers! You can watch them grow all while talking to the famous Hello Kitty!
MINI GAMES: Play mini games with talking Hello kitty, including playing with a ball, tending your flowers, washing dishes and Talking Hello Kitty ‘s Favorite mini game, baking!
EXPLORING talking Hello Kitty ‘s house: Hello kitty can go from one room to the next discovering exciting games and new activities. Players can Help Talking Hello Kitty and have amazing fun and talk with her. 
SURPRISE BOX: Talking Hello Kitty has a surprise box, and there are several surprise toys to discover and play games! Each one is unique and amazing. Discover with her what amazing toy you will get each time in this great talking game for all.
DECORATE HER HOUSE: You can also decorate Hello Kitty ‘s house in this casual game, you can have lots of fun decorating, changing wallpaper, rugs, lamps, and some of Hello Kitty ‘s belongings!
DRESS HER UP: Another great thing about this great simulation game is that you can play dress up with talking Hello Kitty, make her pretty and change her looks while having fun!
FEATURES INCLUDE:
• TAP and talk to hear Hello Kitty’s voice!
• PLAY with her surprise chest and find out which amazing toy you will get!
• TAKE a photo with Hello Kitty and SHARE WITH YOUR FRIENDS!
• ENJOY casual mini-games with your favorite virtual freind.
• FUN with Hello Kitty in her house doing what she loves. 
• DRESS her up and choose her clothes.
• PLAY any game with her and discover all the fun surprises!

bluejetty:00185066:ios.description:
Best of Mac App Store 2016 game now on iOS!
"The funniest mobile game of 2017 if not all time." - gamezebo.com
Pirate heroine Nelly Cootalot takes on the evil Baron Widebeard in this hilarious adventure game. 
Meet an outlandish cast of characters featuring the voice of Tom Baker (Dr Who), and face perplexing challenges in your search for the Treasure of the Seventh Sea.
• "Overflowing with charm and heart" - Adventure Gamers
• "The puzzles are as perfect as possible" - Just Adventure
• "Incredibly funny" - Gamewatcher
ABOUT THE GAME
Join Nelly and explore a hand-drawn world created by award-winning comedian Alasdair Beckett-King. This is your opportunity to:
• Race aristocrats for fun and profit.
• Commandeer an ancient airship.
• Enter the mind of a monkey wizard.
• Borrow moonshine from a surly Viking.
• Wantonly misuse the word ‘borrow’.
What is Baron Widebeard planning? Can he be stopped? How is a fleet of hypnotised wildfowl involved?
To answer these questions comes Nelly Cootalot: pirate heroine and defender of endangered and adorable creatures. Nelly’s journey will take her from Port Rubicund in the South Seas to the lonely isle of Gloomholm in the icy north. Help Nelly solve puzzles and defeat the most formidable husband and wife team in the bird-kidnapping industry.
FEATURES
• Full voice-acting in English & German.
• A script that will amuse and delight whether you are 9, 19 or 90. (But ONLY those ages.)
• Art & animation in glorious high-definition.
• Puzzles that will tax the world's greatest minds, if they're having an off-day.
• Over 45 unique characters & 35 locations.
• Quaint British spellings = extra letters for free.
MINIMUM SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS
iPad 3, iPhone 5, iPad mini 2, iPod touch 6 or better
MORE PRESS CLIPPINGS
"It’s funny, daft, and the look is incessantly fantastic" - Rock, Paper, Shotgun
"Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet is one of the funniest games I have played in recent years." (5/5) - Kickstartventures
"Beautiful art, an engaging story, some fun gameplay and snappy dialogue, Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet is a nice little gem." (9.1/10) - Geeknifty
"If you are a fan of the genre, then The Fowl Fleet should definitely be on your wishlist." (8.3) - Gameramble
"Outstanding puzzle design" (87% ) - adventurecorner
"Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet is a brilliant adventure that wonderfully demonstrates quirky British humor and is totally unique." (4.5/5 - Amazing) - The Nerd Stash
"An amazing adventure game. Its story has surprising depth, the characters are lovable, the puzzles are great fun and it wraps it all up in a layer of fantastic humour!" (4.5/5 - AMAZING! ) - The Mental Attic
"Lovingly crafted and amounts to a very relaxing and enjoyable point ‘n click experience." (7: very good) - Techraptor
"A delightful point-and-click romp of swashing and buckling. In short, it’ll straight up charm your knickers off." (Buy it!) - vgblogger
"Tom Baker is in it, which is important." - PC Gamer

bluejetty:00071151:ios.description:
Practice reading EKGs in lead II
Basic EKG interpretation is more accurately described as an intermediate-level skill that takes time, practice and refreshing. Whether you are a doctor, nurse, EMT or tech your ability to read and pick up on basic EKG changes in real time is essential. Practice with an app that actually looks like what you see at work.
Use the app’s ‘Study Mode’ to choose one or multiple rhythms to view and compare. A brief description of each rhythm is provided, you can also pause and restart rhythms. Delete and add specific rhythms as desired. Rates, amplitudes and widths of the rhythms are dynamically set which provides for a more realistic simulation and variation within each type of rhythm. 
Use the app’s ‘Game Mode’ to challenge yourself to identify rhythms presented randomly in lead II. If desired, you can also choose which rhythms to include in the game.
Access to the complete set of rhythms and topics requires a subscription via in-app purchase.
Please Read: The purpose of this app is not to teach basic EKG interpretation but rather to practice basic EKG interpretation. If you don’t know basic EKG interpretation seek out additional resources such as classes, books, online materials and mentors to learn more and further your understanding.
Note: The cardiac rhythms presented by the app are simulated approximations. There is NO guarantee to the accuracy of rhythms presented. While accuracy is not guaranteed it is a goal. Please report errors, suggestions or general feedback to: feedback@arrhythmiaApp.com.
Arrhythmia uses the standard Apple Terms of Use End User License Agreement (EULA): http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

Basic EKG interpretation is more accurately described as an intermediate-level skill that takes time, practice and refreshing. Whether you are a doctor, nurse, EMT or tech your ability to read and pick up on basic EKG changes in real time is essential. Practice with an app that actually looks like what you see at work.

Use the app’s ‘Study Mode’ to choose one or multiple rhythms to view and compare. A brief description of each rhythm is provided, you can also pause and restart rhythms. Delete and add specific rhythms as desired. Rates, amplitudes and widths of the rhythms are dynamically set which provides for a more realistic simulation and variation within each type of rhythm. 

Use the app’s ‘Game Mode’  to challenge yourself to identify rhythms presented randomly in lead II. If desired, you can also choose which rhythms to include in the game.

Access to the complete set of rhythms and topics requires a subscription via in-app purchase.

Please Read: The purpose of this app is not to teach basic EKG interpretation but rather to practice basic EKG interpretation. If you don’t know basic EKG interpretation seek out additional resources such as classes, books, online materials and mentors to learn more and further your understanding.

Note: The cardiac rhythms presented by the app are simulated approximations. There is NO guarantee to the accuracy of rhythms presented. While accuracy is not guaranteed it is a goal. Please report errors, suggestions or general feedback to: feedback@arrhythmiaApp.com.

bluejetty:00027078:ios.name: Beastcam - Pro Camera
bluejetty:00027078:ios.summary:
Beastcam makes it easier than ever to capture the best possible photos and videos on your iPhone. It’s fast and easy-to-use, but powerful and customizable as a professional camera when you need it. 
We believe Beastcam is the most intuitive
bluejetty:00027078:ios.description:
Beastcam makes it easier than ever to capture the best possible photos and videos on your iPhone. It’s fast and easy-to-use, but powerful and customizable as a professional camera when you need it. 
We believe Beastcam is the most intuitive and advanced camera app ever created for capturing life’s special moments, expanding the capabilities of your iPhone camera to its fullest potential, and taking your #iPhoneography to the next level!
*Complete control
Easily set, fine-tune, and lock the most important settings you need in seconds, such as focus, exposure, zoom, white balance, and more using Beastcam’s intuitive design, quick-access buttons, precise value sliders, focus, and exposure reticles. All are available with a single tap on the home screen.
*Hardware support
Enhance your creativity with built-in support for DOF adapters, 1.33X & 1.55X anamorphic lenses in both photo and video mode. Improve your sound quality with external microphones and dial in the perfect settings for your environment, such as gain, audio format, sample rates.
*Advanced presets
Speed up and organize your workflow with shareable presets for every available setting.
Save time setting up your camera with unlimited customizable presets for all available settings that can be applied at any time. Perfect for multi-phone setups, DOF Adapters, 1.33X & 1.55X anamorphic lenses, and other commonly used settings like frame rate, resolution, etc.
*File management
Save time finding your files by creating projects and scenes that auto-generate readable file names based on the project name, scene name and take # and prioritize your best footage (or delete your worst) with a single tap as soon as you’ve finished recording, or later in the built-in gallery. Conveniently manage and share all of your organized photos and videos with the built-in gallery.
-SSD recording support on iPhone 15 and 16 Pro Series
# Features
- Set and lock focus and exposure with reticles
- Precisely adjust white balance, focus, zoom, and exposure settings right from the home screen
- Analyze your shots accurately: focus peaking, false colors, zebras, and histogram
- Take steadier shots with standard or cinematic image stabilization
- De-squeeze footage to 2.39:1 for 1.33X anamorphic lenses and 2.76:1 for 1.55X anamorphic lenses
- Rotate orientation for DOF lens adapters
- quick zoom, perfect for manual focus
- Switch between any of your iPhone cameras
- Monitor audio levels, microphone type, format, and sample rate right on the home screen
- Compose your shots with 1:1, 2.39:1, and 2.76:1 aspect ratio guides and grids
- Show/hide all of the menus from your home screen
- Built-in flash/torch control
- Create projects and scenes that auto-generate easy-to-read folder and file names based on the project name, scene name, take #
- Prioritize your best footage (or delete your worst) with a single tap as soon as you’ve finished recording or later in the gallery
- View, rename, move, share, or delete files with the built-in gallery
- Custom local presets for white balance, zoom, and focus
- Create shareable global presets for all available settings (video mode only)
- Custom settings/rules for a fresh start
- Easily adjust exposure, focus, zoom with gesture controls
# Video
- 4K 3840x2160, QHD 2560x1440, FHD 1920x1080 or HD 1280x720 resolutions
- 24, 25, 30, 48, 50, 60, 120, or 240 FPS options
- Bit rates: Low, Standard, High, Beast (up to 160 Mbit/s)
- 10-bit Dolby Vision HDR 
- 10-bit SDR
- ProRes (+Apple Log on iPhone 15, 16, and 17 Pro Series)
Note: Some resolution and FPS options are not available on older iPhone models. The bit rate may vary depending on the resolution, FPS, and scene of your video
# Audio
- ACC, PCM, AIFF audio formats
- 44.1kHz and 48kHz audio sample rates (device-dependent)
- Supports built-in and external microphones
- Control gain for external microphones
#Photo
- JPEG, HEIF, RAW, file formats
- 1:1 , 4:3, 3:2, and 16:9 aspect ratios

bluejetty:00187513:ios.description:
BORROW, LEND AND GROW, ALL IN ONE APP.
Life doesn't wait for payday, and now should you. Lenme is where real people secure instant $200 cash advances, fast personal loans reaching up to $5,000, and a smarter way to grow their investments, all in one platform.
NEED EXTRA CASH RIGHT NOW?
Secure an instant $200 advance in those low-balance moments. No credit check. No paperwork. No judgment. Just extra cash when you need it.
WANT TO BORROW MORE?
Request up to $5,000 and watch thousands of real lenders competing to fund your loan request in minutes. You choose the amount, the repayment period, and the offer that actually fits your life. Rates start at 3% APR only.
HATE SURPRISE FEES?
So do we. No tips, no hidden charges and no money traps. Turn on Balance Guard and Lenme quietly secures a cash advance to keep your account in the green safe zone. Forget about overdraft fees with our newest automated feature.
DAILY DEALS AND BIG SAVINGS INSIDE
Enjoy access to money-saving tools like Credit Score boosters, Insurance plans, and Side Hustle programs—all in our Marketplace.
TURN YOUR FREE TIME INTO EXTRA CASH
Ever wish your downtime paid you back? With Lenme's new gaming feature, you can. Play exciting games, complete milestones and level up, and earn up to $50 a day in extra rewards. When you're ready, cash out your earnings straight to your bank account in just a few simple taps. Actual earnings vary based on gameplay and completed milestones.
DO OWN CRYPTO? WE HAVE A SPECIAL LOAN FOR YOU!
By connecting your crypto wallet, you unlock exclusive access to Personal Loans up to $10,000—a new kind of borrowing backed by your assets. Download Lenme now and experience the smarter, faster way to access Cash Advances or Personal Loans you deserve—no matter where life takes you.
Lenme isn’t just for borrowers. It’s also the perfect gateway to Passive Income and Financial Freedom.
WANT YOUR MONEY TO WORK BACK?
Here's the part nobody else offers: flip the script and become a lender. Put your money to work and earn higher returns while others get funded.
Lenme is a lending platform that connects people looking to borrow money with financial institutions, lending businesses, and individual investors looking to invest in the loan market. Users remain completely anonymous throughout the entire borrowing/lending process. For transparency and to encourage a fair and competitive market, the “feed” tab within the app allows users to see which loans are being funded and at what interest rate.
Lenme offers monthly and annual subscription plans available via In-App Purchases. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
Crypto-backed loans, our new product allows investors to fund cash loans backed by cryptocurrency owned by the borrower. Cryptocurrencies are used as collateral and may be liquidated in case of default or sudden price drop of the held currency.
Since our app is not directly involved in the lending decision, we cannot guarantee the interest rate borrowers will be offered. All borrowers have the option to request a loan on our platform for up to a 12-month repayment period, paid in installments. Lenders can offer loans for a minimum of 3% APR based on the credit score and their own criteria. The lending decision is based on multiple factors viewable on our app, including credit, income, and cash flow analysis.
A representative example of the total cost of the loan, including all applicable fees: If you borrow $1,000 over a term of 1 year with an APR of 12% and an origination fee of 1%, you will pay $89.75 per month. The total amount payable will be $1,076.96, with a total interest and fees of $76.96.
For more information, see our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
https://lenme.com/privacy-policy/
https://lenme.com/term-of-use/

Panopto Mobile lets you access all of your organization’s video content from your iPhone or iPad. View HD video presentations, lectures, training courses and events. Search inside your videos to find any keyword or topic. And upload or record videos using your device's camera app.
Learn anywhere
• Watch a lecture, presentation, or training session from your iPhone or iPad
• Search within a video to jump right where you need to be
• Read closed captions as you watch the video
• Navigate videos by tapping on slides, chapters, or transcript
• Listen to videos while you are interacting with other apps or while your screen is off
Present and teach anywhere
• Record a presentation or lecture with the built-in camera
• Record meetings or classes in rooms equipped with Panopto Remote Recorder
With Panopto’s Video Platform, you can transform how your organization learns and communicates:
• Sales and Marketing can record and webcast presentations, demos, and events.
• Corporate Communications can deliver recorded or live messages from executives.
• Human Resources can deliver online training to employees around the world.
• Engineering teams can record meetings and share best practices.
• Support teams can record tutorials and visually demonstrate solutions to customers.
• Faculty can record lectures, lab demonstrations, medical simulations, and more.
• Students can view lectures on the go and take notes that get saved with the recording.
• Students can record their own videos and securely submit them for instructor review.
• IT staff can integrate Panopto with existing LMS, CMS and identity systems.
About Panopto
Panopto creates software that enables organizations to record, webcast, search, and share all of their video content and presentations. Panopto's video platform is currently in use at Fortune 500 companies around the world, and is the fastest growing lecture capture solution at leading universities.

bluejetty:00129204:ios.description:
Aplicația Calendar Ortodox te ajută să fii la curent cu sărbătorile, posturile și tradițiile Bisericii Ortodoxe Române. Simplu de folosit, rapid și mereu actualizat.
• Calendar complet – Descoperă sărbători ortodoxe, naționale și alte evenimente pentru anul în curs și anii următori.
• Radiouri ortodoxe – Ascultă programe radio cu tematică religioasă.
• Rugăciuni și articole duhovnicești – Accesează o colecție bogată de texte spirituale pentru întărirea credinței și liniștea sufletului.
• Biblia – Citește oriunde textul integral al Sfintei Scripturi.
• Sinaxar, Evanghelia și Apostolul zilei – Inspiră-te zilnic din cuvintele Sfintei Evanghelii.
• Notificări personalizate – Primește alerte la momentul potrivit.
• Planificare inteligentă – Află din timp care sunt zilele libere și perioadele de post pentru a-ți organiza concediile și activitățile.
RADIOURI FAVORITE
Rămâi conectat la credință prin posturile de radio ortodoxe disponibile în aplicație: ASCOR Cluj, Doxologia, Lumina, Ortodox Putna.
CALENDAR OFICIAL 2025
Respectăm întru totul deciziile Bisericii Ortodoxe Române (BOR) și Calendarul Creștin-Ortodox tipărit, aprobat de Sfântul Sinod al Patriarhiei Române.
Anul 2025 este Anul omagial al Centenarului Patriarhiei Române și Anul comemorativ al duhovnicilor și mărturisitorilor ortodocși români din secolul al XX-lea.
Aplicația Calendar Ortodox îți oferă o modalitate plăcută de a-ți organiza timpul, menținându-te informat despre sărbători, posturi și evenimente importante. Instalează aplicația și aprofundează tainele credinței ortodoxe. Înainte de a utiliza aplicația, te rugăm să verifici termenii și condițiile, https://bit.ly/calendar-ortodox-termeni-si-conditii
Doamne, ajută!

bluejetty:00169418:ios.summary: Start a blood chilling adventure in search and find objects games! Your brother Colin’s bad luck takes a disastrous turn when his wife Dakota goes mysteriously missing! Just when things seem like they can’t get any worse, he’s arrested for
bluejetty:00169418:ios.description:
Start a blood chilling adventure in search and find objects games! Your brother Colin’s bad luck takes a disastrous turn when his wife Dakota goes mysteriously missing! Just when things seem like they can’t get any worse, he’s arrested for her kidnapping! Now it’s up to you to find hidden items and evidence and learn the truth behind this mystery. This is no open and shut case, and you quickly find evidence of foul play. The question of the detective games is, who would want to frame your friend and why? It’s up to you to crack the case, go through a lot of free hidden object games and clear his name before it’s too late. Do you have what it takes? Find out in these riveting adventure games!
· ENJOY SURPRISING PLOT TWISTS IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
The Dark Hunter is threatening you and your family with deadly explosions - can you find the hidden objects and stop him in time?
· PLAY YOUR FAVORITE PUZZLES!
Play - and re-play! - more challenging HOPs and mini-games! Play hidden object adventure and solve this mysterious case of Dakota’s disappearance!
· LOTS OF BONUS MATERIALS!
Earn Achievements, outfit your Kitchen, play hidden object adventure games and collect all the photos and statuettes. Replay videos and download original concept art, wallpapers, and soundtracks!
· HELPFUL STRATEGY GUIDE!
Stuck while finding things and playing hidden objects games? Don't go it alone - take along the helpful Strategy Guide!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00070980:ios.developer: Bibi.Pet - Toddlers Games - Colors and Shapes
bluejetty:00070980:ios.summary:
A drum roll and the blare of trumpets… are you ready for the big news? The wait is over — all Bibi.Pet games are now available in a single app!
Welcome to BibiLand, a world of fun preschool and kindergarten learning games designed to help
bluejetty:00070980:ios.description:
A drum roll and the blare of trumpets… are you ready for the big news? The wait is over — all Bibi.Pet games are now available in a single app!
Welcome to BibiLand, a world of fun preschool and kindergarten learning games designed to help kids grow and explore. With over 200 educational games, this app offers everything your child needs to start learning numbers, letters, tracing, puzzles, colors, shapes, and logic — all through play!
From exploring jungles to running a restaurant, from meeting farm animals to swimming under the sea, Bibi.Pet invites kids on a magical journey packed with preschool and kindergarten-friendly educational activities.
What’s inside BibiLand:
- Cooking & Restaurant Games: Fun cooking games where kids become little chefs and master recipes.
- Farm Games: Manage a farm, care for animals, and play preschool alphabet and shape educational games.
- Jungle Games: Solve exciting puzzles and meet animals in an adventurous jungle setting.
- Numbers & Counting: Help toddlers and kids learn numbers, tracing, and counting.
- ABC & Phonics Educational Games: Easy and fun alphabet learning and pronunciation practice for kindergarten and preschool kids.
- Puzzle Games: Drag, drop, and complete colorful jigsaw puzzles designed for kindergarten and preschool minds.
- Color Games: Explore colors through tracing, matching, and play-based learning.
- Dinosaur Educational Games: Discover dinosaurs and have fun exploring the prehistoric world.
Key Features:
- Includes all Bibi.Pet games: over 200 educational activities!
- Early access to new preschool and kindergarten games
- Frequent updates with fresh learning content
- Designed for children aged 2–6: baby, toddler, preschool, and kindergarten
- No reading required: perfect for little kids
Subscription Details:
- Free to download with limited content
- 7-day free trial unlocks all educational games
- Cancel anytime without extra fees
Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
About Bibi.Pet:
At Bibi.Pet, we create games we’d want for our own kids — safe, ad-free, and packed with preschool and kindergarten learning fun. With a mix of colors, shapes, dress-up, dinosaur, and mini-games, our apps help children discover and grow at every stage.
Thank you to all the families who trust Bibi.Pet to support their child’s early learning journey!

bluejetty:00095503:ios.name: Playbacks: AI Note Taker
bluejetty:00095503:ios.summary:
Playbacks is your all-in-one AI powered note taking assistant.
NEW: Summarize anything, not just audio. Add PDFs, slides, articles, YouTube videos, and photos on their own or attach them to a recording, and Playbacks folds everything into
bluejetty:00095503:ios.description:
Playbacks is your all-in-one AI powered note taking assistant.
NEW: Summarize anything, not just audio. Add PDFs, slides, articles, YouTube videos, and photos on their own or attach them to a recording, and Playbacks folds everything into one summary you can chat with. Then turn any note into quizzes and flashcards, and challenge classmates and friends on the leaderboard.
Whether you're in a meeting, class, interview, or watching a video, Playbacks captures every word, transcribes it with stunning accuracy, and delivers clear, organized notes - so you can stay focused instead of scribbling.
With one tap, Playbacks records your conversation and automatically generates word-for-word transcripts, clean summaries, and lets you ask the AI questions like: "What were the key action points?" or "Who mentioned the deadline?"
No recording? No problem. Upload an MP3, a PDF, a slide deck, or a photo, or paste a YouTube or article link, and Playbacks will instantly generate a summary and insights you can chat with.
Talk to your recordings. Tap once and start a live voice conversation with any meeting or lecture - ask questions out loud, get answers out loud, in real time. Debrief a meeting on your walk home, or turn any lecture into a study session.
Playbacks is built with privacy in mind - your recordings are stored securely, and your data is never shared.
Playbacks transcribes and summarizes in dozens of languages, including English, Spanish, French, Arabic, Portuguese, Chinese, Hindi and many more. The app is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Dutch, Italian, and Japanese.
Playbacks is perfect for:
Combining a lecture with its slides and readings into one set of notes
Turning your notes into quizzes and flashcards before an exam
Talking through a meeting out loud instead of rereading it
Auto-generating meeting notes to share with your team
Turning lectures into searchable, beautiful transcripts
What you can do with Playbacks:
Sources & Uploads
Add PDFs, Word and PowerPoint files, text files, and photos - on their own or attached to any note
Add web articles, YouTube videos, MP3s, or a second recording
Scan book pages, handouts, and whiteboards with your camera
Update your summary to bring every source together
Ask the AI about anything in your sources
Quizzes & Flashcards
Generate quizzes and flashcards from any note or source
Share with classmates and friends, and compete on the leaderboard
Voice Conversations
Talk to any recording in a live voice conversation
Ask questions out loud and hear answers back
Review a lecture or debrief a meeting hands-free
Record & Transcribe
Record anything instantly with high quality audio
Get instant word level transcripts
Speaker identification with timestamps
Automatic recovery if a recording is interrupted
Smart AI Summaries
Pull out action items, decisions, or mentions
Edit any summary to add detail or make corrections
AI Chat
Chat directly with your transcript and sources
Ask follow-up questions anytime, with your chat history saved
Playback That Keeps Up
Transcripts highlight in real time as the audio plays
Tap any timestamp to jump straight to that moment
Polished Notes
Clean formatting with punctuation + line breaks
Find any word or phrase in your transcript and summary
Adjustable text size for comfortable reading
Organize with tags
Export and share notes in seconds, or send a web link
Who is Playbacks for?
Working professionals
Students and grad researchers
Interviewers and journalists
Educators and lecturers
Doctors, therapists, and patients
Church attendees and spiritual leaders
Content creators and podcasters
Remote teams, freelancers, consultants, and coaches
Test preppers and self-learners
Playbacks is the fastest way to go from raw audio and documents to organized notes you can actually talk to - and study from.
Terms Of Use: https://www.playbacks.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.playbacks.ai/privacy

bluejetty:00182946:ios.description:
Lurk through the dungeon, raise your level, find treasures, recruit monsters, forge your equipment, build your house, hire other players at guild, engage in faction war, player vs player in an alley, and defeat the boss...
Simple yet deep and nostalgic dungeon RPG for iOS.
- Features -
- Supports VoiceOver and text to speech
- Super indie, 99.9% made by one guy since the first iPhone was launched in 2010, and community supported ;)
- Player-supported, I update the game as I receive feedback
- Good old simple choose-your-adventure style dungeon RPG
- Multiplayer feature: Hire other players asynchronously to form a party to enter the dungeon
- Seasonal faction war you can participate with or without guild
- Evolve your character to learn new classes
- Collect monsters to fight with you as your minions
- Build your own house and level them up
- Forge your weapons and armors to make it stronger
- Optimized user experience for one-handed use touch interface
- Awesome reviews on replay-value
- 100% support from the actual creator, I don't have any other people updating my app, except I now have Discord server
- Story -
Small island called Eunaba locates in south of the Hornmare continent. On that island, a princess was kidnapped by an unknown evil. You as a player must become a mercenary and head to the dungeon to save the princess...
- Gameplay & Opening Movie -
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s5HKjT_rafI

bluejetty:00083712:ios.summary: "Triple Match" - "Find Hidden Objects" is a thrilling puzzle game that will test your skills and keep you entertained for hours on end. With its stunning 3D graphics and challenging gameplay, this game is a must-have for puzzle game fans ev
bluejetty:00083712:ios.description:
"Triple Match" - "Find Hidden Objects" is a thrilling puzzle game that will test your skills and keep you entertained for hours on end. With its stunning 3D graphics and challenging gameplay, this game is a must-have for puzzle game fans everywhere. In this game, you'll need to match three or more objects of the same type to clear them from the board and score points.
With over 10,000 levels to play, "Triple Match" - "Find Hidden Objects" offers endless hours of fun and excitement. Each level presents a new challenge, with different objectives and obstacles to overcome. You'll need to use your wits and strategy to succeed in this game, as each level becomes more difficult than the last.
The game's 3D graphics are simply stunning, with vibrant colors and realistic textures that bring the game to life. The objects on the board are intricately designed, making it easy to identify them and create matches. The animations are smooth and fluid, adding to the overall visual appeal of the game.
In addition to its stunning graphics, "Triple Match" - "Find Hidden Objects" also features a captivating soundtrack that will keep you engaged and motivated throughout the game. The music and sound effects are perfectly suited to the game, enhancing the overall gameplay experience.
One of the most unique features of this game is its power-ups. As you progress through the levels, you'll unlock different power-ups that will help you clear the board and score more points. These power-ups include bombs, lightning bolts, and other special items that can be used strategically to clear the board and advance to the next level.
Another great feature of "Triple Match" - "Find Hidden Objects" is its leaderboards. You can compete with players from around the world to see who can score the highest on each level. This adds an extra level of excitement to the game, as you strive to climb the ranks and become the top player.
Overall, "Triple Match" - "Find Hidden Objects" is a must-play game for anyone who loves puzzle games. Its stunning 3D graphics, challenging gameplay, and unique features make it stand out from other match-three games on the market. So download "Triple Match" - "Find Hidden Objects" today and get ready for an addictive and exciting puzzle experience like no other!

===
4 REASONS WHY YOU CAN & WILL LEARN A LANGUAGE
===
START SPEAKING IN MINUTES:

LEARN FROM REAL TEACHERS
Feel confident as you learn from actual teachers and hear real-life conversations.
INSTANTLY PRACTICE WHAT YOU’VE LEARNED
Tired of learning and forgetting immediately after? That’s why after every few lessons, you’ll get tested on what you’ve learned with our Assessments. 
16+ YEARS OF TEACHING LANGUAGES

Start now and access hundreds of audio and video lessons by real teachers, lesson notes, study tools and more. You get:
- A 7-Day Free Premium Trial of Any of Our Language Courses (Free)
- New Audio & Video Lessons EVERY Week for LIFE (Free)
- Offline Mode - Download Lessons to My Library (Free)
- Daily Vocabulary Lessons Delivered to Your Email (Free)
- Progress Syncing Across Devices - Start On One Device & Finish on Another (Free)
- Multiple Playback Options - Stream from the App or the Lock-Screen, Skip Ahead & Control the Speed of Your Lessons (Free)

bluejetty:00131324:ios.description:
HealtheLife helps individuals and families to stay informed, stay educated, and take a more active role in their health. Through the HealtheLife mobile app, you have real-time and easy access to your health care organization's online portal. This portal shows your latest health care information and provides services needed to plan, understand, and engage in your care.
Once your health care organization grants you access to their online portal and creates an account for you, simply sign into the HealtheLife mobile app with your Cerner Health username and password. If you have access to multiple organizations' portals, you can view all participating portals through the app.
Each participating organization's portal is unique, but most portals allow you to connect with your care team using the following methods:
• Securely messaging your provider
• Scheduling and managing upcoming appointments
• Accessing medical information including allergies, laboratory results, health issues, immunizations, medications, and other health documents
If you need assistance accessing your existing account, visit your health care organization's website for support options. Contact your provider directly regarding questions about your health record. Personal health inquiries or concerns posted as comments in the App Store cannot be addressed.

bluejetty:00167037:ios.description:
PLEASE NOTE: Play the Lessons and Practice level packs for free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the full game.
Rev your engines and get ready for a thrilling ride with Retro Racing 2, the ultimate old-school retro racing game that brings back the excitement of classic 2D top-down racing.
Choose from a variety of cars, each with unique performance characteristics, and race across diverse tracks and challenging environments. Collect power-ups, to increase Top Speed, Acceleration and Tires, or for an instant Nitro boost, and speed your way to the top of the leaderboard!
This nostalgic yet fresh racing game offers an adrenaline-pumping experience that will keep you hooked for hours. Slick graphics and exhilarating gameplay make Retro Racing 2 a must-play for racing enthusiasts of all ages.
Features
• Classic 2D Top-Down Racing: Enjoy the simplicity and thrill of retro-style racing with modern enhancements.
• Cars: Choose from a variety of cars, each with distinct speed, handling, and acceleration attributes to suit your racing style and track.
• Power-Ups: Collect power-ups scattered across the tracks to boost your car’s performance and gain an edge over your rivals.
• Level Packs: Race through various challenging environments including:
• Practice: Hone your skills and master the tracks before taking on tougher challenges.
• Circuits: Traditional racing tracks for a pure, competitive experience.
• Snow: Slippery and unpredictable tracks to test your control.
• Sand: Tight sandy tracks that require careful handling and quick reflexes to avoid sliding off course.
• Split-Screen Multiplayer: Compete with up to 4 players in split-screen mode and quadruple the fun!
• Leaderboards: Climb to the top of the leaderboard, showcasing your racing prowess and achieving the ultimate bragging rights.
Why You'll Love It
• Fun for All Ages: Simple yet engaging gameplay makes it perfect for players of all ages.
• Replay Value: Multiple cars, power-ups, and level packs, every race offers a new and exciting challenge, will keep you coming back to improve on your best time.
• Competitive Spirit: The leaderboard adds a competitive edge, encouraging players to continuously improve their skills and outperform their friends.
Get Ready to Race!
Join the Retro Racing 2 community and relive the glory days of arcade racing with a modern twist. Whether you’re a seasoned racer or a newcomer, there’s always a thrill waiting for you on the track.
Download Retro Racing 2 today and experience the ultimate in retro racing fun!

RusMeet — знакомства на русском языке по всему миру. Общение, симпатии и новые отношения без границ для русскоязычных людей.
RusMeet — это международное приложение для знакомств и общения на русском языке для русскоговорящих людей. Где бы
bluejetty:00180577:ios.description:
RusMeet — знакомства на русском языке по всему миру. Общение, симпатии и новые отношения без границ для русскоязычных людей.
RusMeet — это международное приложение для знакомств и общения на русском языке для русскоговорящих людей. Где бы вы ни жили — в России, странах СНГ, Европе, США, Канаде или Израиле — здесь знакомства проходят на одном языке: вас понимают без перевода.
Здесь вы можете найти женщину или найти мужчину для серьёзных отношений и брака, найти жену или мужа и создать семью, встретить любовь, сходить на свидание или просто найти пару для общения и новых друзей. Только реальные люди, проверенные анкеты и удобный поиск по вашим требованиям.
Наши пользователи — русскоговорящие люди из России, Беларуси, Казахстана, Узбекистана, Армении, Грузии, стран Балтии, а также из США, Канады, Германии, Великобритании, Израиля, Франции, Испании, Италии, Сербии, Польши, Чехии, Кипра, Турции и ОАЭ. Знакомьтесь в Москве, Берлине, Нью-Йорке, Тель-Авиве, Торонто, Лондоне, Майами, Чикаго, Париже, Праге, Варшаве, Барселоне, Дубае, Тбилиси, Ереване, Алматы, Астане, Ташкенте, Хайфе, Мадриде — и в любой другой точке мира.
ПОЧЕМУ ЗНАКОМСТВА НА RUSMEET
• Знакомства на русском языке. Не нужно подбирать слова на чужом языке — разговор идёт свободно, как дома.
• Общий культурный код. С русскоязычной девушкой или мужчиной не нужно объяснять очевидное.
• География без ограничений. Русскоязычные знакомства доступны в СНГ, Европе, Северной Америке и на Ближнем Востоке — все русскоговорящие пользователи в одном приложении.
• Реальные люди. Верификация и модерация анкет помогают общаться с проверенными собеседниками.
• Живое сообщество. Русскоговорящие пользователи заходят каждый день, новые анкеты для знакомств появляются постоянно.
ЗНАКОМСТВА НА РУССКОМ ЯЗЫКЕ И ОБЩЕНИЕ
• Игра «Симпатии» — знакомства свайпом: листайте анкеты, ставьте лайки и находите взаимную симпатию.
• Переписка после знакомства — начинайте чат сразу после взаимной симпатии, без ожидания.
• Чат для знакомств в реальном времени — переписка и живое общение с теми, кто вам интересен.
• Подробные анкеты — цели знакомства, интересы, образование, привычки и другие детали. Вы сразу видите, подходит ли вам человек, ещё до первого сообщения.
ПОИСК И ФИЛЬТРЫ
• Знакомства на русском рядом и в вашем городе — находите одиноких женщин и мужчин поблизости.
• Знакомства по расстоянию — выбирайте тех, кто ближе, или общайтесь с людьми из других стран.
• Расширенный поиск — фильтры по возрасту, городу, целям знакомства, интересам и другим параметрам.
• Кто сейчас в сети — отметка онлайн показывает, с кем начать знакомство прямо сейчас.
БЕЗОПАСНЫЕ ЗНАКОМСТВА НА РУССКОМ
• Режим «Невидимка» — просматривайте анкеты, оставаясь незаметными для других.
• Верификация профиля — реальные люди и настоящие эмоции.
• Модерация фото и анкет.
• Конфиденциальность — вы сами решаете, что показывать в анкете, а что оставить при себе.
КОМУ ПОДХОДЯТ ЭТИ ЗНАКОМСТВА
• Для тех, кто ищет серьёзные знакомства, отношения, семью и брак.
• Для тех, кто хочет романтики, свиданий, лёгкого флирта и приятного общения.
• Для экспатов, эмигрантов и тех, кто недавно переехал, — знакомства за границей и русская диаспора рядом с вами: соотечественники и близкие по духу люди.
• Для тех, кому нужны международные знакомства с русскими женщинами и мужчинами из любой страны.
• Для тех, кто хочет познакомиться с девушкой или парнем, говорящими с вами на русском языке.
RusMeet — это знакомства на русском языке без границ. Ваша вторая половинка может жить в соседнем районе или на другом континенте: одинокие русскоязычные девушки, женщины и мужчины живут в каждой стране, и спутника жизни за рубежом здесь находят в любом возрасте.
Установите приложение для знакомств RusMeet и общайтесь на русском языке уже сегодня.

bluejetty:00090330:ios.description:
The LeipzigMOVE app always gets you to your destination easily, quickly and reliably - whether by bus, tram, Flexa, bicycle, e-scooter or taxi. Download now and try it!
FUNCTIONS
• Everything in one app: No more jumping back and forth between different mobility apps
• Smart route planner: Enter your next destination and we'll show you the fastest or most convenient way to get there
• Purchase tickets for public transport (e.g. single, 24-hour tickets, weekly and monthly tickets)
• Use of all sharing services
• loyalty program BonusMOVE: Collect valuable points for every euro you spend and redeem them for attractive coupons
• Pay in the app via PayPal, credit card or Klarna
• Save your home and work address and navigate there even faster
BonusMOVE – THE LOYALTY PROGRAM
• Collect points with every booking in the app
• Whether bus, tram, Flexa, sharing services, Bike+Ride or taxi – every mode of transport counts
• Secure attractive coupons and benefits with partners in and around Leipzig
• Get monthly free units from Nextbike
• Benefit especially with the D-Ticket and get exclusive advantages
PUBLIC TRANSPORT NAVIGATOR
• Connection information and digital stop departure monitor
• Real-time information with current departure and arrival times as well as disruption notifications
• Ticket purchase (e.g. single tickets, 24-hour tickets, weekly and monthly tickets or discounted single tickets (LeipzigMOVE+))
• Display your personal Deutschlandticket or Deutschland-Semesterticket
• Booking your Flexa journey
• Set favourites for frequently purchased tickets and get to the ticket with just two clicks
• Digital network map: All day and night connections in the entire MDV network
CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT
• With the check-in/check-out function for public transport, you always travel at the best price: simply check in, travel and check out - and only pay for what you actually travel.
• It doesn't matter how often you change trams or buses. The best ticket price for your journeys within 24 hours is calculated automatically.
BIKE & E-SCOOTER SHARING
• Real-time locations of all bike sharing bikes from Nextbike - simply scan the QR code in the app and start riding
• Book e-scooters from Voi: simply use the map to find an e-scooter at the nearest mobility station, scan the QR code and off you go
CAR SHARING
• Find all car sharing vehicles, see when they are available and calculate the full costs before booking
TAXI
• One of over 250 taxis is always nearby and will take you to your destination quickly, safely and reliably: Simply order a taxi, take the ride and pay with the app.
BIKE+RIDE
• Park your bike safely and dry in a bike garage or bike box. Simply book a parking space via the app and open it with the QR code.
MOBILITY STATIONS
• Your contact point for mobility, where you can find all sharing services: Nextbike and Voi
• Find what you need quickly – without having to search for a vehicle or parking space.
• Over 150 locations are displayed in the app and more are being added all the time.
SUPPORT
If you have any questions, technical problems or feedback, please contact our customer service tam:
Email: verkehrsbetriebe@l.de
Telephone: +49 (0) 341 492-1000

bluejetty:00183848:ios.description:
Send money internationally with confidence using the MoneyGram® Money Transfer App.
For more than 85 years, people around the world have trusted MoneyGram to move money safely, quickly and reliably across borders. Whether you're supporting family, helping loved ones or managing payments abroad, MoneyGram makes it simple to send money the way that works best for you.
WHY MONEYGRAM
• Fast international money transfers
Many transfers are available within minutes, depending on the delivery option and destination.
• Clear, upfront pricing
See exchange rates and applicable fees before you send, so you always know what to expect.
• Trusted worldwide
With over 85 years of experience, MoneyGram is one of the most established global money transfer services, trusted by millions of customers.
• Secure by design
Transfers are encrypted, protected with biometric login and backed by 24/7 customer care.
SEND MONEY YOUR WAY
Send money to 200+ countries and territories using the delivery option that fits your recipient's needs (availability varies by location):
- Bank account transfers
- Debit card transfers
- Mobile wallet transfers
- Cash pickup at 480,000+ agent locations worldwide
Pay with (availability varies):
- Bank account
- Apple Pay
- Debit card
- Credit card
SEND MONEY TO THE PLACES THAT MATTER
Send money to Mexico, the Philippines, India, the Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Jamaica, Colombia, Nigeria, Ghana, Vietnam, Haiti, Pakistan, Bangladesh and many more.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose the country you're sending to and how your recipient will receive the money
2. Enter the amount and check the exchange rate and fees before you confirm
3. Send, then track your transfer every step of the way until it's delivered
Send again to saved recipients in just a few taps.
DO MORE WITH YOUR MONEY
- Pay bills: pay thousands of US billers directly from the app (availability varies)
- Hold funds digitally and cash out when the rates are right
- Estimate fees and exchange rates before you start a transfer
FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE
- Biometric login (Face ID or Touch ID) for fast, secure access
- Real-time transfer tracking and notifications
- Send again to saved recipients in a few taps
- Agent locator to find nearby MoneyGram locations for cash pickup, in-person wire transfers or money orders
Download the MoneyGram® app and send money internationally with confidence.
Legal disclosures 
By downloading and using MoneyGram® Money Transfers app, you agree to the Terms of Use.
MoneyGram makes money from both transfer fees and currency exchange. When selecting a money transfer operator, carefully compare both transfer fees and currency exchange rates. Transfer fees, foreign currency exchange rates and taxes may vary based on transaction details such as transfer amount, destination country, payment type, delivery method and pick up location. Fees and rates may be subject to change without notice. Please use care when providing payment and receiver account information. Funds will be taken from and paid into the account information provided by the sender.
Available app services will be displayed based on your location. Not all services are available in all countries. The app supports the same send and receive countries shown at www.moneygram.com.

bluejetty:00027641:ios.summary:
Lost your TV remote? Remote control battery dead? Welcome to the TV Remote app, which will save you from all these troubles.
TV Remote is a convenient and easy-to-use application that allows you to control your networked TV with your iPhone
bluejetty:00027641:ios.description:
Lost your TV remote? Remote control battery dead? Welcome to the TV Remote app, which will save you from all these troubles.
TV Remote is a convenient and easy-to-use application that allows you to control your networked TV with your iPhone. This app replicates the functions of a handheld remote, enabling you to control everything: channel lists, volume, menu, information, tools, and other controls (play/pause/stop, etc.). It's compatible with the most popular brands and supports TV models of different production years and screen sizes. All you need to do is connect your iPhone and your TV device to the same Wi-Fi network - your touchscreen will transform into a navigation panel with all the functions of a standard remote.
Features:
• Fast and easy to use: this app acts as a physical remote, always at hand
• Haptic feedback: provides excellent vibrations and realism
• Keyboard input: easily search for TV programs
Subscription information:
After purchase confirmation, the fee will be deducted from your iTunes account. The subscription will automatically renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period unless auto-renewal is turned off. Renewal fees depend on your subscription plan. Users can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in the account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when purchasing a premium subscription during the free trial period.

Tap Arrows Gallery is a meditative logic puzzle where you clear the board of arrows to gradually uncover a beautiful image beneath them. Each illustration is a small mystery hidden behind multiple elements. Tap, plan, reveal, and enjoy the process.
Dive into hundreds of levels where every new picture inspires you to keep going while training your brain, focus, and strategic thinking.
Game Features:
- Original arrow-based puzzles: Tap arrows in the direction they point to remove elements and reveal the picture underneath.
- Logic and strategy in every level: Choosing the right sequence of moves is essential – otherwise the board won't clear.
- Hidden images: Discover a wide variety of illustrations – animals, landscapes, household objects, fantastic items, and more.
- Calming and pleasant gameplay: Minimalistic design, soft sounds, and smooth animations create an atmosphere of relaxation and focus.
- Satisfying sense of progress: Every revealed picture feels rewarding and motivates you to move forward.
- Gradually increasing difficulty: Simple tasks slowly evolve into deeper logical challenges that keep you engaged for a long time.
- No pressure gameplay: No timers, no limits – play at your own pace and enjoy the experience.
How to Play:
- Tap the arrows: Tap an arrow to make it disappear in the direction it points.
- Watch the sequence: Some arrows can be removed only after others – plan your moves carefully.
- Clear all elements: Remove arrows one by one to gradually reveal the hidden image.
- Grow and improve: With each level, strengthen your logic, attention, and puzzle-solving skills.
If you enjoy calm logic puzzles, visual discoveries, and relaxing gameplay, Tap Arrows Gallery is the perfect place to unwind, train your mind, and enjoy beautiful images.
Download Tap Arrows Gallery and discover a world of hidden pictures!

• View interactive weather radar to help you track rain, snow and storms.
• Get weather conditions and forecasts for your location.
We're committed to continually improving your experience in our app. Please let us know how we're doing by leaving a review in the App Store.

bluejetty:00174773:ios.description:
Welcome to our addictive, relaxing, and free-to-play Tile Connect puzzle & pair matching game!
As a classic pair matching puzzle inspired by Mahjong, Tile Connect is a popular strategy game in which you need to find the matching pairs of identical images and leave the board empty. Your goal is to connect all pairs and crush all tiles in the game field. 
If you are a Tile Connect & Tile Match game lover and looking for an excellent tile puzzle to exercise your thinking and memory, you will definitely be addicted to this FREE and newest Tile Connect mind puzzle! Tile Connect - Tile Match Game is well designed to develop your logical thinking and practice your tile craft for free. This will be the perfect time killer for you!
With the simple rules to follow, what you need to do in this Tile link and matching game is to find and connect tiles with various pictures in pairs. When all tiles are matched and disappear from the puzzle board, you will be able to win the current level! 
This amazing tile connect puzzle game also enables you to enjoy matching tiles and blocks with vivid and different patterns, for instance, fresh fruits, delicious desserts, and more! Come to challenge yourself with your favorite blocks in Tile Connect puzzle games! 
MAJOR GAME FEATURES
- Brain-training pair matching game for all ages
- Absolutely FREE to enjoy anytime and anywhere
- Simple & fun matching game mechanics and rules
- Tons of challenging Tile Connect levels to unlock
- Clear UI and beautiful tile collections with uniquely designed graphics
- A great variety of patterns and themes to choose
- EASY & flexible to control and connect onet tiles
- Relaxing tile puzzle without time limit
- Use helpful boosters to overcome the difficulty faster
HOW TO PLAY
1. Tap on the first tile to select it and look for another one with the same image. 
2. Connect two same tiles within 3 straight lines.
3. After the connection, the matching pairs of tiles will disappear from the puzzle board.
4. Match all tiles in pairs to clear the board and collect as many stars as you can!
5. Take advantage of hints when you get stuck and use shuffle to rearrange all tiles to build paths more easily.
Fond of tile connect, onet connect game, onnect pair puzzle, block elimination game, and various board game? Can you crush all tiles and blocks on the screen? Keep your mind active while enjoying, relaxing, and relieving your stress in this tile connect puzzle game, and become a Tile master! Connect all tiles with a great number of patterns as quickly as you can! 
Ready to explore this new, free, and super fun Tile Connect - Tile Match Game? Link, connect, and crush! Let's find all of the matching pairs and have fun with the tile connect puzzle games NOW!

Terms of Service: https://tile-connect.gurugame.ai/termsofservice.html

bluejetty:00124423:ios.summary:

Travel back in time in Sheriff of Mahjong®! A struggling frontier town in a f
bluejetty:00124423:ios.description:
Swap and match tiles on thousands of puzzling pair matching levels to collect resources and use powerful boosters to bring a destroyed Western town back to life!
Travel back in time in Sheriff of Mahjong®! A struggling frontier town in a faraway and beautiful corner of the Old West needs your help to be brought back to its former glory. Play thousands of tile matching levels, meet charismatic characters, follow the suspenseful storyline and help transform this resilient town into the pride of the Wild West while tackling matching games!
This new mahjong solitaire game is a unique and epic combination of city building and classic tile pairing, tied together with a storyline full of twists and turns and the free spirits and hardscrabble realities of the Wild West. You’re a talented builder who’s responded to a Help Wanted ad in Colinstown, a troubled outpost in the Old West. Help the determined citizens revive their community after devastating attacks by the Butler Gang, who may be bankrolled by the corrupt tycoon Richard Pierce. Reconstruct an impressive town worthy of Wild West legends, become the new mayor of Colinstown and thwart the evil machinations of the outlaws to ensure that fortune favors your citizens once again! On your way to prosperity, collect achievements and get special tools, such as the Dice booster (which gets you out of a difficult situation), the Dynamite booster (which blows up multiple pairs of tiles) and many other innovative features that can enhance your gameplay experience!
● PLAY through a unique combination of tile matching and city building in one game
● GO on an adventure filled with the history and tales of the Wild West
● MEET townspeople, cowboys, miners, bankers, outlaws and bounty hunters on your way to prosperity
● MASTER thousands of free immersive marjong, majong, majhong, mah-jongg, mah jongg or mahjongg levels – these are the popular ways to misspell “mahjong”
● WIELD incredible boosters and power-up combos, designed for matching games
● UNLOCK a variety of beautiful buildings and town landmarks to rebuild and upgrade
● FOLLOW your friends’ progress with the innovative built-in social network
While this puzzle game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.
You can play this game even if you’re offline!
Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish.

bluejetty:00123692:ios.description:
[Game Intro]
The originator of auto battler - Auto Chess!
The Auto Chess, which has been sweeping over the world since 2019, released its indie game! Auto Chess, introduced by Drodo Studio and Dragonest Co.Ltd., is an original auto battler game that inherits the strategic gameplay of Auto Chess. Fight in an 8-way match, pondering on the features of various lineups made up of 23 races and 14 classes!
Let's play chess in leisure time!!
-Innovative Gameplay
By collecting/changing Hero cards, and arranging different formations, 8 chess gamers will be contending for the first prize in the following tens of minutes. Millions of players are challenging each other every day, and it has become one of the most popular leisure gameplays nowadays.

Players will randomly get their Heroes in the Sharing Cardpool, and form special formations according to their unique strategies. -Fair Play
Make a real fair-play game! The World e-Sports Games are created by Dragonest Co.Ltd., Drodo, and lmbaTV. 
-Global Server
No matter where you come from, welcome to our world and challenge players from all over the world!

bluejetty:00065486:ios.summary:
Pensou em pedir delivery? Peça pelo aiqfome!
No 2º maior app de delivery do país e líder no interior você encontra os melhores restaurantes da cidade, além de mercados, farmácias, pet shops e muito mais, tudo com cupons e muitas promoções.
bluejetty:00065486:ios.description:
Pensou em pedir delivery? Peça pelo aiqfome!
No 2º maior app de delivery do país e líder no interior você encontra os melhores restaurantes da cidade, além de mercados, farmácias, pet shops e muito mais, tudo com cupons e muitas promoções.
E é só pedir que o aiqfome leva até aí rapidinho e você ainda economiza de montão todos os dias. Para pedir é muito fácil: baixe o app, faça seu cadastro e escolha entre as diversas opções. 
Você pode escolher pelas culinárias e pedir delivery de lanche, pizza, hambúrguer, pastel, dentre outros, ou pelo seu restaurante favorito!
Delivery de comida
Seja a sua fome de sushi, marmitex, pizza, hambúrguer ou açaí, o aiqfome tem tudo para acabar com a sua vontade e com aquele preço que cabe no bolso.
Então, se o estômago roncar e a preguiça de cozinhar vir junto, já sabe! É só abrir o app e pedir comida por lá.
Delivery de mercado
Abriu o armário e não encontrou o que precisava? Relaxa, você pode pedir mercado por delivery no aiqfome.
E sabe o melhor? Sem ter que enfrentar filas, se perder nos corredores ou ficar carregando um monte de sacola pesada por aí, porque a gente leva suas compras onde você estiver.
Delivery de farmácia
Imagina estar com dor de cabeça e ainda ter que ir até a farmácia? Ou perceber bem na hora que você vai trocar a fralda do seu bebê que elas acabaram? É, seria um perrengue enorme, se não existisse o aiqfome.
Peça remédios, produtos de beleza e outros itens com cupons e descontos nas farmácias mais perto de você e receba tudo com entrega rápida na porta da sua casa.
Delivery de pet shop
Ninguém fica de fora, nem o seu bichinho de estimação.
No aiqfome você também pode pedir ração, petisco, coleiras, remédios veterinários, caminhas, itens de higiene, areia de gato e muito mais com cupons de desconto nos pet shops da cidade.
Delivery de bebidas
Com o aiqfome, você não precisa nem cogitar deixar a galera ou o churrasco para sair comprar mais bebidas.
Se acabar a cerveja, os petiscos, o gelo ou o que quer que seja, é só abrir o app para pedir delivery e receber em poucos minutos com aquele preço que você AMA (e o seu bolso mais ainda).
Delivery de gás
Quem nunca passou pela situação de estar cozinhando seu almoço a todo vapor e o gás acabar bem na hora?
A situação já é chata por si só, mas ainda ter que ligar para pedir um novo e ficar esperando um tempão para entregar é ruim demais, né?
Ainda bem que pelo aiqfome você resolve essa situação chatíssima em poucos minutos e o seu gás chega antes de bater o desespero.
É delivery de tudo, é rápido e bom para você
Peça agora e tenha a melhor experiência dentre os apps de delivery.
Você pode acompanhar todo o processo do seu pedido, desde o momento em que a loja recebe ele até quando chega aí na sua casa.
E se bater alguma dúvida ou precisar de ajuda antes ou depois de fazer o seu pedido, saiba que você não vai falar com robôs.
O nosso atendimento é feito 100% por humanos preparados e dispostos a te ajudar da melhor maneira possível, não é à toa que chamamos eles de “Ninjas”, é porque eles são bons mesmo.
Cupom de desconto todo dia com o d+, nosso clube de vantagens
Ao assinar o d+, você tem cupons diários de R$10 de desconto ou de entrega grátis para usar em pedidos acima de R$19,99 pagos pelo app em qualquer loja do app.
Além de descontos exclusivos para comprar tudo o que você sempre sonhou no Magazine Luiza, Época, KaBuM! e Netshoes.
Para assinar, abra o app e toque no ícone “Seja d+”!
Para conferir se o aiqfome já chegou na sua cidade, acesse: https://aiqfome.com/cidades

- Current weather conditions for Mid-Michigan and anywhere in the United States
- Share the weather conditions via text message, email, Facebook or Twitter
- You can set multiple custom locations to track forecasts, alerts, radar, and more
- Closings and delays for Mid-Michigan

We celebrate you for being sober curious and seeki
bluejetty:00132389:ios.description:
Sunnyside is the only alcohol tracking, planning, and coaching app focused on mindful drinking and moderation, not sobriety. It’ll help you reframe your relationship to alcohol in no time.
We celebrate you for being sober curious and seeking alcohol moderation. If you’re one of the 75% of adults who drink, you can use Sunnyside to reframe your approach to alcohol and start building healthier drinking habits immediately. You don’t have to go sober to see big results.
Rated 4.6 on the App Store
REAL RESULTS THAT LEAD TO CHANGE
In their first 30 days, the average member experiences the following results:
 • Drink 29% less alcohol every week
 • Successfully reframe their relationship to alcohol, without going sober
 • Save at least $50 (it covers the cost of the subscription)
 • Cut 1,500 calories out their diet
 • Gain significantly more energy and focus
 • Dramatically improve sleep quality
 • Improve overall wellness
WHAT IS MINDFUL DRINKING?
Put simply, it’s all about thinking while drinking. Mindful drinking is not about quitting alcohol but instead being aware of how much alcohol you’re drinking and its impact on you in the moment. 
SCIENCE-BACKED FOR LASTING CHANGE
Reviewed and backed by an advisory board of medical and habit change experts, Sunnyside uses techniques such as pre-commitment and conscious interference to gradually help you reframe your relationship to alcohol without interrupting your day-to-day lifestyle.
NO GUILT OR PRESSURE TO QUIT
Our nonjudgmental approach will make you feel welcome and appreciated. Your goals around alcohol are personal–not all or nothing–and we tailor your experience appropriately. We never pressure you to be sober or quit drinking.
HOW IT WORKS
 • Set your personal goals around alcohol
Your experience starts with a short, anonymous survey that only takes about 3 minutes. We gather some information about your drinking habits, your goals, and your intentions. This helps us personalize your experience to help you reframe your relationship to alcohol.
 • Commit to a weekly alcohol plan
Every week we give you a recommended drink plan for the week ahead that will help you reach your personal goals. It’s always gradual and you can always adjust it.
 • Track your drinks
Via a simple interface in-app (or via text message), we make alcohol tracking easy, and provide nudges to help you stay on target.
 • Get daily motivation
We’ll deliver upbeat and positive education, motivation, tips, and tricks to keep you on track every day of the week. We focus on mindfulness and moderation, not going sober.
 • Text real human coaches
Our team of real human coaches are available for you, no matter what you need. Text them anonymously to receive a helpful nudge at any time. Or don’t. We never force you to interact with our coaches.
 • Interact with the community
Our new community feature lets you connect with others in the community around a shared daily prompt that helps you stay positive and mindful every day. It’s the perfect way to support those around you and get a bit of support and validation for yourself.
 • Measure your progress
Watch and measure how your new habits add up to better sleep, money saved, and an improved diet in your personal dashboard.
PEOPLE ARE USING SUNNYSIDE TO:
 • Reduce and moderate their alcohol consumption
 • Get support from others with similar goals
 • Track their alcohol and learn how much they’re drinking
 • Reframe their overall relationship to alcohol
 • Add more dry days to their week
 • Stop binge drinking and blacking out
 • Reduce the effects of hangovers
 • Reduce anxiety and improve overall wellness
 • Lose some weight and improve diet
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
When you sign up for Sunnyside you’ll get 15 days to try everything for free, after which your credit card will be charged. You can cancel anytime within the 15-day free trial. 
Privacy policy: https://www.sunnyside.co/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.sunnyside.co/terms

bluejetty:00075566:ios.description:
*Try Shapez up to level 7 for free or unlock the full game for more tools, more shapes and more challenges!*
Do you like automation games? Then you are in the right place!
shapez is a relaxed game in which you have to build factories for the automated production of geometric shapes. As the level increases, the shapes become more and more complex, and you have to spread out on the infinite map.
And as if that wasn't enough, you also have to produce exponentially more to satisfy the demands - the only thing that helps is scaling! While you only have to process shapes at the beginning, you will later have to color them - by extracting and mixing colors!
FEATURES
- Create a unique and complex abstract shapes factory in a satisfying way.
- Unlock new devices, upgrade them, and optimize your factory by experimenting with diverse tools.
- Develop your system the way you want: each problem can have many solutions.
- Enjoy an elegant, minimalist and readable art direction.
- Go at your own pace with an approachable gameplay and a soothing soundtrack.
CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface
- Game Center achievements
- iCloud - Share your progress between iOS devices
If you run into a problem, please contact us at https://playdigious.helpshift.com/hc/en/12-playdigious/ with as much information as possible on the issue.

bluejetty:00131083:ios.description:
The official app for BIKETOWN, Portland’s bike share system.
BIKETOWN consists of a fleet of specially designed, sturdy and durable electric bikes that can be locked at any BIKETOWN station or bike rack throughout the city. Bike share is a greener, healthier way to get around — whether you’re commuting, running errands, meeting friends, or exploring in a new city.
The BIKETOWN App gives you access to hundreds of bikes in your area — unlock and pay directly from the app and get going.
The BIKETOWN App also shows upcoming public transit departures, including train lines, local buses, and streetcars.
Within the app, you can either purchase an annual BIKETOWN membership or single rides.
Happy riding!

bluejetty:00120293:ios.description:
Welcome to LEGO® DUPLO® World, where learning and play go hand in hand so toddlers can create, imagine, and explore.
• Hundreds of activities and open-ended play experiences
• Themed play packs catering to every interest
• From vehicles to animals and more!
• Meets the developmental needs of kids aged 3 – 6
• Build and create with colorful 3D LEGO® DUPLO® bricks
• Multi-touch support and parent tips for shared play
• Multi award-winning app
When young children have fun and play, it creates the perfect conditions to learn and grow. We have designed this app to help young kids develop a balance of the IQ skills (cognitive and creative) and EQ skills (social and emotional) they need for the best start in life.
THEMES
Vehicles, Animals, Trains, Trucks, Cars, Police, Fire, Doctor, Space, Holidays, Home, School, Music, Buildings, Camping, Farm, Airplanes, Food, Submarines
AWARDS & ACCOLADES
• Kidscreen Best Learning App Winner 2021
• Licensing International Excellence Awards 2020 Winner
• KAPi Award for Best App 2020 Winner 
• American Library Association’s Notable Children’s Digital Media List 2021
• Children’s Technology Review Editor’s Choice Winner 2020 
• Mom's Choice® Gold Award 2020
• Teach Early Years Awards - Shortlisted for Creative Play 2020
• Notable Children’s Digital Media Winner 2021
• Digital Ehon Prize Winner 2020
• Irish Animation Awards - Nominated for Best Animation for Apps 2021
• Apple Editor’s Choice
FEATURES
• Safe and age-appropriate
• Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age
• FTC Approved COPPA Safe Harbor Certification by Privo.
• Play pre-downloaded content offline without wifi or internet
• Regular updates with new content
• Apple Family Sharing for easy subscription sharing with other family members
• No third-party advertising
• No in-app purchases for subscribers
SUPPORT 
For any questions or assistance, please reach out to us at support@storytoys.com.
ABOUT STORYTOYS
Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.
PRIVACY & TERMS
StoryToys takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps comply with privacy laws, including the Child Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If you would like to learn more about the information we collect and how we use it, please visit our privacy policy at https://storytoys.com/privacy.
Read our terms of use here: https://storytoys.com/terms/
SUBSCRIPTION & IN-APP PURCHASES
This app contains sample content that is free to play. However, LOTS MORE fun and entertaining games and activities are available. You can buy individual units of content via in-app purchases. Alternatively, if you subscribe to the app you can play with EVERYTHING. We regularly add new stuff, so subscribed users will enjoy ever-expanding play opportunities.
• Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually according to the rate of the selected subscription plan.
• You can change your mind at any point. Cancelling can be done through your iTunes settings.
• Your subscription will auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package unless you cancel it 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Subscription fees are charged to your iTunes account.
• After purchase, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings.
• When you purchase a subscription, you forfeit any unused portion of a free trial period.
• You can use your subscription on any device registered with the same Apple ID that you subscribed from.

bluejetty:00017337:ios.description:
Rewrite Conversations. Prank Friends. Make It Your Style.
TYPE lets you turn any message into a personalized sticker — Yes/No bubbles, reversed text, custom tapbacks, and more. Whether you’re fixing a typo, flipping a word for a laugh, or designing something entirely new, you’re in control.
What You Can Do:
 • Create Yes/No stickers to fix or flip what was said.
 • Replace texts for funny pranks or quick corrections.
 • Make your own custom tapbacks with any emoji or color.
 • Choose from dozens of fonts — or stick with the classic iOS look.
 • Customize text color, background, and shape (clear, rectangle, or round).
How It Works:
 1. Type your text.
 2. Pick a style, font, and colors.
 3. Drag your sticker onto any iMessage bubble.
It’s fast, fun, and works for any mood — serious, sarcastic, or just plain silly.
TYPE: Yes No Sticker Maker Pro Subscription:
The app includes a weekly and a monthly auto-renewable subscription with a 7-day free trial. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription. Although your subscription for the current week or month cannot be canceled, you can turn off auto-renewal in your account settings after purchase.
See instructions here:
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
You can read the terms of use and privacy policy here:
https://catnip.media/pps?app=TYPE&lang=en

bluejetty:00159959:ios.description:
Take control of your health with our all-in-one Heart Health Tracker app. Easily measure and record your heart rate, blood pressure, blood sugar, BMI, and daily water intake — all in one secure place.
Whether you want to track your fitness progress, monitor daily changes, or build better wellness habits, our app makes it simple and intuitive.
Smart Health Companion
Understand your body better with scientific charts and personalized health insights. Stay motivated through daily tips designed to help you maintain a balanced lifestyle and long-term well-being.
Key Features
• Heart Rate Monitor – Check and log your heart rate anytime, anywhere.
• Blood Pressure Tracker – Keep a clear record of your readings and trends.
• Blood Sugar Log – Track and manage your glucose levels with ease.
• BMI Calculator – See your health status at a glance.
• Water Reminder – Get smart notifications to help you stay hydrated.
• Health Reports & Statistics – Visualize your progress with easy-to-read graphs.
• Personalized Health Tips – Get advice to support a healthier routine.
What is a Normal Heart Rate? 
Heart rate is a key indicator of overall health. A heart rate between 60 and 100 BPM is considered normal for a healthy adult. However, it can be affected by factors such as posture, stress, illness, and fitness level.
Disclaimer: 
· The app is not intended for medical diagnosis. 
· The app is not intended to be used as a medical device in the diagnosis of heart disease. 
· If you require first aid for heart problems or other emergencies, seek immediate medical attention from a qualified healthcare professional.
