Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Price may vary by location. You will not be able to cancel the subscription during active subscription period. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://h-r-h-t.com/privacy

bluejetty:00022583:ios.summary:
Track running stats, records routes with GPS in real time and allows you to reach your goals with detailed analysis and graphs. Leap running app tracks all key stats, distance, time, speed, calories burned, elevation, etc.
Training for a r
bluejetty:00022583:ios.description:
Track running stats, records routes with GPS in real time and allows you to reach your goals with detailed analysis and graphs. Leap running app tracks all key stats, distance, time, speed, calories burned, elevation, etc.
Training for a race or just want to burn calories? Leap mile tracker provides a variety of plans to meet different goals, which can help you stay motivated and get results. You can also get audio feedback from the voice coach.
Improve heart health with customized goal
American Heart Association (AHA) recommends that most adults should have at least 150 minutes of moderate exercise or 75 minutes of vigorous exercise per week (or a combination of both) to keep the heart healthy.
Follow AHA's guidelines and based on your own conditions, we will help you set the most appropriate goal. This app can automatically calculate the progress of your goal based on your pace, makes your goal measurable and trackable.
Running Tracker
• Map your route - Record your routes with GPS. You can save your paths and share your route maps with friends.
• Analyze every run - It monitors all your stats in real time and analyzes them in graphs.
• Match the same path - It records your same-route runs and shows the trends of your performance over time.
• Get audio feedback - Get audio feedback (duration, distance, calories, pace, etc) from the voice coach to take control of your training and improve your performance. 
Powerful Analysis
• Compare your performance with stats at different distances and time periods.
• Scientifically analyze your training patterns to improve your performance.
• Clear and stylish graphic design.
For Different Fitness Goals
• Whether you simply run or marathon training.
• Whether you want to lose weight or keep fit.
• Whether you are man or woman, old or young.
• It's not only a distance tracker, but also a mile tracker, calorie counter, mile counter, jogging app, weight loss apps.
• Sync data to Apple Health
Subscription Terms and Details
- Get unlimited access to all features for USD $3.99/month, USD $9.99/year. 
- The payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication
Privacy Policy: https://leap.app/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use: http://pay.mobihealthplus.com/app/maprunner.html

bluejetty:00129408:ios.description:
White Noise for Staying On Task
For adults with ADHD, distractions can make staying on task a more significant challenge than usual.
If you have trouble shutting out the world when you need to study, write, paint, spark creativity, sleep, or get down to business at work, this free service is perfect for your needs.
Often someone who has ADHD can think better and stay on task longer if there is some white noise in her surroundings—maybe softly playing music, a fan in the corner, or the hum from an overhead air vent. So far, researchers have found benefits for those with inattention but not impulsivity, but the benefits of white noise don’t continue when it is no longer present. In the real world, people cannot control the sounds that surround them throughout the day. Although researchers are exploring whether white noise may provide complementary support for some people with inattentive ADHD, the evidence is inconclusive.
Research on white noise for inattentive ADHD
Most research on white noise has focused on children still in elementary or middle school; however, the results seem to be applicable also to teens and adults. For adults working from home at this time, having white noise available could be beneficial when it comes to staying on task.

bluejetty:00072971:ios.description:

2. Rich Formatting Options: Take full control of your document's appearance with a wide range of formatting tools. Adjust font styles, sizes, colors, and apply bold, italic, underline, or strikethrough effects. Format paragraphs with alignment, indentation, and line spacing options.
3. Document Collaboration: Seamlessly collaborate with others by sharing documents via email, AirDrop, or cloud storage services. Enable real-time co-editing to work simultaneously with teammates and track changes for easy review.
4. Review and Comments: Add comments, annotations, and track changes within the document. Efficiently review and address feedback from collaborators, ensuring a smooth editing process.
5. Document Management: Organize your documents into folders, rename files, and easily search for specific documents using keywords or file names. Sort and filter documents based on creation date, modification date, or alphabetical order.

7. Offline Editing: Enjoy the flexibility to work on your documents even without an internet connection. Edit offline, and once you're back online, the app will automatically sync your changes.

4. Improved Organization: Keep your documents neatly organized, making it effortless to find and access specific files whenever you need them.
5. Compatibility and Flexibility: Work with various Word document formats, ensuring that you can seamlessly edit files created on different platforms and share them without compatibility issues.
6. Offline Access: Work on your documents even when you're offline, ensuring uninterrupted productivity, regardless of your internet connection.
7. Data Security: With cloud sync and backup, your documents are securely stored, preventing data loss and providing peace of mind.

The best-selling Dr. Seuss classic “Horton Hears a Who!” comes to life with playful interactivity, delightful animations and fun activities!

FEATURES
- Delightful animations on every page
- Tap and drag to find playful surprises throughout the book
- Find hidden stars on every page to reveal fun activities
- Read with highlighted narration in Read To Me, explore in Read It Myself, or enjoy Auto Play
- Explore new vocabulary by tapping words and pictures
- Track minutes spent reading, pages read, and more in the Parents section
ACTIVITIES
- Play ten different mini-games like Memory Match, Jigsaw Puzzle, Word Search, Sequence, and more!
- Find all 31 unique games hidden throughout the book
- Enjoy activities again and again, directly from the main menu
- Try to beat your high score and best time

bluejetty:00027189:ios.description:
Introducing you Bicycle Ride Tracker - most accurate, powerful and precise cycle computer available for your iPhone. Either you are cycling for pleasure or training as professional - Bicycle Ride Tracker is your irreplaceable assistant to healthier and longer live.
With Bicycle Ride Tracker you can easily track how much you ride, how long it was, how many calories were burned, what was the speed or elevation and finally, see that all on a map.
What we did in Bicycle Ride Tracker - is that we took user experience to the new level. Our easy to use and intuitive interface will help you to start cycling anywhere and set up everything right on the go. We thoroughly selected each and every element to show and combined them in quite simple but unique and outstanding user interface.
TRACK
Bicycle Ride Tracker automatically records your time, distance, speed, elevation, calories burned and location.
MAP
Track your exact distance and speed for each and every ride using maps.
PERSONAL PROFILE
Fill in your personal weight, height, gender and age to make the stats more precise and accurate.
SHARE
Tell the world about your accomplishments via Facebook, Twitter and Email by posting them to your favorite social websites.
EXPORT
Improve your personal results by exporting complete summaries of your rides in GPX, KML or CSV formats.
Apple Watch
Start, stop and track your rides from Apple Watch.
GPS USAGE
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Bicycle Ride Tracker offers a subscription plan that lets you record unlimited number of trips and turn off in-app advertisements 
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
NOTE:
Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.
Data connection is required to see map.
Make sure that you have location services enabled for the application. To enable - Settings> General> Location Services

bluejetty:00026810:ios.description:
We sincerely invite you to join us in exploring more efficient ways of taking notes and jointly reshape the modern learning mode. As a companion exploring new ways of taking notes, Kilonotes can meet your various needs. Whether it is recording class notes, annotating PDFs, doing test exercises, studying online courses, or organizing reading notes, Kilonotes will be your reliable study partner. Let's take good notes together.
[Breakthrough the limitations of paper]
·Handwriting can be moved, scaled and rotated freely
·You can undo what you entered
·The size of the eraser can be adjusted to control the erasing range
·Scale paper function to make writing more comfortable
You can insert pictures or photos, and combine text and pictures to deepen memory
· Quick browsing function to help you quickly find what you need
· Unlimited creation of paper, providing endless memory space
·Recording function, allowing you to take notes while listening to lectures
·Card function, create an exclusive knowledge base, you can create your card through pictures, brushes, and typing
OCR function, convenient and fast text extraction
 A variety of fun-but-practical Journaling templates
[Optimized reading experience]
·Global PDF search, quickly find what you need in the database
· Outline function, convenient and fast positioning
Multiple reading modes: eye protection, dark color, vision protection
· Quick jump function, enter the page number to quickly navigate
·Translation function to help foreign language literature reading
·Extraction function, easy to collect important information
·PDF extension function, make reading and writing more free
[Beyond the limits of the brush]
· Change brush color, create custom colors, or pick any color with the eyedropper
·Adjustable brush width to adapt to various scenes
·Graffiti pen function, make notes more colorful
[Custom Notebook]
·Provide many unique and beautiful covers for you to choose
·A variety of paper templates are available: blank paper, dot matrix paper, graph paper, to meet your needs
·You can import PDF and record freely in your own notebook
[AI Assistant] 
• Built-in high-efficiency AI assistant helps you organize notes, expand knowledge points, and double your learning and work efficiency.
• Exclusive AI problem-solving function supports selecting questions and sending them with one click, helping you easily overcome learning difficulties.
[About subscription]
Users can subscribe to the monthly subscription service of kilonotes to unlock advanced content, including custom time planning books.
The subscription will be automatically renewed. If the user needs to cancel the subscription, the renewal needs to be closed 24 hours before the end of the current cycle.
Users can close and cancel subscriptions and trials in their iTunes account.
Contact us: feedback@top-stack.com
Official website: https://www.kilonotesapp.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.top-stack.com/page/ios_en_privacy.html
User agreement: https://www.top-stack.com/page/Kilonotes_Terms_of_use_En.html

bluejetty:00017421:ios.name: WeDJ for iPhone
bluejetty:00017421:ios.summary: Get the party started with WeDJ for iPhone! Developed by Pioneer DJ – the brand known for its club-standard DJ equipment – this app offers a flexible and seamless DJ experience. Play and mix music from streaming services such as Beatport St
bluejetty:00017421:ios.description:
Get the party started with WeDJ for iPhone! Developed by Pioneer DJ – the brand known for its club-standard DJ equipment – this app offers a flexible and seamless DJ experience. Play and mix music from streaming services such as Beatport Steaming and SoundCloud Go+/DJ, as well as tracks stored on your iPhone, and use performance features and FX to create your own sound.
◆Key features
Discover and mix new music.
Play tracks from: 
- Your iTunes
- Beatport Steaming (subscription required)*
- SoundCloud Go+/DJ (subscription required)*
- Other locations on your iPhone, such as Dropbox
* Please contact the service developer about the corresponding countries of each streaming service.
◆Take your performances to the next level by connecting compatible DJ gear.
Get hands-on with any of these units:
- DDJ-200
- DDJ-WeGO4
- DDJ-WeGO3
◆Main features
◇Make the music your own.
 FX (effects): Change the texture of the sound using various FX, such as Echo and Reverb.
 Sampler: Get creative by triggering included sounds such as Horn and Siren.
 3-band EQ: Mix smoothly by adjusting the volume of three sound ranges: high, medium, and low.
 Tempo slider: Control the speed of each track and use Master Tempo to prevent changes to the key. 
◇Other features
 2-channel layout: Play two different tracks at the same time.
 Beat Sync: Sync the tempo of two songs with the touch of a button.
 Crossfader: Adjust the volume balance of the two tracks.
 Transition FX: Create a professional-sounding transition between tracks by simply moving the crossfader. 
◇Play your favorite parts of a track
 Loop: Choose a section of a track and play it repeatedly.
 Hot Cue: Mark the point in a track where you want to start playing from and jump to it at any time.
◇Listen and share
 Automix: Let the app do the mixing so you can simply enjoy listening.
 Record: Capture your mix and play it back (disabled when streaming music).
 Upload: Share your mix with friends and music lovers via Mixcloud or SoundCloud.
◇Design
 Jog wheels: Scratch tracks by touching the jog wheel on the screen.
 Enlarged waveforms: See a visual representation of the track and touch the waveform to visually check the playback position.

bluejetty:00159412:ios.description:

COMPLETELY AD-FREE / PREMIUM-FREE:
- The only weight lifting / workout app with absolutely no ads and no premium features!
TRACK YOUR WORKOUTS:
- The only high-end workout app with a colorful, information-centric workout overview display
- Visualize your workout history in one of three ways: list, weekly, or calendar view

- Use one of our many provided default templates as inspiration for your next workout

- Compete against your friends for weight lifting glory!
- Effortlessly share your workouts with friends

- App-wide dark mode
- The only app with a customizable, machine learning-driven 'workout smart name' feature
- Create, name, and categorize any exercise
- Choose from one of eleven different ways to track your exercise
- Add variations to individually view your progress for each type
- An extensive settings menu, including:
 - Prevent screen sleep, extra workout analytics, shortcuts, and much more

bluejetty:00152783:ios.description:
It’s not a car. It’s a robotaxi designed around you.
Zoox is fully autonomous, all-electric ride-hailing. We’ve created a purpose-built robotaxi to give you a better way to ride. Get the app today and learn what makes Zoox the best ride on the road.
HAIL A RIDE
Open the app, choose your destination, and your Zoox is on the way. Zoox drives itself — all you have to do is make yourself comfortable.
MEET YOUR ZOOX
Your carriage-style seating awaits. Zoox arrives, the doors slide open, and you step inside. After you sit down, craft your ideal ride with in-seat controls for music, temperature, and more.
NEW FREEDOMS
The Zoox robotaxi’s spacious and comfortable cabin is designed to give time, space, and freedom back to you. Plug in, switch off, or throw a dance party. It’s your journey.
SENSORS THAT SEE IT ALL
The Zoox robotaxi combines cameras, lidars, radar, and long-wave infrared sensors for a 360-degree view of everything on the road.
SAFETY AT THE CORE
Zoox protects every rider with over 100 safety features that don’t exist in conventional cars, such as an innovative airbag system and a safety-focused active suspension.
TRACK YOUR JOURNEY
Instantly view your trip progress from the app or the touchscreen at your seat so you’re never left guessing your ETA.
STAY IN CHARGE
Wireless charging at every seat means your devices arrive as recharged as you do.
MIX THE MUSIC
Pair your device to Zoox via Bluetooth and enjoy your favorite tunes or podcasts during your ride. Pair just once and your device will auto-connect every time you ride.

bluejetty:00022947:ios.description:
One-time purchase. No subscription.
AstroShader is an astrophotography app for capturing, stacking and editing. All you need is a stand, tripod, telescope or rock (to lean your phone on).
AstroShader lets you align and stack live during the image capture process. You can also align and stack images from you Photos library. No need to transfer images to a computer to align and stack them separately (but there is a built in intervalometer if you need it).
To take an image follow these steps:
 • Use a stand, tripod, telescope mount (or lean your iPhone on a rock).
 • Zoom in on stars and set focus manually, or use autofocus.
 • Set the exposure time, ISO and white balance, or leave to auto-exposure.
 • Set the number of exposures to be automatically aligned and stacked.
 • Calibrate your images from the edit tools.
 • After the capture is complete you can edit and save your image—including as 16bit TIFF.
 • You can open images directly to use the edit tools in AstroShader - rather following a new image capture.
Image capture options include:
 • Number of exposures to be aligned and stacked
 • Exposure time
 • ISO
 • White balance
 • Camera type
 • Countdown timer
 • Manual focus
 • Pause the capture to reposition iPhone or telescope
Edit options include:
 • Stretch image
 • Background extraction
 • Dynamic background extraction (DBE)
 • x5 Histogram curves for fine tonal adjustment
 • x3 sharpen layers each with radius and intensity with layer blending rather than chaining
 • Brightness (low light enhancement)
 • Saturation
 • Black point
 • Temperature
 • Tint
 • Save format options; HEIF, PNG, JPEG, TIFF

bluejetty:00127173:ios.name: nanoloop
bluejetty:00127173:ios.summary:
Nanoloop combines sequencer, synthesizer and sampler in one package. It provides all functions for creating electronic music from scratch.
- Easy to use sequencer, suitable for rhythm and melody
- Automatisation of all parameters
- 8 chann
bluejetty:00127173:ios.description:
Nanoloop combines sequencer, synthesizer and sampler in one package. It provides all functions for creating electronic music from scratch.
- Easy to use sequencer, suitable for rhythm and melody
- Automatisation of all parameters
- 8 channels, each can be synth or sampler
- 8 patterns per channel
- Sample via microphone
- Re-sample
- Polyphonic FM-, PWM- and noise synth
- Song editor with loop function
- Send and receive projects via e-mail
- WAV export
- Sharing projects and audio in file sharing apps like Dropbox is possible when these apps are installed.
- MIDI sync with other devices
- Ableton Link
The Synth
Nanoloop's FM synth offers a maximum of flexibility within a small set of parameters. It comes with a stereo modulator detune effect and covers the typical clean bells and Rhodes-like sounds, spheric pads, thick beats and basses.
The Sequencer
The stepsequencer visualises the rhythmic structure in a compact 4x4 square matrix, making it very easy to lay out patterns.
The Sampler
Besides A/D envelope, loop function, start offset, tune and fine tune, the puristic sampler comes without effects. You can record up to 6 seconds via microphone or copy samples via iTunes.
Share
With nanoloop for iPhone, you can send your saved projects to other nanoloop users and your own PC via e-mail. If nanoloop is installed on the recipient's iPhone / iPod, she/he can simply tap on the file name in the received e-mail to start nanoloop and import the attached file so that it is available for editing. This makes collaboration very easy, multiple users around the world can work on the same project by simply e-mailing the file.
Export
Songs can be exported to a WAV file that is accessible via iTunes (simply drag & drop files in finder). The exported file is also copied to the clipboard so that it can be pasted in other apps that support pasting audio. If a file sharing app like Dropbox is installed, you can upload the file there.
More information can be found at the nanoloop website: www.nanoloop.com

bluejetty:00026569:ios.description:
Download BabyCenter’s Pregnancy App to track your pregnancy week-by-week and win exclusive discounts and products from top-rated baby brands with our free loyalty program.
BabyCenter is the go-to pregnancy, parenting and family planning app, offering expert resources, week-by-week pregnancy tracking, and a loyalty program to earn points and redeem for exclusive discounts and products.
Pregnancy
* See your baby’s growth during pregnancy with our 3-D fetal development videos
* Join our in-app loyalty program where you can earn and redeem points for exclusive discounts and products from brands you love – free for all members
* Use our Pregnancy Calendar to track appointments and symptoms like nausea and morning sickness
* Take free Baby Safety and childbirth classes
* Choose the perfect baby name with our Baby Name Generator 
* Use our My Registry tool to build your baby registry and research your favorite pregnancy and baby products
* Get helpful tips about common pregnancy symptoms and questions
* Check out pregnancy workouts and nutrition advice tailored to your trimester
* Count down and prepare for the big day with our printable hospital bag checklist and birth plan template
* Count your baby’s kicks during pregnancy
* Time contractions during late pregnancy and labor!
Parenthood
* Use our Baby Growth Tracker to chart your baby’s size, development and big milestones
* Keep track of postpartum symptoms and notes about your baby
* Learn about baby sleep at every stage with our sleep guides
* Consult our feeding guides to solve common breastfeeding and formula feeding challenges 
* Get ideas for fun baby and toddler games and activities to boost your child’s development
* Document memories as you watch your baby grow
Starting a Family
* Track ovulation and fertility with our Ovulation Calculator
* Spot the early signs of pregnancy by tracking symptoms
* Get tips on how to get pregnant
* Learn which prenatal vitamins experts recommend
* Calculate your baby’s due date with our pregnancy due date calculator
BabyCenter Community
* Connect with moms, parents and parents-to-be in our Community
* Join your Birth Club to meet people with due dates in the same month
* Ask questions, share stories and find support from other expecting families and parents
All health information is written by experts and reviewed and approved by the BabyCenter Medical Advisory Board. These doctors and other professionals ensure that our pregnancy and parenting information is thorough and accurate. 
An Award-Winning Experience
BabyCenter is proud to be recognized by leading organizations for its excellence in delivering expert content and top-of-the-line experiences to the parents who visit our site and use our pregnancy app and baby tracker app.

bluejetty:00186113:ios.summary:
Select the desired rail and connect it. 
Just tap to lay rails.
Create a railway with elevated rails, forking rails, etc., as you want.
Create a railway for your favorite train or bullet train and exercise your imagination and creativity.
bluejetty:00186113:ios.description:
Select the desired rail and connect it. 
Just tap to lay rails.
Create a railway with elevated rails, forking rails, etc., as you want.
Create a railway for your favorite train or bullet train and exercise your imagination and creativity. 
Great fun to run a train on a railway you created, and a great sense of accomplishment!
Add train stations and tunnels to customize it. Then run trains on it! 
Instructions
Tap the screen to add the desired rail. 
Tap the arrow in the direction you want to lay the rail. Very easy to lay rails. 
Tap on a background part to add buildings and trees wherever you want. 
After building the railway, tap on the Put Train button and select a train!
You can add and delete trains and change the running direction. 
After you are done, tap the Start Train button to start running the train.
When the train approaches a fork, use the following Fork button to switch the train's direction.
Camera Mode
Press "+" to zoom in. 
Press "-" to zoom out.
Press the arrow to change the camera angle. 
Train tracking: Press ON to track a train.

bluejetty:00140697:ios.description:
Duo Chat - the ultimate app for those who want to use a second WhatsApp account on their iPhone.
With Duo Chat, you can easily and securely access your second WhatsApp account without having to log in and out of your main account.
The app also comes with advanced security features, such as Face ID lock, making sure that your conversations are always safe and private.
But that's not all. Duo Chat is also available on iPad, providing you with a seamless WhatsApp experience across all your Apple devices. And if you need to send a WhatsApp message to someone without adding them to your contacts, Duo Chat has got you covered. Simply enter the number, and you're good to go.
Finally, Duo Chat allows you to create a link that opens up a WhatsApp chat. This means that you can easily share your WhatsApp details with friends and family, without having to manually add them to your contacts. Download Duo Chat now and take your WhatsApp experience to the next level.
FEATURES:
- Using a second WhatsApp account;
- Click to Chat - sending a message by WhatsApp number, without adding it to your contacts;
- Chat Link - creating a link through which the user can quickly go to WhatsApp chat;
- App Lock - to lock the application.
Download Duo Chat now and take your WhatsApp experience to the next level!

bluejetty:00062493:ios.description:
My Town: Daycare brings six cute babies and 12 happy characters, from teachers to family members. There are six locations to discover including a playground complete with swings and a slide. You can interact with almost every item you see, so after putting the babies down for a nap (make sure to cover them up with their blankets!), you’ll have time to set the table for dinner or grab some food from the fridge!
FEATURES:
*6 different rooms to adventure into!
*No time limit, competition or high scores to beat – just pure open ended play.
*Over 900 new items and sounds to discover!
*Experience all four seasons and find clothing to wear during them all.
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
 You can easily contact with us on Facebook or Twitter at any time to let us know what you would like changed or added. Maybe you’ve come up with a new My Town game all on your own – let us know! We promise to read all messages and reply. We love to hear YOUR ideas, so please connect with us! 
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
 Twitter – https://twitter.com/mytowngames
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

WHY YOU’LL LIKE IT 
- Time‑Bending Progression – Push forward, rewind, and unlock exponential growth that always feels new. 
- Choose Your Pace – Tap quick mini‑events for instant boosts or let generous offline earnings work while you are away. 
- Smart Prestige Loops – Several reset systems reward clever timing and long‑term planning. 
- Hundreds of Upgrades and Collectibles – Build unique strategies with cards, buffs, and hidden synergies you will uncover yourself. 
- One Fair IAP – An optional “Dev Options” pack lets you jump to maximum forward/backward time and run the game at 10× speed. No forced ads or paywalls. 
- Plays Great Offline – Progress continues even when your device is asleep.
YOUR JOURNEY (SPOILER‑LIGHT) 
Begin with humble production, then discover entirely new layers that flip the rules of idle games. In time you will command forces so vast they ripple through past and future alike—but figuring out what unlocks next is part of the fun.
Join a growing community of Timekeepers today. Download Idle Eternum and start forging infinity!

bluejetty:00180770:ios.name: Baby Einstein: Storytime
bluejetty:00180770:ios.summary: Introducing Baby Einstein: Storytime, a brand-new interactive app with 12 books from PlayDate Digital. Each engaging and vibrant tale is hosted by a curious group of animal friends who use senses like sight, sound, and touch to introduce an
bluejetty:00180770:ios.description:
Introducing Baby Einstein: Storytime, a brand-new interactive app with 12 books from PlayDate Digital. Each engaging and vibrant tale is hosted by a curious group of animal friends who use senses like sight, sound, and touch to introduce and explore early-learning concepts. It’s a bundle of interactive book experiences that center around Science, Nature, Art, Numeracy, Animals, and, of course, Music!
Each book introduces babies and toddlers to the splendor of classical music through well-known symphonies and compositions restyled for “little ears” from both a sound and length perspective. Featured composers include Beethoven, Bach, and Mozart, along with World Music tunes that contain natural and environmental elements that fit each book’s theme. 
This app was designed around several principles of the Baby Einstein learning philosophy, the Einstein Way, including multi-sensorial engagement, creative-thinking stimulation, and confidence development. Try out the first story for free – Water, Water, Everywhere! – and see where your child’s curiosity takes them! With every tap and swipe, your child will be transported to exciting new worlds!
Explore SCIENCE with:
- Water, Water Everywhere
- Seasons of the Year
Learn about NATURE with:
- Playing in Nature
- Colors All Around
Play MUSIC and learn SOUNDS with:
- Music Under The Sea 
- Nature Sounds 
Have fun with ART with:
- We Like to Paint 
- My Favorite Colors
Discover where ANIMALS live:
- A Day on the Farm 
- Jungle Friends 
Practice COUNTING with:
- Count To 5
- Let's Count Together
FEATURES: 
- 12 Fully narrated stories illustrating key early-learning concepts with adorable, animated animal characters
- Over 25 classical music symphonies from composers including Beethoven, Bach and Mozart.
- "Read to Me” “Read Myself” and “Auto-Play” modes allow users to control their own story experiences
- Word highlight feature as you read
- A colorful and interactive world in each book
- Simple interactions tailored to babies and toddlers.
- “Create” Mode allow users to create their own scenes with art from each of the story books.
- Add classical music symphonies to your art work.
- Save your musical artwork and share with family and friends!
- Download a book once and you can read it anytime, anywhere, without an internet connection
- Protected from unintentional purchases
NOTE:
Before you download this experience, please consider that this app contains in-app purchases that cost money. Additional content cannot be unlocked without spending money. This version is ad supported.
ABOUT PLAYDATE DIGITAL
PlayDate Digital Inc. is an publisher of high-quality, interactive, mobile educational software for children. PlayDate Digital's products nurture children's emerging literacy and creativity skills by turning digital screens into engaging experiences. PlayDate Digital content is built in partnership with some of the world's most trusted global brands for kids.
Visit us: playdatedigital.com
Like us: facebook.com/playdatedigital
Follow us: @playdatedigital
Watch all our app trailers: youtube.com/PlayDateDigital1
HAVE QUESTIONS? 
We'd love to hear from you! Your questions suggestions and comments are always welcome. Contact us 24/7 at info@playdatedigital.com

bluejetty:00069916:ios.name: Sun Tracker: UV Index & Tan
bluejetty:00069916:ios.summary: Sun Tracker: UV Index & Tan is the most complete sun tracker app for anyone who cares about safe tanning, sunscreen routines, and real-time UV index monitoring. Whether you want a golden tan, need to manage your SPF schedule, or simply want
bluejetty:00069916:ios.description:
Sun Tracker: UV Index & Tan is the most complete sun tracker app for anyone who cares about safe tanning, sunscreen routines, and real-time UV index monitoring. Whether you want a golden tan, need to manage your SPF schedule, or simply want to stay protected from sunburn, this app gives you everything you need every single day.
Knowing your UV index is the first step to enjoying the sun safely. Our sun tracker provides real-time UV index data directly from your location, so you always know how intense the sun exposure is before heading outside. The UV index changes throughout the day, and missing a spike can mean the difference between a beautiful tan and a painful sunburn. With Sun Tracker, you get precise UV index readings hour by hour, so you can plan your outdoor activities, manage your sunscreen reapplication timing, and protect your skin from unnecessary burn and long-term UV damage.
Sunscreen is your first line of defense, and our app makes sunscreen management effortless. Based on your skin type — classified using the Fitzpatrick scale — Sun Tracker calculates exactly how long you can stay in the sun before sunburn risk increases. You receive smart sunscreen reminders that tell you when to reapply your sun cream based on the current UV index and your skin sensitivity. Forget guessing your SPF schedule. The app tracks your sun exposure in real time and alerts you the moment your skin needs more sunscreen protection. No more sunburn because you forgot to reapply. Our SPF-aware sun tracker puts you in full control.
For outdoor lovers, Sun Tracker is an indispensable companion. Whether you're running, hiking, cycling, or playing beach volleyball, UV exposure adds up fast. Outdoor enthusiasts are among the most exposed groups when it comes to sunburn and cumulative UV damage, precisely because they spend extended time outside without checking the UV index or reapplying sunscreen. Set your outdoor activity, get a burn risk assessment, and receive alerts when it is time to seek shade or reapply sun cream. Stay active outdoors without compromising your skin health.
Sun Tracker is also the perfect app for family sun protection. Parents can monitor the UV index and sun exposure for up to six locations simultaneously, keeping an eye on kids at the park, family at the beach, and their own outdoor sessions. Kids burn far faster than adults, making UV index tracking and sunscreen reminders critical for their safety. With family UV alerts, every member stays protected from sunburn wherever they are. Sun safety for your kids and your whole family has never been this simple.
The tanning experience is at the heart of Sun Tracker. Our tanning app helps you build a lasting tan safely by showing you the optimal exposure window — long enough to tan, short enough to avoid sunburn. Adjust your sun exposure based on the UV index forecast and get daily outdoor sun summaries. Because tanning and burn protection are not opposites — with the right UV tracker, you can have both.
Every morning, Sun Tracker sends you a UV index forecast so you can plan your outdoor day with confidence. Add our UV index widget to your home screen and get instant sun exposure data at a glance. Sun Tracker monitors UV index levels across multiple locations worldwide. Customize UV alerts by location, set your SPF level, and let Sun Tracker handle the rest.
Download Sun Tracker — the UV index, tanning, sunscreen, and outdoor sun protection app trusted by families, athletes, and sun lovers who want a great tan and healthy skin.

Brain Test is an addictive free
bluejetty:00021021:ios.description:
Join Alyx on her quest to find the six power gems in order to save her dying father. While helping Alyx to overcome tricky and brain teasing puzzles, meet with Brain Test franchise characters along the way.
Brain Test is an addictive free tricky brain puzzle game with a series of tricky brain teasers for a relaxing brain out. These offline mind games, brain games, IQ tests, thinking games and puzzle games are perfect for those who love a good brain workout.
Do you have the puzzle skills to solve the trickiest riddles ever? Are you capable of finding clues and using your mind for logical puzzles? Only the highly intelligent players can complete Brain Test 3’s difficult story and become a brain teaser master. Exercise your brain out with different tricky puzzles. This game is a new game and an offline game. Also one of the best games in the world. If you like puzzle games and mind games then dive into mind blowing riddles and brain teasers that make this brain puzzle game the ultimate free brain game for adults.
A Long Story Filled with Adventure and Puzzles
Brain Test 3 reshapes the successful formula of Brain Test 1: Tricky Puzzles and Brain Test 2: Tricky Stories and Brain Test 4: Tricky Stories to combine tricky riddles with an exciting and epic story. Join Alyx as she embarks on an adventure filled with dangers and troubles. Find the gems to achieve infinite power and write your name into the hall of fame. Brain games and iq games are for improving the brain. Challenge your mind with brain teasers, and brain out puzzles in this mind game! You can play the best offline games for free.
Inventory System and Interactive Elements
Brain Test has never been as interactive as it is now as you can collect objects into your inventory and use them to solve the tricky puzzles for relaxing brain out.You can also merge the objects in the inventory to create new items to pass tricky brain teasing obstacles. The inventory becomes a powerful toolset for the high IQ players. No riddles will be left unsolved.
Improved Hint and Help Systems
IQ games, brain games, and mind games can be a great way to enhance your mental abilities. To help with the more complex riddles and puzzles, we implemented a better hint system to the game. With the new help system, you are not forced to struggle with difficult puzzles and riddles. With easy game mechanics and tricky quests, this mind game offers an offline brain out challenge.
Dialogue and Chat Levels
Alyx will meet dozens of characters in the course of her long and epic adventure. These characters will require you to convince them with the correct chat responses. bluejetty:00150381:ios.description:
Mannered Manes lets you discover your hair type, connect with people who have similar goals, and allows you to discover what products they use.
Never wonder what products work best for your hair type again.
DISCOVER YOUR HAIR TYPE
It begins with a hair type quiz. Once you take the quiz you will enter the hair community where you can filter your social feed based on your hair type.
SEE OTHER PEOPLE WITH YOUR HAIR TYPE
You can see everyone or only people with the same hair type as you and what products they use. You can post your amazing mane along with the products you used to achieve your style so others who share your hair type can buy the same products.
FIND THE BEST HAIR PRODUCTS FOR YOU
In the product search section you can discover the best products for you, you can search by product type (shampoo, conditioner, etc), or by brand. You can view the ingredients of each product to see if there is anything you want to avoid, and you can shop for that product through the app.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
No matter what your goal is, (hair growth, achieve the silkiest curls, grow your beard, restore hair loss, etc) you can track your progress with our progress tracker. It’s a unique camera designed to align all your images in an identical way so you can get identical images. This way you can compare the progress you’ve made.
BEARDS & SKINCARE INCLUDED
You can also search for skincare & beard products (if you have one) as well.
Ready to have the most mannered mane in the room? Come join thousands of other maneiacs and share your amazing hair with the community.
For more information please visit the link https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

Terms of Use: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/18908852

bluejetty:00123304:ios.name: Warba Bank
bluejetty:00123304:ios.summary: Warba Bank is excited to introduce its new app, which puts customers at the forefront of its attention. The app offers a personalized experience, with new home screen views and controls allowing customers to access all their banking product
bluejetty:00123304:ios.description:
Warba Bank is excited to introduce its new app, which puts customers at the forefront of its attention. The app offers a personalized experience, with new home screen views and controls allowing customers to access all their banking products and services with just a few taps. These innovative features redefine the customer-focused experience for financial services. 
The New Home Screen 
• Select from two viewing modes for each section on the home screen: 
Detailed: comprehensive details for a complete overview at-a-glance. 
Summary: a minimalistic view for easy access and enhanced information privacy. 
• Order your home screen sections to bring what's important to you to the top of the page. 
• Add your most used services to the top of the home screen within our new quick-services bar or hide the section completely to free up space for other sections! 
• Your personalization preferences move with you across your linked devices. 
Banking Products: visibility and control over your Warba products  
• Check your accounts, financing, and term-deposit balances. 
• Request a new card or financing. 
• Open savings, gold, or term deposits. 
• Grow your savings consistently with Saving Goals (Hassala) 
• Add your cards to various supported digital wallets. 
• Claim unauthorized credit card transactions. 
Payments & Transfers: Convenient ways to pay & move funds 
• Transfer money locally and internationally via SWIFT, Super Transfer, or Western Union.  
• Send and receive money requests with Pay Me & I Pay services. 
• Split bills with your friends and send reminders to those who didn't pay. 
• Schedule, edit, or cancel standing transfer orders. 
Marketplace: Exclusive deals, offers, and promo codes 
• One-stop shop for exclusive and personalized offers and deals. 
• Gift your beloved ones with various online and retail gift. 
• Redeem valuable promo codes on your favorite brands. 
Pocket: Earn rewards points for every day’s activities 
• Earn points by using credit cards, paying bills, transferring salary, or inviting friends to open an account with Warba. 
• Use your points to pay bills, top up your cards or exchange them for Kuwait Airways Oasis miles. 
• Keep track of your points earning and redeeming activities via the points history page. 
Dashboard: Get a 360° view of your finances 
• Check daily spending categories and insights at-a-glance. 
• Set up budgets and track debit/credit card transactions. 
• Track your stocks’ performance by linking your KCC (Maqasa) account. 
Security: Keep your data safe & secure 
• Enable biometrics login and transaction authorization. 
• Manage all devices linked to your account. 
• Freeze/unfreeze your cards if you misplace your card. 
Communication: Open communication channel with Warba Bank 
• Get instant transaction push notifications instead of a slow and unreliable SMS. 
• Submit suggestions or requests via Communication Center for prompt feedback back. 
• Find the nearest Warba Bank branches and ATMs to you.

bluejetty:00183610:ios.summary: Con l'app Mooney puoi pagare bollette, multe e bollettini, il bollo auto e moto, ricaricare il tuo cellulare o quello di altre persone. Puoi pagare comodamente i servizi della Pubblica Amministrazione con pagoPA, cercare i nostri punti vend
bluejetty:00183610:ios.description:
Con l'app Mooney puoi pagare bollette, multe e bollettini, il bollo auto e moto, ricaricare il tuo cellulare o quello di altre persone. Puoi pagare comodamente i servizi della Pubblica Amministrazione con pagoPA, cercare i nostri punti vendita più vicini a te, digitalizzare le ricevute dei pagamenti effettuati in punto vendita e gestire la tua carta prepagata Mooney o VR46.
PAGA LA PUBBLICA AMMINISTRAZIONE CON PAGOPA
Dimentica le lunghe code! Puoi pagare gli avvisi della pubblica amministrazione con il logo pagoPA inquadrando il QR Code o inserendo manualmente i dati. Direttamente dal tuo divano! 
SCATTA E PAGA CON IL TELEFONO
L'app Mooney ti consente di pagare col cellulare i servizi convenzionati direttamente con la fotocamera del tuo smartphone, scansionando uno dei due codici presenti sui bollettini. Puoi anche pagare dall’app, inserendo manualmente i dati richiesti. Pagare bollette (come luce, gas e altro), multe e bollettini postali diventa più veloce e facile.
PAGA IL BOLLO AUTO E MOTO
Con l’app Mooney puoi pagare il bollo auto e moto inserendo il numero di targa del tuo veicolo. Basta un tap!
RICARICA TELEFONICA VELOCE
Ricarica il tuo cellulare online direttamente da app o genera il QR Code da mostrare all’esercente per concludere la ricarica in punto vendita. 
RICARICA LE CARTE PREPAGATE CON T-RICARICA
Con Mooney hai tantissime funzionalità a portata di app. Grazie al servizio di T-Ricarica puoi ricaricare le principali carte prepagate con IBAN italiano in tempo reale. T-Ricarica è davvero conveniente: genera il codice sull’app, salvalo sul tuo telefono e mostralo nel punto vendita Mooney più vicino a te per completare l’operazione. Ricarica le tue carte prepagate in pochi istanti sia in contanti che con carta di credito o carte di debito.
DIGITALIZZA RICEVUTE
Scansiona il QR Code che trovi sulla ricevuta di pagamento cartacea e archiviala digitalmente in totale sicurezza. Potrai visualizzarla nell’archivio pagamenti e nelle statistiche e monitorare così l'andamento delle tue spese.
STORE LOCATOR
Trova il punto vendita Mooney più vicino a te inserendo uno specifico indirizzo o il servizio che ti interessa. 
RICEVUTE E STATISTICHE DI SPESA
L'app Mooney registra ogni tua transazione: visualizza il dettaglio del pagamento dalle ricevute dei tuoi pagamenti e monitora le spese effettuate per ciascuna categoria (per esempio acqua, luce, gas, multe) nella sezione "Statistiche". Per una visione ancora più completa, digitalizza le ricevute delle tue operazioni effettuate nel punto vendita Mooney, saranno automaticamente integrate nell'area "Statistiche".
ASSISTENZA DEDICATA
Se hai bisogno di aiuto per le tue operazioni in app o in un punto vendita Mooney puoi contattare il nostro servizio clienti al numero verde dedicato 800.005.005 attivo dal lunedì al sabato dalle 9 alle 20 (dall’estero +39 02 30458205), compilare l'apposito form online, consultare le FAQ o accedere ai tutorial disponibili.

bluejetty:00019264:ios.summary: Embark on a Fantasy Adventure with Cappy The Unicorn in the world of Munzee! This mystical guardian has traveled to our world to help realm-hopping creatures make their way home. Your quest is to locate magical munzee game pieces at GPS poi
bluejetty:00019264:ios.description:
Embark on a Fantasy Adventure with Cappy The Unicorn in the world of Munzee! This mystical guardian has traveled to our world to help realm-hopping creatures make their way home. Your quest is to locate magical munzee game pieces at GPS points around the world and capture them to earn points. Unicorns, dragons, and monsters - You never know what mythical creatures may land on a munzee. Continuously scout the map for new surprises!
Munzees can be either physical QR code stickers hidden in plain sight, or virtual GPS points marking places of interest. Physical munzees might be hidden on lamp posts, stop signs, tree tags, and more. Virtual munzees can only be seen using the Munzee app. You can find these munzee types at unique locales, scenic markers, or rest stops, to name a few. Alongside capping munzees you can also deploy your own to earn even more points and help grow the map around the world!
Cappy’s arrival has introduced a number of new features to help you become a master of Munzee! Start your journey at Cappy’s Camp hub in the Munzee app. Take the adventuresome unicorn on a Daily Stroll to earn Shooting Star credits, and then use those stars to summon magical Wisps at a Wishing Well in your local park. 
Compete with fellow players worldwide, earn achievements for capping unique munzees types, and build a community with in-person events around the world! Start your adventure today and help Cappy along his Munzee journey!
FEATURES:
- Discover hundreds of unique physical and virtual munzee types
- Help Cappy search for mythical creatures that periodically bounce to munzees
- Grow the map by hiding your own munzees for other players to find
- Take a Daily Stroll with Cappy to make your wishes come true
- Upgrade to a Premium Membership to unlock extra features and goodies
- Earn points to compete with players globally on the leaderboard
- Unlock badges by completing different goals
- Join a clan to participate in monthly Clan War battles
- Attend local player hosted events for exclusive badges and bonus points
Visit our blog for weekly announcements about new munzee specials, gameplay updates and more: https://www.munzeeblog.com
- Learn everything you need to know about Munzee on the Help Guide: https://munzee.zendesk.com/hc/en-us
- Discover which Munzee types you can find in-game: https://www.munzee.com/types/ 
- Find local Munzee events near you: https://calendar.munzee.com/ 
- Follow Munzee on social media:
--- https://www.facebook.com/munzeeinfo/ 
--- https://twitter.com/Munzee 
--- https://www.instagram.com/munzeeapp 
- Terms of Service: https://www.munzee.com/terms/
- Privacy Policy: https://www.munzee.com/privacy/
Munzee is a fantasy adventure like no other! Embark on a quest with Cappy The Unicorn, capturing mythical creatures like unicorns, dragons, and monsters at GPS points worldwide. Whether you're hunting physical QR code stickers hidden in plain sight or virtual GPS locations, there's always a new surprise waiting. Compete globally, join clan battles, and attend in-person events to grow your collection and climb the leaderboard. With Munzee, every day is a new realm-hopping journey filled with magic and exploration. Start your adventure today and help Cappy bring these magical creatures home!

bluejetty:00039091:ios.name: Torr: Barometer Altimeter
bluejetty:00039091:ios.summary:
Free barometer & altimeter — real-time pressure, altitude, 10-day forecasts with migraine alerts, automatic history logging, and CSV export all in one app.
The dashboard displays high-precision real-time measurement data, offering peace of
bluejetty:00039091:ios.description:
Free barometer & altimeter — real-time pressure, altitude, 10-day forecasts with migraine alerts, automatic history logging, and CSV export all in one app.
The dashboard displays high-precision real-time measurement data, offering peace of mind for mountaineering enthusiasts and outdoor adventurers.
It uses your device's built-in barometric pressure sensor, motion sensor, and GPS, allowing offline use.
It also features real-time trend graphs, making it ideal for observing short-term changes during typhoon approaches, sudden downpours, stair/elevator ascents/descents, or driving uphill.
The altimeter lets you simultaneously view readings from three sources—sensor, GPS, and QNH (sea-level corrected pressure)—plus a calibrated value matched to a known elevation such as a trailhead.
Each altitude is displayed visually on an arch gauge, and you can tap each source to learn about its characteristics and accuracy.
Since barometric pressure and altitude support various units, it can also be used for professional purposes by researchers and academic institutions.
Additionally, for those sensitive to weather changes and suffering from migraines or weather-related illnesses, it provides graphs forecasting barometric pressure and weather for the next 10 days, along with headache alert information based on published research, updated every 6 hours.
Its graphical, intuitive UI runs smoothly, making it a valuable tool for daily prevention and countermeasures.
Furthermore, measured barometric pressure data is automatically stored within the app.
It features a background measurement mode that enables measurements even when the app is in the background or asleep. You can view accumulated data and export it to CSV files.
It also supports Live Activities in the background, allowing you to view real-time data on Dynamic Island or the lock screen.
Beyond the main app, it also works with Apple Watch, letting you instantly check barometric pressure and altitude.
An all-in-one, high-performance barometer app covering all present, future, and past information related to barometric pressure.
The one-of-a-kind app you never knew you needed—that's "Torr"!!
【Features】
・Dashboard
　・Barometer (Atmospheric pressure data via pressure sensor)
　・Altimeter — View altitudes from 4 sources on arch gauges
　　・Sensor Altitude (absolute altitude from the barometric sensor)
　　・GPS Altitude (elevation above sea level via satellite positioning)
　　・QNH Altitude (sea-level corrected barometric altitude)
　　・Calibrated Altitude (calibration matched to a known elevation)
・Pressure Forecast
　・Up to 10 days of nearby sea-level pressure values and weather forecasts
　・Pressure graph showing trends like rises and falls
　・6-hourly migraine/weather sensitivity alerts based on published research
・History
　・Automatic data logging
　・Daily history export to CSV files
　・Background measurement mode
・Unit settings — 7 pressure units including Torr, hPa, kPa, mBar, psi, inHg, mmHg
・Color theme settings
・Daily pressure forecast notification
・Torr Pro — full 10-day forecast anytime, 30 days of past pressure, pressure alerts, graph widgets, ad-free
・Apple Watch compatibility and complication
・Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
・Live Activity
【Other】
Some devices may not have a barometric pressure sensor or motion sensor.
Please note that in such cases, certain dashboard features may not be available.
Location access and an internet connection are required to use the barometric pressure forecast.
Location access is required for background measurement.
Please submit requests or inquiries via reviews or the support URL.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00026399:ios.summary: HomeLights is the ultimate solution to quickly and easily control your HomeKit lights! Whether you want to adjust a single bulb or an entire room, achieve the perfect ambiance effortlessly. Finding the right room in a list can be tedious, s
bluejetty:00026399:ios.description:
HomeLights is the ultimate solution to quickly and easily control your HomeKit lights! Whether you want to adjust a single bulb or an entire room, achieve the perfect ambiance effortlessly. Finding the right room in a list can be tedious, so HomeLights includes a unique Smart Room Detection feature. This exclusive feature not only automatically opens the remote of your current room but also enables Widgets & Live Activities to dynamically display the current room!
KEY FEATURES:
- Unified Brightness & Color Control: Seamlessly adjust the brightness, color, and temperature of all bulbs in a room simultaneously, or fine-tune individual bulbs to your preference.
- Smart Room Detection: Utilizing Bluetooth, HomeLights automatically detects the room you're in and provides immediate control for this room as soon as you open the app.
- Live Activities & Dynamic Island: Enjoy fast and convenient control of your current room right from your Dynamic Island (on supported devices). For other devices, Live Activities brings similar quick control from the Lock Screen.
- HomeScreen & LockScreen Widgets: Use our interactive widgets for immediate access to your room's lighting controls. Set it up using Room Detection for dynamic room display, or lock it to a specific room of your choice.
- Apple Watch Companion App: Control your lights directly from your wrist! With our Apple Watch app, lighting adjustments are just a tap away.
- Apple Shortcuts Actions: Enhance your automations with HomeLights actions to easily control your rooms. We are also including a special "Get current room" action, which takes advantage of the Room Detection feature. Build shortcuts that adapt to your location and create personalized, efficient routines.
Start with our base version, offering control over two of your preferred rooms. For those seeking for more, the Premium upgrade provides limitless room control, exclusive Room Detection and Apple Watch access.
Light up your space with precision. Download HomeLights for HomeKit today and enjoy the ease of smart lighting adjustments!

Start your day on Home
Tap Mine to
bluejetty:00116935:ios.description:
Lia is a free way to take part in web3. Earn $LIA through everyday activities, send it to friends, and discover what people are building. You can get started without buying tokens or connecting a wallet.
Start your day on Home
Tap Mine to start a session. Lia tracks it on its servers, so you can close the app and get on with your day. Come back to see what you earned, check your balance, and follow each reward in your activity history.
Make your walk count
Turn on Strides to count your steps and claim your walking rewards before midnight. Strides uses your step count without tracking your location. See how your week adds up or join the weekly walkers board.
Find a routine you enjoy
Check in to build a streak, try the daily spin, or pick a task or quiz. Home shows what you’ve already claimed and when your next session is due.
Bring your friends along
Share your invite link to build a team. When the friends you invited are mining, they can boost your own session. Chat with friends, send $LIA by username, and follow the monthly mining and invite leaderboards.
Discover apps inside Lia
Open the Apps Center to explore web apps from Lia Labs and independent builders. Your Lia account goes with you. Play a round of chess or XO, or try another app without a separate download. When an app offers an item for $LIA, Lia shows you the price and the balance you’ll have left before you confirm.
During the mining phase, the $LIA you earn is recorded as an in-app balance. Lia is available in 13 languages.

Meet Ari. He's on a journey to rescue his sister, Ina, who has been kidnapped in the mysterious Phantom world. He's determined. He's focused. But super-scary enemies, super powers, allies and hidden secrets await him. 
In Super Phantom Cat 2, you can possess the best Phantom superpowers yet: 
· Bounce higher and higher to reach for the sky and stars.
· Float on balloons into the Wild Woods and Alps.
· Break walls, stone, and metal.
· Shrink and enlarge monsters with the touch of a finger. 
· Turn irritating critters into ice statues. 
· Shift to invincible mode if danger still prevails. 
Play as one of many characters, such as: 
· The lead singer and guitarist of a band.
· A dancer who plays pranks and dresses up as a skeleton.
· A pink-haired magician who is a master of cards.
· A funky teen skater obsessed with extreme sports.
· An adventurous cowboy always on a lookout for treasure. 
· And champions from Mushroom stomping, Juice blending and Cuteness competitions. 
Plus... 
· Find hidden secrets in the mysterious Phantom World. 
· Discover different levels and checkpoints. 
It's a purr-iceless experience for everyone! 
And... 
In Super Phantom Cat 2, you can own props, which save you from cata-astrophe. If cats have nine lives, you can earn even more! 
· Create props based on your own requirements. · Whether you are a beginner or a master at platform games, you need these props to complete your mission. 
Wait, there's more... 
Save your progress across multiple devices. Mobiles, tablets, Apple TV — you can access Super Phantom Cat 2 from all of these locations. 
From the creators of Super Phantom Cat, which featured in the App Store's "Best of 2016," Super Phantom Cat 2 is the hottest, baddest platform game of 2017.

bluejetty:00027229:ios.summary: Bipolar Disorder is a mental disorder that causes shifts in a person's mood, energy, and thoughts. People with bipolar disorder experience high and low moods (mania and depression, respectively) that are more extreme than what people typica
bluejetty:00027229:ios.description:
Bipolar Disorder is a mental disorder that causes shifts in a person's mood, energy, and thoughts. People with bipolar disorder experience high and low moods (mania and depression, respectively) that are more extreme than what people typically experience. This can lead to a lot of stress and problems with family, work, money, and the law. This app contains a self-report questionnaire to help screen for symptoms related to bipolar disorder. It also contains information to help you get a better understanding of this mental illness.
Bipolar Disorder Test is designed to evaluate your symptoms of bipolar disorder with a scientifically-supported 15-question test. It uses the Mood Disorder Questionnaire (MDQ), a screening questionnaire for bipolar spectrum disorder that is commonly used in research and healthcare settings.
Bipolar Test contains four tools:
- Start Test: take the MDQ questionnaire to screen for bipolar disorder
- Result: understand your test results and get resources tailored to your result
- Information: learn about bipolar spectrum disorder and discover additional resources that can help you on your path to recovery
Disclaimer: The MDQ is NOT a diagnostic test. A diagnosis can only be provided by a qualified healthcare professional. Please consult a physician or mental health professional if you are concerned about bipolar disorder. 
References:
Hirschfeld, R. M., Williams, J. B., Spitzer, R. L., Calabrese, J. R., Flynn, L., Keck Jr, P. E., ... & Russell, J. M. (2000). Development and validation of a screening instrument for bipolar spectrum disorder: the Mood Disorder Questionnaire. American Journal of Psychiatry, 157(11), 1873-1875.

Cat puzzle: Draw to Kitten is a simple but interesting drawing puzzle game.
You need to help the cats find the kittens and draw to home, draw a line between the cats and their corresponding homes, and avoid the villains from bumping into each other. 
Draw the lines to help the cats take the kittens go home safely when the villains are going to kidnap them. If the cats collide, they will be dizzy, and the game will fail.
How to play:
1. Click on the leg of the cat to start drawing lines.
2. Lively and interesting cats and kittens.
3. Pay attention to avoid moles, dogs, monsters, and thieves.
4. Draw a line to go home but avoid obstacles
5. Make sure all cats take their baby get home safely and win the game.
Game Features:
1. Rich and interesting levels.
2. Various customs clearance methods.
3. Fully exercise the ability to solve puzzles.
4. Variety of levels: More than 99+ levels of increasing difficulty

bluejetty:00087266:ios.summary:

Enjoy classic Pitch rules — play solo (cutthroat) or with a team, and cho
bluejetty:00087266:ios.description:
Whether you’re a seasoned pro or learning Pitch for the first time, Pitch – Expert AI is a great way to play, learn, and master this classic trick-taking card game. 
Enjoy classic Pitch rules — play solo (cutthroat) or with a team, and choose to play with or without bidding (Auction Pitch). Jump right in with preset variations from the All Fours family of card games, including Pedro, Pidro, Setback, Smear, Nine-Five, and Eighty-Three. With extensive rule customization, you can adjust the rules to suit the way you play.
Learn smarter, play better, and master Pitch with powerful AI opponents and in-depth analysis tools. Play anytime, even offline.
CHALLENGING AND ENJOYABLE FOR ALL
New to Pitch?
Learn as you play with the NeuralPlay AI, which offers real-time suggestions to guide your moves. Build your skills hands-on, explore strategies, and improve your decision-making in a single-player experience that teaches you every step of the game.
Already an Expert?
Compete against six levels of advanced AI opponents, designed to challenge your skills, sharpen your strategy, and make every game competitive, rewarding, and exciting.
KEY FEATURES
Learn and Improve
• AI guidance: Receive real-time insights whenever your plays differ from the AI’s choices.
• Built-in card counter: Strengthen your counting and strategic decision-making.
• Trick-by-trick review: Analyze every move in detail to sharpen your gameplay.
• Replay hand: Review and replay a deal to practice and improve.
Convenience and Control
• Offline play: Enjoy the game anytime, even without an internet connection.
• Undo: Quickly correct mistakes and refine your strategy.
• Hints: Get helpful suggestions when you’re unsure of your next move.
• Claim remaining tricks: End the hand early when your cards are unbeatable.
• Skip hand: Move past hands you’d rather not play.
Progression and Customization
• Six AI levels: From beginner-friendly to expert-challenging.
• Detailed statistics: Track your performance and progress.
• Customization: Personalize the look with color themes and card decks.
RULE CUSTOMIZATIONS
Explore different ways to play with flexible rule options, including:
• Number of Players – Choose 3- or 4-player solo or 4-player partnership play.
• Initial deal: Select 6–10 cards for the deal.
• Kitty: Deal 2–6 cards to the kitty.
• Stick the dealer: The dealer must bid if everyone else passes.
• Dealer can steal: The dealer may match the highest bid instead of exceeding it.
• Misdeal: Allow a misdeal for hands with only cards ranked 9 or lower.
• Dealer can run it: The dealer may choose to deal three more cards.
• Discarding: Allow discarding after trump is chosen, with the option to give the stock to the dealer or maker.
• Trump only: Require players to lead and follow with trump only.
• Team: Play in partnerships or individually.
• Low point: Assign the low trump point to the capturer or the player who played it.
• Off-jack: Include the off-jack as an additional trump worth one point.
• Jokers: Play with 0–2 jokers, each worth 1 point.
• Scoring trumps: Optionally score: 3 (3 pts), 5 (5 pts), 9 (9 pts), Q (20 pts), K (25 pts).
• Special trumps: Optionally include: off-ace (1 pt), off-3 (3 pts), off-5 (5 pts), off-9 (9 pts).
• Last trick: Award a point for taking the final trick.
DOWNLOAD TODAY
Play, learn, and master Pitch – Expert AI. Enjoy a single-player Pitch experience designed for practice, strategy, or casual play. Whether you want to improve your skills or relax with an offline card game, play your way with smart AI opponents, customizable rules, and a fresh challenge every game.

bluejetty:00039582:ios.name: Asmaul Husna 99 Names of Allah
bluejetty:00039582:ios.summary: Asmaul Husna, which means the most beautiful names; it is used for the 99 Names of Allah, the owner of both heaven and earth, the creator of the universe.The importance of Asmaul Husna is emphasized in the Holy Quran and Hadith in every fie
bluejetty:00039582:ios.description:
Asmaul Husna, which means the most beautiful names; it is used for the 99 Names of Allah, the owner of both heaven and earth, the creator of the universe.The importance of Asmaul Husna is emphasized in the Holy Quran and Hadith in every field. Every believer who has faith in Islam must learn the names of Allah and repeat them continuously. Our Prophet (S.A.W.) wanted these names to be known, to be quoted and to be felt with contemplation at any moment. Whoever memorize the names of Allah by understanding is heralded with paradise. With the Asmaul Husna application you can read names of Allah with its readings, short meanings, long explanations. Also you can dhikr names of Allah and test yourself with Arabic Asmaul Husna quiz. The importance of Asmaul Husna is stated in verses and hadiths:
“And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them.” (Al-A'raf, 180)
“Allah has 99 names. Whoever memorizes them (believes in them and reads them by heart) enters Paradise.” (Tirmidhi, Daawat 82)
-Asmaul Husna Meanings
With the Asmaul Husna application 99 Names of Allah can be learned with Arabic reading, short meanings, long explanations. You can bookmark the names of Allah you want to read later in the application to your favorites. Texts are enhanced with high contrast and resizable fonts to provide a comfortable reading experience.
-Asmaul Husna Dhikr
It is very easy to dhikr for the 99 Names of Allah with the smart tasbih in the Asmaul Husna application. Tasbih counter offers accessibility options such as audible and vibrating alerts, as well as useful features such as initial value and counter target settings. You can select the counter target as Asmaul Husna Dhikr Numbers (according to the abjad values) or you can perform a free Asmaul Husna tasbih.
-Asmaul Husna Quiz Game
We developed the quiz in game format, 99 Names of Allah are ranked in a mixed order with the meanings of Asmaul Husna. Depending on the matching of the name and the meaning, you must answer true or false each time. Thus, you can learn the meaning and pronunciation of the 99 names of Allah and you can test your knowledge. 
Asmaul Husna application provides language support for English, Indonesian (99 Nama Allah), Turkish (Allah'ın 99 İsmi), French (99 Noms d'Allah), Russian (99 Имен Аллаха) and Malaysian (99 Nama Allah) languages. Please contact us for more language options and localization.

Meet your Big Island tour guide. Discover GPS audio tours that turn your drive into a guided adventure with stories, directions, and local insights.

Explore the Big Island with Shaka Guide, a 4.9-star GPS audio tour app trusted by thousands of travelers and made in Hawaii.

WHY SHAKA GUIDE BIG ISLAND?
• GPS audio tours that play based on your location
• Works 100% offline — no cell service needed
• Built-in maps with preplanned routes and navigation
• Explore at your own pace — no schedules or groups
• Stories, Hawaiian music, and local travel tips
• Visit beaches, volcanoes, waterfalls, and more

Download a tour, start driving, and go.

Prepare for a thrilling venture, loading your rifle and refining your shooting precision for encounters with various animals. Embrace the spirit of a hunter and exhibit your shooting expertise amidst nature's domain!
Ready for an exceptional hunting and shooting quest?
Eager to traverse stunning, diverse hunting terrains, concentrating on shooting authentic animals?
Intent on experiencing different hunting and shooting methods, from free-ranging pursuits to competitive shooting outings?
Thrilled to engage in online 1v1 PvP shooting competitions, aiming at a variety of animals?
Keen on learning to load, upgrade your weapons, and shooting accurately at animal targets such as deer, wolves, and more?
WILD HUNT FEATURES:
→ Pursue and engage in shooting deer and a range of animals.
→ Explore various landscapes for hunting and shooting expeditions.
→ Travel across continents for unique animal shooting experiences.
→ Adapt to environmental factors for better shooting precision, with suitable gear and ammunition. It's the premier hunting and shooting simulation!
→ Enhance your hunting skills and shooting accuracy, compete in online PvP battles, and strive to be the top animal hunter and sharpshooter!
→ Create or join shooting clubs, relishing the hunt with friends and connecting with hunters and shooters worldwide in thrilling events!
Experience HUNTING CLUBS!
Discover the excitement of hunting clubs! Relish the thrill of hunting and shooting with peers. Join existing clubs or start your own, inviting enthusiasts of shooting and animal hunting. Participate in team hunting and shooting contests, challenging other clubs in timed animal shooting competitions!
Animal Hunting and Shooting Tournaments - Enroll Now!
Rise in the leaderboards as a renowned animal hunting and shooting specialist! Wild Hunt offers a variety of tournaments and championships, accessible for all. Perfect your hunting and shooting skills in our PvP online mode, challenging other hunters and shooters, and showcasing your adeptness in animal shooting. May the best shooter win!
Real Locations, Authentic Animals
Embark on authentic hunting trips, targeting animals native to those regions. Hunt and shoot a deer in USA, aim at a rhino in Africa, set your crosshairs on a walrus in Russia, or line up a shot at a dingo in the Australian Outback. Global hunting and shooting adventures await, directly from your mobile device. Deer shooting now spans the globe!
Choose Your Shooting Equipment
Select from an array of free hunting gear or buy new shooting items. Choose rifles, shotguns, or demonstrate your archery skills with a crossbow for animal shooting. Regularly maintain and upgrade your equipment, selecting appropriate gear for various hunting and shooting scenarios. Whether your preference lies in archery or firearms for shooting animals, Wild Hunt equips you for the challenge.
Stunning 3D Graphics
Wild Hunt stands out in the shooting games category with its impressive 3D graphics. Observe your animal prey through your weapon's scope, take careful aim, and execute your shot. Watch the bullet's path in slow motion, hitting your animal target with precision!
Developed by the team behind Fishing Clash, Wild Hunt is a socially interactive, action-packed sports game featuring realistic graphics set in genuine global hunting locales. Venture outdoors, select your weapon, target a range of animals, and fire! Meet new friends, join or form a hunting club, and participate in exciting shooting competitions. Deer shooting games have advanced, offering an authentic 2024 experience!

listings.name: Wild Hunt: Hunter Simulator
listings.description:
Prepare for a thrilling venture, loading your rifle and refining your shooting precision for encounters with various animals. Embrace the spirit of a hunter and exhibit your shooting expertise amidst nature's domain!

Ready for an exceptional hunting and shooting quest?
Eager to traverse stunning, diverse hunting terrains, concentrating on shooting authentic animals?
Intent on experiencing different hunting and shooting methods, from free-ranging pursuits to competitive shooting outings?
Thrilled to engage in online 1v1 PvP shooting competitions, aiming at a variety of animals?
Keen on learning to load, upgrade your weapons, and shooting accurately at animal targets such as deer, wolves, and more?

WILD HUNT FEATURES:
→ Pursue and engage in shooting deer and a range of animals.
→ Explore various landscapes for hunting and shooting expeditions.
→ Travel across continents for unique animal shooting experiences.
→ Adapt to environmental factors for better shooting precision, with suitable gear and ammunition. It's the premier hunting and shooting simulation!
→ Enhance your hunting skills and shooting accuracy, compete in online PvP battles, and strive to be the top animal hunter and sharpshooter!
→ Create or join shooting clubs, relishing the hunt with friends and connecting with hunters and shooters worldwide in thrilling events!

Experience HUNTING CLUBS!
Discover the excitement of hunting clubs! Relish the thrill of hunting and shooting with peers. Join existing clubs or start your own, inviting enthusiasts of shooting and animal hunting. Participate in team hunting and shooting contests, challenging other clubs in timed animal shooting competitions!

Animal Hunting and Shooting Tournaments - Enroll Now!
Rise in the leaderboards as a renowned animal hunting and shooting specialist! Wild Hunt offers a variety of tournaments and championships, accessible for all. Perfect your hunting and shooting skills in our PvP online mode, challenging other hunters and shooters, and showcasing your adeptness in animal shooting. May the best shooter win!

Real Locations, Authentic Animals
Embark on authentic hunting trips, targeting animals native to those regions. Hunt and shoot a deer in USA, aim at a rhino in Africa, set your crosshairs on a walrus in Russia, or line up a shot at a dingo in the Australian Outback. Global hunting and shooting adventures await, directly from your mobile device. Deer shooting now spans the globe!

Choose Your Shooting Equipment
Select from an array of free hunting gear or buy new shooting items. Choose rifles, shotguns, or demonstrate your archery skills with a crossbow for animal shooting. Regularly maintain and upgrade your equipment, selecting appropriate gear for various hunting and shooting scenarios. Whether your preference lies in archery or firearms for shooting animals, Wild Hunt equips you for the challenge.

Stunning 3D Graphics
Wild Hunt stands out in the shooting games category with its impressive 3D graphics. Observe your animal prey through your weapon's scope, take careful aim, and execute your shot. Watch the bullet's path in slow motion, hitting your animal target with precision!

Developed by the team behind Fishing Clash, Wild Hunt is a socially interactive, action-packed sports game featuring realistic graphics set in genuine global hunting locales. Venture outdoors, select your weapon, target a range of animals, and fire! Meet new friends, join or form a hunting club, and participate in exciting shooting competitions. Deer shooting games have advanced, offering an authentic 2024 experience!
