bluejetty:00145864:ios.description:
Can you build a perfect Canasta? Play Canasta online for free!
Canasta is usually played with two standard 52-card decks and 4 jokers. The main goal is to form melds (sets of three or more cards of the same rank), complete Canastas and reach a higher score than your opponents before the round ends.
Start with our app today, compete against real players all over the world and improve your Canasta strategy and skills! The app is intuitive and easy to use - turning you into a Canasta master in no time!
THE BEST FEATURES AT A GLANCE:
- LIVE GAMES WITH REAL PLAYERS: take on opponents at your level.
- EASY-TO-READ CARDS: our beautiful card design makes playing even more fun and provides a pleasant user experience.
- THE LEAGUE TO SHOWCASE YOUR TALENT: rise up the ranks in our leagues and prove your Canasta pro skills.
- PERFECT FAIRNESS: cards are dealt randomly using a random number generator (RNG). This ensures a fair gaming experience, where your skill at the game makes all the difference.
- AD-FREE GAMING EXPERIENCE: enjoy the game with no distracting ads or interruptions.
- HIGH-DEFINITION GRAPHICS AND DESIGN: enjoy an immersive playing experience thanks to high-quality graphics and a thoughtful design.
- RESPONSIVE CUSTOMER SUPPORT: our intuitive and easy to navigate app, various help sites and great customer support will facilitate your journey to becoming a Canasta pro!
If you are a fan of other card games like Rummy, Crazy8 or Solitaire, you will love Canasta! Our game is and will remain entirely free-to-play, you may however benefit from in-app purchases to enhance your gameplay experience.
GameDuell has 20 years experience in making fun card games like Rummy and Skat. Our apps are developed by card-game-lovers to give you a perfect online card game experience.
Let’s go - Download Canasta today and enjoy smooth gameplay and endless fun! Form melds, make Canastas, score big!
Your Canasta Team

contact-canasta@canasta-fun.com

bluejetty:00065975:ios.summary:
In the near future, the secrets of the universe will be unlocked in the chicken egg. You have decided to get in on the gold rush and sell as many eggs as you can.
Hatch chickens, build hen houses, hire drivers, and commission research to b
bluejetty:00065975:ios.description:
In the near future, the secrets of the universe will be unlocked in the chicken egg. You have decided to get in on the gold rush and sell as many eggs as you can.
Hatch chickens, build hen houses, hire drivers, and commission research to build the most advanced egg farm in the world.
An incremental (clicker) game at its core, Egg, Inc. uses many elements from simulation games that give it a unique feel and play style. Instead of menus, you are presented with crisp and colorful 3D graphics and a delightful simulation of a swarm of chickens. In addition to choosing your investments wisely you must also balance your resources to ensure a smooth running and efficient egg farm.
There is something for everyone here:
Casual players love Egg Inc's laid back feel and beautiful appearance. Take your time to build a wonderful egg farm and explore all the content.
More experienced incremental (clicker) players will love the emergent gameplay and depth afforded by the different play styles needed throughout the game. To reach the ultimate goal of having a ginormous egg farm with an astronomical value, you will need to balance strategies throughout many prestiges to make best use of your time.
Features
- Simple, Casual gameplay with opportunities to challenge yourself
- Chicken swarm!
- Dozens of research items
- Dozens of challenges and trophies
- Collaborate with friends and strangers in weekly time limited challenges called Contracts
- "Colleggtible" speciality eggs
- Artifact collection and crafting
- Deep end game
- Many different hen houses and shipping vehicles
- A "Nested" Prestige system has the game always feeling new
- Wonderful 3D graphics with pixel perfect UI and shadows
- Game Center achievements and leaderboards to compete with your friends and the world!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00036028:ios.description:
MathGPT: Your personal AI math solver! (Known as MathGPT on web)
MathGPT is an AI math solver and calculator that provides accurate step-by-step solutions for any math problem from just a photo! Over 15 million students use MathGPT as their AI math solver to understand math problems through instant, accurate solutions and AI-animated math videos.
Tackle any subject with confidence with MathGPT by your side. You can solve more than just math. Check out the other subjects offered, such as Physics, Chemistry, Accounting and Statistics. 
AI Math Solver
MathGPT's AI Math Solver provides accurate, instant solutions and outperforms popular AI models. Our math solver provides accurate math solutions accompanied by step-by-step explanations. Each explanation walks you from beginning to end through each problem. The explanations are designed to help students learn the foundations of each math concept. 
On-Demand Practice Exams
MathGPT goes beyond a math solver and offers opportunities to test your understanding. With the click of a button, generate AI powered practice exams that track your progress, provide feedback, and grades your work. Ask follow-up questions to clarify your understanding. MathGPT is there from all parts of the journey, from learning, to practicing, to mastering math concepts.
AI Animated Math Videos
MathGPT creates on-demand AI videos for any question. Ask a question, click Generate Video, and receive an animated math video complete with a voiceover. Our AI video generation uses animated math diagrams to help you understand how to solve your problem and other similar problems.
Flashcards for any topic
Explore our custom Flashcard generator to master vocabulary and test memorization. Share the topic you are learning, and generate a full, custom set of flashcards related to your topic. MathGPT provides all the AI learning tools you need in one place for a robust learning experience.
Custom Explanations
Get on-demand explanations to any problem. Just take a photo of your question and MathGPT instantly provides an intuitive explanation. Learn better and faster with personalized help for any question. 
AI Math Graphing Calculator powered by GeoGebra
Quickly visualize functions related to your problem. Create interactive graphs related to your question. Complex equations and graphing calculator problems suddenly become easier to understand with the help of GeoGebra powered visuals. 
AI Math Calculator
Complex calculations are easily solved with MathGPT's built in AI Math Calculator. We take difficult equations from any subject (math, statistics, physics, chemistry, accounting, engineering) and provide simple and easy to understand AI-powered explanations. 
Check out a list of MathGPT's Calculator topics: Delta Math Calculator, Algebra Calculator, Integral Calculator, Derivative Calculator, Quadratic Calculator, Square Root Calculator, Limit Calculator, Scientific Notation Calculator, Fraction Calculator, Decimal Calculator, Antiderivative Calculator, Graphing Calculator, Scientific Calculator, Percentage Calculator and many more.
Stay connected with the MathGPT Community!

Flashcards for any topic

AI Math Graphing Calculator powered by GeoGebra
Quickly visualize functions related to your problem. Create interactive graphs related to your question. Complex equations and graphing calculator problems suddenly become easier to understand with the help of GeoGebra powered visuals.  

AI Math Calculator
Complex calculations are easily solved with MathGPT's built in AI Math Calculator. We take difficult equations from any subject (math, statistics, physics, chemistry, accounting, engineering) and provide simple and easy to understand AI-powered explanations.

bluejetty:00044939:ios.summary: BeKind is a free, social, kindness app that gives simple, daily acts of kindness ideas that anyone can do. It's a fun way to build a habit of kindness. It allows you to add your friends and connect with other kind and loving users. The insp
bluejetty:00044939:ios.description:
BeKind is a free, social, kindness app that gives simple, daily acts of kindness ideas that anyone can do. It's a fun way to build a habit of kindness. It allows you to add your friends and connect with other kind and loving users. The inspiring stories from around the world will also keep you more motivated to be kind.
App Features:
• Kindness Tracking: Do an act of kindness now or later. Use our suggested ideas, or create your own. Keep track of all your good deeds, personalized with pictures and stories. Earn coins, level up with badges, and have fun.
• Kindness Sharing: Share ideas and acts of kindness with others. Share inspiring news and stories with friends and family using your favorite social media. Stay informed with new ideas and news about kindness.
• Community Building. Connect with kind and loving people from around the world. Invite your friends and make new ones. Get inspired by your friends’ acts and communicate with them via comments.
• Personalization: Upload your favorite photo and update your biography in your account. Set your mood for the day. Decide on your most convenient time to receive your "Idea of the Day".
• Safety Features. Block trolls and spammers. Built-in content blocking. Age verification at sign-up.
• Easy access. Login using Facebook, Apple, Google, or email address.
• Support. Send feedback, suggest ideas, and contact support.
The BeKind app helps you to:
• Build a habit of kindness, an easy and fun way.
• Challenge yourself more to become a better person.
• Connect and inspire people with your good deeds and encourage them to be more kind.
• Be kept motivated by your friend’s acts as well as news and stories of kindness from across the globe.
The BeKind app hopes to foster a community of kind and loving people around the world. Ultimately, making the world a better place, one small kind act at a time.
Take the kindness challenge today. Perform daily acts and make kindness the norm. Download is free, no ads.
Like our Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/thebekindapp
Follow us on Twitter at https://twitter.com/bekind_app and Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/bekindapp/
Pin our kindness quotes at https://www.pinterest.com/bekind_app
Subscribe to our YouTube Channel: https://youtube.com/channel/UCz02M4ROa_Tx4C64uoTG3ng

bluejetty:00041470:ios.name: Hyper Evolution
bluejetty:00041470:ios.summary:
► IT’S AN EVOLUTION REVOLUTION!
Dive into the primordial soup and get eating in this beautiful and entertaining survival simulator where your goal is to climb the food chain one organism at a time. Start the game as a small fish in a vast
bluejetty:00041470:ios.description:
► IT’S AN EVOLUTION REVOLUTION!
Dive into the primordial soup and get eating in this beautiful and entertaining survival simulator where your goal is to climb the food chain one organism at a time. Start the game as a small fish in a vast ocean and chomp your way through eons of history on the long rocky road to civilization. 
There are plenty more fish in the sea, and some of them are a whole lot bigger than you, so while you’re chowing down on your prey, just make sure you don’t end up as somebody else’s dinner. Only the fittest will survive, so activate your animal intuition, engage your reptile brain, get in touch with your inner caveman and watch your back in this Darwinian adventure game that’s red in tooth and claw but provides hours of relaxing evolutionary fun.
► SOMETHING TO CHEW ON…
• The evolution’s here: progress through entire geological ages in the vast Paleozoic ocean, growing from a tiny little primitive sprat into a mighty predatory shark, turning turtle, really coming out of your shell, and emerging on dry land as a beautiful lizard. 
• Master survival in a new environment and you’ll soon be going the way of the dinosaurs, before you move up another class to go nuts as a squirrel, take on the mammoth task of being a mammoth, and pass the test to see if you’re a good, average, or truly great ape.
• Feeling a little more human at last? You’re not quite finished with evolution just yet, work through your neanderthal attitudes, take out your caveman aggression as a hunter, and finally finish the game by settling down to a little farming as the paragon of animals and the undisputed chamption of the food chain.
• Eleven stages of evolution with a total of 81 levels in the game, each with a new twist on the satisfying core gameplay.
• Complete levels with high scores to unlock exotic evolutionary missteps including mermaids, unicorns, and dragons for even more foraging fun.
• Simple but stylish graphics with beautiful creature designs and stunningly varied landscapes that bring to life the different ages of the history of the planet right there on your screen.
► PLUMB THE MYSTERY OF PRE-HISTORY
Want to see the origin of species in action? Not sure that you’re fully evolved? This fun casual simulator will let you stake your rightful place at the top of the evolutionary ladder and have a whale of a time while doing so. 
Download Hyper Evolution, the survival game that brings biology lessons to life in a colorful and satisfying simulator experience, and get yourself evolving right now.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00018850:ios.summary:
21cake是廿一客官方APP，
提供网上订购蛋糕、手工面包、冰淇淋、咖啡等食物的服务，全程自有冷链配送。
【品牌理念】
廿一客认为，真正的自然美味，均有其自身的生命规律，人力智慧应该用在如何保护食物的天然本色上，这样做，不只是为了健康，更是尊重每一种精心挑选的地道食材。从生日蛋糕，延伸到面包、冰淇淋、下午茶和咖啡……
【天然食材】

bluejetty:00081391:android:0.description:
Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket has players in 150 countries and regions around the world.
Use your mobile devices to enjoy collecting and battling with Pokémon cards anytime, anywhere!
■ Open packs every day to collect cards!
Players can enjoy the experience of collecting, with two booster packs available to open every day. Collect different kinds of Pokémon cards, like those with nostalgic illustrations from the past, as well as completely new cards exclusive to this game!
■ Experience a new kind of Pokémon card!
The app features new immersive cards with illustrations that have a “3D feel.” Players can feel like they’ve leapt into the world of the card’s illustration!
■ A new way to collect with the share feature!
Sharing has just been added.
It’s a feature that lets you give one 1-4-diamond rarity card to your in-game friends—and receive one in return!
■ Trade cards with friends!
Use the trade feature to collect even more cards!
Certain cards can be traded with friends.
You can now trade cards from even the most recent booster packs. In addition, cards of 2-star rarity, Shiny 1, and Shiny 2 rarities can also be traded.
■ Show off your collection!
Display your cards with binders or display boards, and showcase them to players around the world! Try building a collection that you’re proud to show off!
■ Enjoy casual battles!
You can enjoy quick and exciting battles with your cards!
Players who want to test their skills even more can take on ranked matches.

bluejetty:00041824:ios.description:
Wooden Slide: Block Escape brings you a fun and brain-teasing challenge with a fresh wooden puzzle twist. The board is packed with blocks of different shapes and colors, and your mission is to slide them into the right path to escape. Sounds simple? Think again—every move must be planned carefully to clear the way.
As you move up through the levels, puzzles become more complex with tighter spaces, tricky block layouts, and challenging paths that test your logic and strategy. Each slide matters, and one wrong move could block your escape.
To help you on the toughest stages, you can unlock powerful boosters. Freeze time for an extra moment to think, smash through obstacles with a hammer, or use special tools to clear multiple blocks at once. These boosts give you the edge when the puzzle feels impossible.
With smooth wooden textures, satisfying slide mechanics, and an endless variety of puzzles, Wooden Slide: Block Escape is both relaxing and addictive. It’s the perfect game to train your brain while having fun. Can you master every escape?
Download now and start sliding your way to victory!

bluejetty:00186477:ios.description:
¡El juego de preguntas y respuestas consentido de México!
Diviértete y aprende, solo o con amigos, contestando preguntas de interés general.
Dos modos de juego: Solitario y Multijugador (en línea).
Solitario
- Contesta correctamente las preguntas para llegar a la meta de 21 o 42 km.
- Al inicio cuentas con 5 barritas de energía. Pierdes una con cada error, pero la recuperas
con 3 aciertos seguidos.
Multijugador
- Pueden participar de 2 a 4 personas.
- En tu turno contesta hasta tener 6 aciertos seguidos, o un error.
- Si todos fallan la primera pregunta en un turno, avanza la ficha negra de la Ignorancia.
¡No la dejen ganar!
- Invita a tus amigos de Facebook, oponentes recientes, o comparte un código de
invitación por Whastapp, mensaje, etc.
- Si lo preferes, puedes crear o unite a partidas abiertas a cualquier jugador.
Paquetes de preguntas
- Con la descarga de la app tienes incluido el Maratón Clásico, con más de mil preguntas.
- Poco a poco irán apareciendo más paquetes. Están a disponibles: Maratón Futbol,
Maratón Cinemex, Maratón Doña Lucha contra la Ignorancia y Maratón LGBITQ+

bluejetty:00147883:ios.description:
Your trusted partner that helps you grow, invest, and learn about money. 
The best investment app on the planet! 
Zedcrest Wealth is a wealth management app designed to help you grow your money, hit your financial goals, and earn rewards along the way. 
As an SEC-licensed asset management firm, we give you access to a secure, regulated platform to build real, lasting wealth. 
Product offerings and key features: 
Plan for your short-term and long-term goals: 
Wealth Box: Build an emergency plan without restrictions, withdraw anytime, and earn competitive interest rates. Link your debit card for seamless automated deposits. 
Aspire: Got a big goal? Set a target, pick a timeline, and set up auto-deposits to smash your targets! 
Vault: Build discipline with a strict plan. Lock your funds until maturity and watch your money grow untouched. No withdrawals, no exceptions. 
Auto-deposits & auto-reminders: Add your debit card to stay consistent with automated deposits. Get scheduled push notifications and email reminders that keep you on track. 
Invest and build wealth smarter: 
Mutual funds: Explore a range of short-term, low-risk investments in local and global markets, carefully curated for steady growth. 
Fixed-income investments: Earn steady, predictable returns through short-term, low-risk instruments. Choose from government-backed treasury bills or commercial papers and let your capital work for you. 
Ethical portfolio: Invest in line with your beliefs and values. Our ethical portfolio offers stable returns while supporting responsible and principled businesses. 
Stocks: Buy and sell NGN and US stocks with ease. Seamlessly switch between your asset management and stockbroking profiles, all in one app. 
Auto-invest: Set it and forget it. Automate your investments and stay focused on what matters most to you. 
Turn your phone into a digital wallet:

bluejetty:00149627:ios.description:
ALYKA is your personal health assistant for a stronger Heart and Mind!
Created by Doctors trained at the Best Schools to help you:
UNDERSTAND YOUR HEALTH DATA WITH INSIGHTFUL LEARNINGS.
ALYKA Health integrates data from your responses to questions and surveys, your Electronic Health Record and home health devices. Now easily review your essential health data with insightful multi-media learnings in one place!
RECEIVE PERSONALIZED HEALTH REPORTS AND SCORES.
Are you Resilient? Let’s find out through your health knowledge and confidence. Get your own Wellness Report that breaks down your health across six different dimensions with opportunities to improve across each. Calculate your Heart Risk score to estimate your 10 year risk of heart disease.
CREATE A SIMPLE AND EFFECTIVE PERSONAL HEALTH PLAN.
Several factors influence cardiovascular and mental health, including your overall sense of wellbeing, eating habits, physical activity, everyday stress, sleep patterns, tobacco and alcohol. ALYKA will improve each of these areas, lower your risk for heart disease and place you in the mental position to perform at your optimal YOU!
SET CUSTOMIZED GOALS WITH REMINDERS TO BUILD HEALTHIER HABITS.
With ALYKA you will gain knowledge and now empowered to set goals to improve areas of concern found in your Wellness Report.
GET REMINDERS FOR HEALTH TESTS AND SCREENINGS.
Your personal health assistant at your side to provide weekly check-ins for monitoring important vital signs as well as health screenings, tests and immunizations.
BUILD YOUR CARE TEAM AND MANAGE IT IN ONE PLACE.
Organize your entire care team from primary care, specialists, pharmacy, labs and imaging centers within ALYKA so you can make your calls or get directions in one place.
Strengthen your Heart and Mind with ALYKA Health!
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
ALYKA Health is free to download. We offer monthly and annual auto-renewing subscription options. Payment will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
ALYKA Health is provided for educational and informational purposes only and does NOT constitute providing medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or professional services. Individuals should contact their healthcare provider with any questions related to their health needs.

bluejetty:00033026:ios.summary:

Koko is a fun and easy dating app that doesn’t take dating too seriousl
bluejetty:00033026:ios.description:
Dating and meeting new people can be such a drag these days, right? Enter Koko: the latest free dating app for meeting and connecting people. What makes it different?
Koko is a fun and easy dating app that doesn’t take dating too seriously. No need to swipe left or right, no time limiting rules, & absolutely no guarantee you’ll meet the love of your life. Instead, Koko encourages you to chat up & meet cool, like-minded people directly and in reality.
CONNECT, DATE, & FLIRT!
Meet, connect, date & flirt with local men and women! Start fun chats & make cool new friends. Koko welcomes ALL orientations & preferences. Whoever you are or whatever you associate with, Koko has it all, guys & girls, and all those in between ;)
TRY OUR UNIQUE MATCHMAKING FEATURES:
QUIZ - Match made in Foodie Heaven!
 • Crazy party animal or lazy couch potato? Take the fun and highly entertaining personality quiz to find your best match. Or your worst!
 • Discover those with similar interests & chat up a storm with people in your area or while travelling.
REALSHOT!
 • Show them just how strong your selfie game is! Send your crush a genuine smile or funny, in-the-moment facial expressions.
• Inappropriate chats or harassment of any sort will not be tolerated, so please play & crush nicely! 
VOTE FOR YOUR CRUSH TO GET A DATE!
Koko is the app to find people nearby in a fun and easy way. Vote for guys and girls, and if they vote back, voilà, it’s a Crush! The more you vote, the more chances you have of flirting and chatting up your dream date! So, chat online, make a date, and meet up in real life! In the end, dating leads to a ton of FUN, and maybe a bit of smooching - if you’re lucky!
CONVENTIONAL? NO WAY!
What’s left to say? We’ve all done that flirt & dating thing, haven’t we? It’s a part of life after all, and life is meant to be enjoyed and lived to the fullest! So, have fun! Chat with friends, go clubbing, take a trip with new people. This is your journey. Own it.
---
The app is free to download and use. Koko also offers an optional subscription package.  
Subscription Service Conditions:
 • Koko+ costs 18,99 USD / 19,99 EUR / 16,49 GBP, for 1 month; 7,49 USD / 7,99 EUR / 6,99 GBP for 1 week; and 74,99 USD / 76,99 EUR / 67,99 GBP for 6 months (Prices may vary slightly depending on location and currency).
 • Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase 
• Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
 • Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period 
• You can manage your subscription and switch off the auto-renewal by accessing your Account Settings after purchase 
• You cannot cancel the current subscription during the active subscription period
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription to that publication. 
More details here: https://www.hallokoko.com/terms-and-conditions
All personal data is handled under the terms and conditions of Koko's privacy policy. More details can be found here: https://www.hallokoko.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00188194:ios.description:
The New Living Translation (NLT) is a modern English Bible translation first published in 1996. Known for its clarity and readability, the NLT uses simple and natural language to help readers easily understand the message of the Scriptures.

bluejetty:00128163:ios.description:
Bad audio can ruin a great video. KLIN Audio helps you fix it. Remove unwanted noise, boost volume, improve clarity, and transform your sound with professional audio effects - all without compromising your original video quality. 
Whether you're creating Instagram Reels, TikToks, Stories, or everyday videos, KLIN Audio helps you get cleaner, louder, better-sounding audio while preserving your original video quality.
CLEAN & ENHANCE AUDIO
 * Reduce wind and background noise in voice recordings
 * Increase, decrease, or mute video volume
 * Improve clarity with audio filters
 * Fine-tune your sound with 8- and 16-band equalizers
 * Boost bass or remove unwanted low frequencies with a high-pass filter
AUDIO EFFECTS
 * Add depth and space with Reverb, Echo, and Stereo Delay
 * Create wider sound with Stereo Spread
 * Experiment with Ring Modulation and Pitch effects
 * Maximize loudness and prevent clipping with a Limiter
 * Choose from a growing collection of audio presets
POWERFUL, EASY-TO-USE EDITOR
 * Preview audio changes while watching your video
 * See how effects change your audio waveform
 * Quickly turn effects on and off to compare results
 * Edit slow-motion videos at normal or original playback speed
 * Apply effects individually or combine them to create your own sound
HIGH-QUALITY VIDEO EXPORT
 * Preserve your video's original picture quality, HDR, frame rate, and metadata
 * Keep video and audio perfectly synchronized
 * Maintain high-quality audio throughout editing and export
 * Import videos from Photos or Files, including videos stored in iCloud
 * Save your edited videos directly to Photos
 * Share to Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms
 * No watermark
 * Works offline

bluejetty:00137382:ios.description:
RVing gives you the freedom to vacation the way you want to. Whether it’s driving the open road to a hike on a bucket list trail or having the RV delivered and set up to camp at a national park campground, you’ll find that an RV rental is the best way to experience it. Renters can use the RVshare app to: 
Explore with ease - Browse over 100,000 motorhomes and trailers, save your favorites, and share your perfect RV rental with friends and family. Options are available to fit every budget and include motorhomes, travel trailers, campervans and pop-up campers. Search filters for pet-friendly rentals, RVs that can be delivered to your campground, and trailers that your vehicle can tow make it easy to find the right option for you.
Book with confidence - Safely and securely book your trip through the RVshare app with payment protection and a worry-free rental guarantee. Comprehensive insurance offerings and 24/7 roadside assistance means we are here for you through every step of your vacation. 
Stay connected while on the road - Get pre-trip questions answered and stay connected to your RV owner through every step of your vacation through in-app messaging. With the RVshare app, important trip details and documents for your rental are always at your fingertips. 
RVing has never been more popular. If you own an RV, share the love of camping and earn up to $40,000 per year. Listing your RV on RVshare is free and gives you access to millions of potential renters nationwide. RV owners can use the RVshare app to: 
Stay up to date - Easily see when your RV has new messages, booking requests and upcoming rentals from the app home screen so that you can efficiently run your rental business. 
Respond quickly - Review and accept booking requests quickly through the RVshare app to ensure that you get more reservations. In-app messaging makes it easy to communicate with renters ahead of their trip, during their vacation and after their reservation ends. 
View booking details - View important booking details, documents, payout information, and the status of your reservations while on the go. 
START MAKING MEMORIES TODAY!
For renters who want to find and book their next road trip, camping adventure, or festival vacation and stay connected while on the go, and owners who want to easily manage their motorhome or trailer rentals from anywhere, the free RVshare app makes it convenient to browse, book and manage reservations from anywhere, any time.

- experience the cel
bluejetty:00161138:ios.description:
The official prayer app of the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes is there for you every day in your prayer and meditation, wherever you are.
Join the Sanctuary's prayer community and keep in touch with Lourdes every day:
- experience the celebrations live from the Grotto
- pray each day with Our Lady of Lourdes
- have a candle lit, leave a prayer intention, or have a mass said for your intentions
JUST LIKE BEING IN LOURDES IN PERSON
Every day, millions of people from all over the world connect with Lourdes in search of hope and comfort. The message that the Virgin Mary delivered to Bernadette Soubirous is a treasure to be discovered and rediscovered.
Would you like to join with the pilgrims in Lourdes? Would you like to learn how to pray the rosary and discover the grace of this unique place? The “Praying with Lourdes” app is designed to be a part of your daily life, to invite you to peace and reflection.
The app is run by priests, religious and lay people from the Sanctuary of Lourdes.
It is aimed at those who are new to or already familiar with Lourdes, those who practise their faith regularly or occasionally, those who are curious... and those who are friends of Lourdes.
100% free to download.
The app is available in 4 languages: French, English, Spanish and Italian.

Step into the wonderful world of books with Nextory. Now you can listen to audiobooks and read eBooks without any limit. It’s very simple to stream books in the app directly on your iPhone or iPad. Nextory is always available. At any time - online and offline - as long and as often as you want.
Sign up today and enjoy 14 days or even more of free unlimited reading and listening with Nextory. You will get access to over 1.4 million books right away. No matter what kind of books you are looking for - bestsellers, crime novels, thrillers, non-fiction, or feelgood. You will always find the stories that you like in our huge library.
Your advantages with Nextory:
Read eBooks comfortably and anywhere - at home or on the road.
Listen to audiobooks anytime you want: on vacation, while commuting, to relax and in between.
Read and listen online or offline by downloading audiobooks and eBooks directly to your iPhone or iPad.
Huge library of excellent audiobooks and eBooks with over 1 million titles in total from the genres such as non-fiction, novels, thrillers, children's books, fantasy, and many other categories.
Discover new audiobooks and eBooks that you like. Based on your reading history, we create individual reading and listening tips tailored to your needs.
With our eBook reader it is possible to...
... place an automatic bookmark. You can mark a place in a book and easily go back or start in the exact same place where you paused before.
… adjust the font size, screen brightness and background color individually to your liking or depending on your reading environment.
… turn pages or jump back and forth between chapters and books in a trouble-free and easy way.
… get an even better reading experience with the double-page view in iPad, which delivers a feeling close to a physical book.
… save your favorite locations using markers and bookmarks.
With our audiobook player it is possible to:
...increase or decrease the reading speed in different steps to individually choose your desired speed.
… simply use our navigation bar to fast-forward or rewind if you want to go back to a specific place in the book you would like to listen to.
… set a sleep timer that will automatically stop the player after a specific amount of time.
… use the bookmark function to mark out a good part of the book or to continue to listen exactly where you last stopped or paused.
... keep track of how much of you have left of the book you are listening to.
… continue to listen even in energy-saving mode and enjoy your favorite audiobooks anytime you want.
Sign up today and enjoy the benefits with Nextory!

You can easily access them online or download books in advance to read and listen offline. Even audiobooks for the little ones. 
Read and listen for free for 14 days and up - start your trial today!
Benefit from the eBook reader developed specifically for Nextory, which will take your reading experience to a whole new level. Even reading PDF files run flawlessly. It has numerous settings so that you can customize your reading experience to suit your every need.
In-App Subscription Unlimited - price- and payment terms:
A subscription gives you access to our growing library, consisting of tens of thousands of books at a fixed monthly cost.
The amount will be charged automatically each month via your iTunes account. The subscription is automatically renewed each month,
as long sd the feature "automatic renewal" is not deactivated via the iTunes settings on your device, no later than 24 hours before your subscription period runs out. You can read more about our terms and conditions on our website.
